raw.excerpt: About High ScaleWe’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media.
raw.description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Junior Video Editor who is hungry to learn, fast on the keys, and ready to grow into a top-tier performance editor.

Why This Role Matters

Speed, precision, and growth are your playground. As a Junior Video Editor, you are the engine room of our post-production team. You’ll support Senior Editors by assembling footage, handling high-volume versioning, and applying the finishing touches that make our ads pop.

This isn’t just about cutting clips; it’s about mastering the art of performance marketing. You will learn the science behind "the hook," the rhythm of a winning ad, and the technical workflows of a world-class agency. If you are eager to learn from the best and accelerate your career, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Support High-Volume Editing

    • Assist Senior Editors by assembling rough cuts, organizing raw footage, and pulling selects for high-performance ad campaigns.

    • Execute fast-paced edits for social media (TikTok, Reels, Shorts), focusing on pacing, music syncing, and basic transitions.

  2. Handle Versioning & Resizing

    • Take approved "hero" edits and adapt them for various platforms and aspect ratios (9:16, 4:5, 16:9) ensuring no visual quality is lost.

    • Create multiple variations of ads (changing hooks, swapping music, updating CTAs) to support our aggressive A/B testing strategy.

  3. Manage Assets & Organization

    • Maintain a pristine digital workspace. ensuring all project files, assets, and exports are named and organized according to High Scale’s strict workflows.

    • Perform Quality Control (QC) on your own work to ensure zero technical errors before final delivery.

  4. Learn & Level Up

    • Absorb feedback from Art Directors and Senior Editors to refine your technical skills and storytelling ability.

    • Stay current with social media trends to understand what editing styles are trending on TikTok and Instagram.

Who You Are

  1. A Rising Talent

    • 1–3 years of experience in video editing (freelance or agency). You have a portfolio that shows potential, rhythm, and a good eye for composition.

    • You are passionate about social media content and understand the language of the internet.

  2. Technically Proficient

    • You know Adobe Premiere Pro inside and out. You are comfortable with keyboard shortcuts and efficient workflows.

    • Basic knowledge of After Effects (for simple motion graphics) and color correction is a major plus.

  3. Fast & Detail-Oriented

    • You can work quickly without sacrificing quality. You double-check your export settings and catch small mistakes before anyone else does.

    • You are organized and follow instructions precisely.

  4. Eager to Learn

    • You check your ego at the door. You view feedback as an opportunity to get better, not a criticism.

    • You want to build a career in performance marketing and commercial editing.

  5. Excellent Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency is required. You can communicate clearly with a global remote team via Slack and Zoom.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: We promote from within. Master this role, and the path to Video Editor and Senior Editor is open to you.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one breakthrough campaign at a time.

raw.description:
About Onward

At Onward, we're nurturing wellbeing - one ride, one visit, one moment of connection at a time. Our door-through-door Companion rideshare services and transportation management platform help individuals with mobility and cognitive challenges access healthcare, community resources, and daily essentials. We work with healthcare systems, PACE programs, public transportation agencies, and health plans to improve care access, reduce missed appointments, and relieve the burden of caregiving.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, love wearing multiple hats, want to help shape a category-defining business and lead a high-performing team, we want to talk.

Reports To:Chief Revenue Officer

Location: Remote (Anywhere USA)

Pay Range: $125,000 to $150,000

OTE range with Incentive Structure: $145,000 to $180,000

About the role

As Senior Business Development Manager, you will lead new business acquisition efforts across healthcare segments, driving revenue growth through consultative sales and strategic partnerships. You’ll own the full sales cycle from pipeline development and opportunity qualification through contract execution and will work cross-functionally to ensure successful handoff and launch with our Customer Success team.

You’ll be responsible for accurate forecasting, maintaining CRM discipline, and contributing insights that shape our go-to-market strategy. This is a quota carrying role suited to a motivated, healthcare-savvy professional who thrives in a mission-driven, high-growth environment.

You’ll also build the health system sales playbook, own the sales-to-Customer Success handoff standard, and mentor future sales hires. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports.

What you'll do

Sales & Business Development
  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle for healthcare prospects (Health Systems & Hospitals, and PACE programs)
  • Develop and execute outreach strategies, value propositions, and tailored presentations aligned with customer goals (e.g., LOS, access to care, SDoH, cost savings, compliance)
  • Respond to RFPs and RFIs, develop pricing models, and negotiate contract terms in collaboration with leadership and legal
  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline and consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets
  • Define and own the sales-to-customer success handoff standard, partnering with Operations and Customer Success to ensure a smooth handoff post-sale
  • Lead in kickoff meetings and early implementation steps to align internal teams with customer expectations
Sales Strategy & Playbook
  • Build and own the health system sales playbook: ideal customer profile, qualification criteria, discovery framework, and pitch narrative
  • Own the go-to-market approach for priority markets, starting with Texas, and present market strategy and target account plans to the CRO
  • Lead pricing and packaging recommendations for the health system and PACE segments, in partnership with leadership and Finance
  • Make the approach repeatable, so the next market and the next hire start from what you built
Forecasting & CRM Discipline
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date deal stages, close dates, and revenue projections in the CRM, Hubspot.
  • Provide regular sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and market feedback to leadership
  • Use data and historical trends to improve forecast accuracy and deal velocity
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with Marketing to develop campaigns, collateral, and thought leadership tailored to healthcare audiences
  • Share market insights with Product to inform roadmap priorities and address industry pain points
  • Represent Onward at industry events, conferences, and webinars as a brand ambassador and subject matter expert
Mentorship
  • Mentor and help onboard future business development and sales hires, without formal authority
  • Set a calm, steady tone for the team through deal setbacks, long sales cycles, and market ambiguityDescribe the specific responsibilities and job functions of the role

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of B2B healthcare sales or business development experience, including SAAS products (health systems, PACE, payers, or care coordination strongly preferred)
  • Track record of building or shaping a sales process, playbook, or go-to-market approach that others adopted
  • Strong understanding of healthcare delivery models, value-based care, and social determinants of health (SDoH)
  • Ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals from discovery to close
  • Skilled at using CRM tools for pipeline management, forecasting, and reporting
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills; confident interfacing with clinical and executive audiences
  • Builds buy-in across teams without formal authority
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative environment
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% to 40% for client meetings and conferences

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in or selling to Medicaid and Medicare Advantage programs
  • Knowledge of non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT) or benefits administration
  • Background in healthcare startups or early-stage healthtech companies
  • Experience mentoring or onboarding other sellers

Why Join Onward?

  • Impact-Driven Work: Help revolutionize transportation for those who need it most.
  • High-Growth Environment: Be part of a fast-paced, rapidly scaling company.
  • Shape How We Sell: Build the health system sales motion our team will grow on.
  • Customer-Centric Culture: Work closely with mission-driven partners making real-world impact.

We Offer

  • Unlimited PTO
  • 12 Paid Company Holidays
  • 401k with 5% match
  • Competitive health and benefits plans
  • Employee Assistance Program

If you're excited about building healthcare partnerships, making a difference in healthcare and transportation, and being part of a dynamic, mission-oriented team, we'd love to hear from you!

raw.excerpt: NVIDIA Aerial CUDA Accelerated RAN is framework for building high-performance, software-defined, cloud-native Radio Access Network functions over NVIDIA CPU/GPU/DPU based systems.
raw.description:
NVIDIA Aerial CUDA Accelerated RAN is framework for building high-performance, software-defined, cloud-native Radio Access Network functions over NVIDIA CPU/GPU/DPU based systems. We are seeking a self-motivated senior software engineer to drive development, performance and scalability of our platform. This position offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology for 5G and 6G networks, using NVIDIA's world-class compute platforms to advance the field of software-defined digital signal processing stack!


As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.


What you will be doing:

  • Lead design and development of ground breaking end-to-end reference system stack for 5G/6G baseband system.
  • Optimizing CPU, GPU and NIC sub-systems for predictable low-latency and maximum throughput
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve performance bottlenecks in CPU, GPU and NIC sub-systems
  • Work in lab environment to trouble-shoot and integrate complex software modules.
  • Develop software, implementing new baseband functions in C/C++/Python/CUDA on a GPU platform.
  • Support system integration, performance testing, system demonstration and lab trials for end-to-end system.
  • Be a technical bridge between engineering team and partners/customers engineering team. Engage with customer field trials and technical teams.
  • Help in implementing missing features to unblock progress at customers/partners and in benchmarking and develop/evaluate test tools for Aerial SDK evaluation.

What we need to see:

  • Our ideal candidate has a wireless communication systems or digital signal processing background, a passion for building real-world carrier-grade communication systems, and industry experience developing PHY/MAC layer or base band unit (BBU) software in C/C++.
  • Understanding of the PHY/MAC layer procedures and typical performance tradeoffs, as well as overall system performance.
  • Background with LTE/5G MAC and PHY from both systems and low-level 3GPP spec point of view. Ability to switch between high-level systems view and low-level detail view of complex wireless systems.
  • Comfortable using wireless lab equipment such as signal generators, network analyzers, power meters, etc. Exposure to CUDA/GPU programming is a plus.
  • MS or PhD in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or Telecommunications (or equivalent experience)
  • 8+ years of work-related proven experience in software development, systems engineering.
  • Ability to work as an individual contributor or take a technical leadership role. Strong written and oral communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with management and engineering.
  • Experience in the telecommunications industry or with customers/partners in the telecommunications domain.
  • Strong time-management and organization skills for coordinating multiple initiatives, priorities and implementations of new technology and products into very complex projects. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 31, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.description:
Country Manager South Africa

As Country Manager South Africa, you understand the crucial role strong business ecosystems play in driving economic growth, social inclusion, and sustainable development. You bring a solid local network of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and partners, combined with proven experience in programme management and team leadership. Do you thrive on building meaningful partnerships, leading a result-driven team, and creating lasting impact across your country? This is your opportunity!

About PUM

PUM is a unique organisation committed to making a positive impact on a global scale. With a network of 1,200 skilled voluntary experts, we collaborate with ambitious entrepreneurs in 26 countries and 12 programmes, sharing expertise to strengthen business ecosystems and create economic, social, and environmental value. We work closely with SMEs, as well as the organisations that support them. We believe in the power of collaboration and in the magic that happens when diverse perspectives come together; Together we grow!

The role

You will lead the country acquisition team in South Africa, consisting of 6Country Representatives on a freelance basis who engage change-driven SMEs to participate in PUM's impactful programmes. You hold end-to-end responsibility for client relationship management after acquisition, ensuring continuity, quality of engagement, and strategic alignment. You will be part of the Africa regional team, reporting to the head of region and collaborating closely with 15 other country managers in the region, 12 programme managers, as well as other departments such as recruitment and communications & partnerships. Your daily activities will be varied and challenging:

  • You develop and implement the Country Impact Plan (CIP) in line with PUM’s mission, strategy, and organisational ambitions.

  • You center on strengthening business ecosystems, based on strategic analysis and in line with PUM’s programmes. You are able to establish partnerships and collaborate with wider networks of entrepreneurs, business organisations and other enabling organisations to advance business ecosystems.

  • You identify, develop, and secure funding opportunities from institutional donors, foundations, corporate partners, and other possible sponsors, contributing to the sustainability and growth of PUM's impact in South Africa.

  • You foster strategic partnerships with SMEs and stakeholders through proactive account management and ongoing engagement, building trust and long-term impact, while expanding PUM's visibility, credibility and country influence.

  • You build, lead, and coach the country representative team, safeguarding the quality and continuity of acquisition.

  • You ensure team capacity, motivation, accountability, and performance through effective people management, including organising country team meetings (CTMs).

  • You qualify new clients using assessment criteria that emphasise diversity, inclusion, and alignment with PUM’s green and social goals within business ecosystems.

  • You approve project proposals, ensuring accurate and complete information so programme managers can identify the right expert match.

  • You collaborate closely with programme managers to ensure alignment, shared goals, and successful projects. Occasionally, you will welcome and accompany visiting experts.

  • You personally engage with clients after acquisition, ensuring continuity, quality of engagement, and strategic fit.

  • You lead professional briefing and debriefing sessions to ensure quality assurance, data collection, and learning.

  • You monitor performance and use data to share insights and improve results. 

  • You ensure compliance with organisational policies, quality standards, and project timelines.

Who are you?

As Country Manager, you combine strategic vision with operational excellence. You understand the challenges that local SMEs face and know how to translate entrepreneurial ambition into tangible impact. Does this sound like you?

  • You are a proactive, hands-on and strategic thinker with a bachelor's or master's degree.

  • You bring at least 10 years of experience in a coordinating role and leading a commercial or acquisition-focused team.

  • You bring in strong fundraising capabilities through a thorough understanding of local donor opportunities.

  • You have a strong local SME network and a deep understanding of business ecosystem development in your country.

  • You are familiar with European work culture and experienced in remote collaboration within international organisations.

  • You demonstrate strong intercultural communication skills and collaborate effectively across departments and stakeholders.

  • You have proven leadership and accountability skills, with experience in performance management and stakeholder engagement.

  • You are experienced in managing a remote team operating across the country.

  • You are willing to travel occasionally within South Africa for project development visits, partnership meetings, and country team meetings.

  • You are strongly focused on impact, quality, and measurable results.

  • You thrive in an organisation in growth and transition and enjoy contributing to further professionalisation.

  • You are data-driven and comfortable using digital tools, including Microsoft 365.

  • You have excellent command of English.

  • You are permanently based in South Africa, preferably Johannesburg or Cape Town, and available for 37.5 hours per week.

What we offer

This assignment is offered on an independent contractor basis with an expected commitment of approximately 37.5 hours per week, up to a maximum of 1.800 hours per year. The initial assignment is for one year, with the possibility of extension based on organisational needs and a successful collaboration. You will receive a competitive fee aligned with local market standards, reflecting the responsibilities and scope of the role. As an independent contractor, you are responsible for your own taxes, social security contributions, insurance and any other statutory obligations that apply in your country of residence. Reference checks and a declaration of good conduct are part of the selection process. At PUM, we celebrate diversity and inclusion as essential pillars of our organisation. We embrace the uniqueness of each individual, fostering an environment where everyone can thrive by being their authentic selves.

Ready to make a difference? Join us!

Becoming a Country Manager at PUM isn’t just a career move; it’s a chance to drive meaningful change. Working at a volunteer organisation like PUM offers extra fulfilment. In addition to the benefits mentioned, here’s what else awaits you:

  • Building a brighter future: Contribute to the sustainable development of communities, cultivating a profound sense of fulfilment

  • Optimal knowledge utilisation: Put your expertise to its best use, making tangible impact on businesses worldwide.

  • Continuous learning: Embrace new perspectives and gain insights by connecting with diverse people and cultures.

  • Building a professional network: Collaborate with a vast network of stakeholders, including institutional funders, government entities, and NGOs.

  • International exposure: Immerse yourself in a multicultural environment, broadening your horizons.

Apply now and be part of something truly meaningful!

Get inspired by one of our successful projects within our Social & Educational programme in South Africa: The revitalisation of Dimbaza Industrial Park in South Africa - PUM

In the case of a high volume of applications we reserve the right toclose the vacancy early and begin interviews before the deadline on 17 November 2026. Please submit your CV and motivation letter in English.

Highlights

Picture yourself as people manager, leading the country team of South Africa. Are you ready to shape a brighter tomorrow? Join PUM and let’s make a lasting impact together!

raw.description:
Company Overview

Our client is a software company that helps property managers inspect properties and turn what they find into clear, shareable reports. They've been at it for over ten years, profitable and self-funded the whole way, and today tens of thousands of people use it, together capturing over 100 million inspection photos. They're now putting real energy into paid social, and this role builds the creative behind it.

Your Role

Paid social is a new channel for a product like this, and the hard part is easy to say and tricky to do: explain an operational tool without making ads that feel technical or corporate. You own the fun, social-first concepts, from the first spark of an idea to the finished creative. You learn how customers actually work, find the human tension inside their problems, and turn it into something people want to watch. This is not a make-briefs-and-wait role: you carry an idea from spark to finished ad and care how it lands. You do not need to master every craft; you define the outcome, keep the idea intact, and judge the work that reaches the audience.

You'll

  • Come up with social-first ad concepts and hooks that earn attention in the first few seconds
  • Turn a dry, operational insight into something relatable, funny, or genuinely fun to watch
  • Make the work: writing, filming on a phone, editing, or directing a freelancer or AI tool, whatever the idea needs
  • Write clear briefs so a creator, editor, or tool can run with an idea without losing it
  • Test variations and let what the audience responds to shape what you make next
  • Keep every finished ad accurate, clear, and relevant to the people who might buy

You Bring

  • A real feel for short-form video and social content, shown through anything you've made: side projects, a personal account, school, freelance, or a job
  • An instinct for hooks: you get why a video keeps someone watching past the first seconds
  • Clear writing, enough to brief an idea so someone else executes it faithfully
  • Comfort being hands-on where it helps, without needing to be an expert at every part
  • You actively use AI tools in your creative work, and can say how
  • Good spoken and written English, since the team is US-based and fully remote

Years are not the point here; instinct and taste are.

Bonus Points

  • Creative for B2B or SaaS, or any product people think is unglamorous
  • A sense for paid-social performance: hook rate, retention, testing
  • Any brush with property management, real estate, or field services

What's Offered

  • Fully remote, anywhere in LATAM with a few hours of overlap with US Pacific time
  • Part-time or full-time, whatever fits; the work matters more than the hours
  • What we'd estimate for a role like this: around $1,500 to $2,500 USD/month for full-time (roughly $9 to $14 per hour), paid weekly in USD as a contractor. Part-time is welcome and paid hourly. Share the range that fits your level and we'll go from there
  • Up to 20 days paid time off a year (prorated for part-time)
  • Real creative ownership: your ideas ship and reach audiences in weeks, not quarters

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This role is open for candidates residing in the following US states: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts , Rhode Island, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Washinton DC, Maryland, Delaware. The role requires travel approximately 25% of the time.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue
  • All candidates must be located in one of the following states: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts , Rhode Island, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Washinton DC, Maryland, Delaware

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$152,000—$190,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Position : Senior Recruitment Consultant - Fashion & Retail
Salary : Competitive South African base salary plus a strong commission structure
Working Hours & Conditions: Approximately 30 hours per week — six hours per day, five days per week, Strong alignment with the Australian business day; exact shift agreed with the successful candidate.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

A premier boutique recruitment firm in Australia specializes in connecting top-tier talent with leading brands across highly dynamic, lifestyle-driven niche sectors. The firm's specialist consultants collaborate with prominent brands to facilitate strategic placements across creative, operational, digital, and commercial business functions.

Currently, the team is looking for a dependable and professional Recruitment Resourcer to assist in sourcing, vetting, and pre-qualifying high-calibre talent for active job openings. This role transcends basic administration; with routine data tasks fully automated, the core objective centers on active candidate engagement and the delivery of qualified shortlists. Prioritizing long-term stability and professional growth, the firm boasts an exceptionally high retention rate within its offshore team, with the previous incumbent serving for over three years.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

The client is seeking an experienced agency recruiter with a strong understanding of the fashion, retail, beauty, lifestyle or e-commerce sector. Working remotely from South Africa, you will manage recruitment assignments, build relationships with clients and candidates, and develop specialist talent networks across our Australian and US markets. We are looking for someone commercially sharp, proactive and confident managing a recruitment desk. You will bring sector knowledge, strong headhunting skills and the ability to represent the client professionally with senior clients and candidates. This is an opportunity to become a valued, long-term member of our team, with meaningful responsibility and strong earning potential.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage recruitment assignments from briefing and sourcing through to interviews, offer negotiation and placement.
  • Understand client businesses, role requirements and hiring priorities, and provide informed recruitment advice.
  • Proactively headhunt candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, direct outreach, referrals and specialist networks.
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines across your areas of expertise.
  • Assess candidates’ experience, technical capabilities, motivations and suitability for each opportunity.
  • Present well-qualified shortlists with clear, accurate candidate summaries.
  • Manage candidate relationships throughout the process, maintaining regular communication and a high standard of service.
  • Coordinate interviews, gather feedback and keep recruitment processes moving.
  • Manage your desk, prioritise assignments and maintain accurate records within the recruitment CRM.
  • Identify opportunities to deepen client relationships and secure repeat business.
  • Work closely with the wider team across Australian and US recruitment assignments.

Recruitment specialisms

  • Your experience may cover one or more of the following areas. You do not need expertise across every discipline:
  • Buying, merchandising and planning.
  • Fashion design, production and garment technology.
  • E-commerce and digital.
  • Marketing and sales.
  • Retail operations and head-office functions.
  • Senior leadership and executive retail appointments.

Requirements

Essential

  • Solid recruitment agency experience, with current or recent experience recruiting within fashion, retail, beauty, lifestyle or e-commerce.
  • A strong understanding of your specialist market, including relevant roles, skill sets and candidate profiles.
  • Demonstrated success managing recruitment assignments and delivering placements.
  • Strong headhunting and candidate management skills.
  • The ability to build a talent network and manage a recruitment desk with ownership and urgency.
  • Commercial confidence and credibility when speaking with senior clients and candidates.
  • Practical experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and recruitment CRMs.
  • Excellent written and verbal English.
  • Strong organisation, attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
  • The ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Genuine, ongoing availability to work hours strongly aligned with the Australian business day.

Highly regarded

  • Experience recruiting for Australian or US clients.
  • International recruitment exposure and confidence working across markets and time zones.
  • Experience recruiting senior or executive appointments within fashion and retail.
  • An established network within a relevant specialist market.

The person who will thrive here

You are polished, personable and commercially astute. You move quickly, communicate clearly and follow through without needing to be chased. You understand that successful specialist recruitment requires market knowledge, targeted outreach and strong relationships. You take pride in the quality of your work and want to build a long-term career within a team where your contribution matters.

Benefits

  • A competitive South African base salary reflecting your experience and capability.
  • A strong commission structure with genuine earning potential.
  • Remote work from South Africa.
  • Approximately 30 working hours per week.
  • Exposure to Australian and US clients and candidates.
  • The opportunity to build specialist networks and become an integral member of the client

Working hours:

The role requires approximately six hours per day, five days per week, with strong overlap with the Australian business day. This will involve early starts in South Africa. The exact shift will be agreed with the successful candidate. Applicants must be comfortable maintaining this schedule on an ongoing basis.

raw.description:
About Accenture

Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.

You Are:

We seek network professionals who have successfully led and delivered modern network transformations.

A successful Consultant, Network Engineer combines strong technical expertise with consulting and problem-solving skills. They help design, implement, and support secure, scalable networking solutions across enterprise environments. They can translate business and technical requirements into practical network solutions, contribute to transformation initiatives, support automation efforts, and collaborate effectively across teams to deliver reliable and future-ready infrastructure. They are also expected to build strong client relationships, continuously develop their technical expertise, and contribute to successful project outcomes.

Key job responsibilities include:

  • Assess and plan network design and implementation projects
  • Assess client network environments and identify gaps and performance improvement opportunities, based on leading industry practices
  • Develop implementation roadmaps and transition plans
  • Document findings and present to client managers and engineers
  • Develop network engineering solutions from concept through implementation
  • Create network detailed designs utilizing software defined networking, network segmentation, network access control, network security, and cloud networking components
  • Analyze and provide recommendations for emerging network technologies
  • Implement network infrastructures solutions (hands-on engineering, configuration, testing, deployment, and initial support)
  • Establish and maintain relationships with clients
  • Drive internal and client-facing meetings and develop reports and presentations

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 25% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here is what we need:

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience supporting large-scale network transformation and modernization programs.
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience designing infrastructure to support AI, analytics, data-intensive, and high-performance application workloads.
  • Minimum 2+ years of experience with software-defined networking, intent-based networking, network digital twins, and autonomous operations concepts.
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience with hybrid cloud, multi-cloud, and edge networking architectures.

raw.description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity


FICO builds the analytics and decisioning technology behind some of the highest-stakes decisions in the world economy including the FICO Score, the standard measure of consumer credit risk in the US, and FICO Platform, an API-first applied intelligence platform delivering real-time decisions across fraud detection, credit risk, regulatory compliance, marketing, and customer engagement. This is mission-critical, low-latency, heavily regulated software where auditability and controlled change are non-negotiable. This role sits at the point where that technology is being built and operated in an agentic-first way. As coding agents take on an increasing share of the software lifecycle, the engineer's role shifts from hand-writing code to directing, specifying, and verifying the output of a fleet of specialised agents, working through a structured harness of guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that transforms raw model capability into production grade engineering. The successful candidate will bring the engineering judgement that agents cannot replicate: the ability to define what good looks like, encode it with sufficient precision for agents to achieve it, and recognise when they have not, applying that judgement to architecture, correctness, trade-off analysis, and the design of the work itself.


What You’ll Contribute

  • Collaborate with Product teams to translate early stage ideation into structured Proof of Concepts, establishing clear technical feasibility and scope.
  • Produce detailed specifications and acceptance criteria that enable coding agents to generate correct, maintainable, and well-architected output, taking full ownership of the resulting code through to deployment.
  • Apply rigorous quality standards to all agent generated output, ensuring it meets the same level of scrutiny as hand written code within a regulated decisioning context.
  • Operate effectively within the agentic harness, utilising established guides, including AGENTS.md files, architectural rules, and reference documentation alongside automated sensors such as linters, fitness tests, verification loops, and LLM-as-judge reviewers.
  • Identify the root cause of recurring agent errors and work with the harness team to implement systemic controls, ensuring the same class of failure cannot recur across the codebase.
  • Maintain the accuracy and currency of repository documentation, specifications, and contextual knowledge, treating these as a shared system of record for both human engineers and agents.
  • Apply focused technical judgement to architecture decisions, edge case analysis, latency and integration risk, auditability requirements, and any determination that falls outside the appropriate scope of agent autonomy.

What We’re Seeking

  • Demonstrable experience in software engineering within large, complex codebases, with a strong foundation in software architecture, testing practices, and long-term maintainability.
  • Practical experience working with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or Cursor with a clear understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use within a production engineering workflow.
  • The technical judgement to critically evaluate agent generated output, identify subtle errors or architectural weaknesses, and make informed decisions about when to intervene in the agent workflow.
  • The ability to communicate technical requirements with precision, producing specifications and definitions of done that are unambiguous, testable, and actionable by both agents and engineering colleagues.
  • A disciplined approach to verification, instinctively questioning correctness, building appropriate checks and test coverage, and applying particular rigour in regulated and mission-critical delivery contexts.
  • A results-oriented approach to delivery, with accountability for the quality and correctness of shipped work rather than volume of code produced.
  • Familiarity with relevant technologies including Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, AWS or Azure, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, ML model deployment, or real-time decisioning systems.
  • Experience with spec-driven development, context engineering, or agent orchestration in a team environment is a significant advantage, as is knowledge of regulated or audited software delivery processes and controlled change management.
  • A background in decisioning, credit risk, fraud detection, analytics, optimisation, or data engineering would be advantageous; candidates who can also articulate a considered approach to human-AI collaboration including delegation boundaries, human oversight, and earning autonomy through demonstrated quality will be of particular interest.

Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.

raw.description:
Sales Support Specialist

Full-Time | M–F 8:30–5:30 Central | 100% Remote (U.S.)

  • $36,000 base + commission
  • Full base from day one — including every day of training
  • 100% inbound — no cold calling, no prospecting, no list building

About Us

At EIDLexit we help small business owners resolve their SBA disaster loan (EIDL) debt. Most are frightened, embarrassed, and out of options when they reach out. We believe every person is made in the image of God and deserves honest guidance in the hardest financial season of their life.

We are a Christian-led company looking for people who want to build a career here — not pass through. You can read what we believe at eidlexit.com/about-us.

We're scaling fast, with lead volume growing every month.

Sales Support Specialist

Our closers sit across from small business owners on the hardest financial day of their year. Your job is to make sure every one of those conversations starts prepared, on time, and with trust already built.

This is a dedicated sales-support career role. You do not sell or close. You make our closers faster.

What You Will Do

  • Respond to new leads fast and earn the consult with tactical empathy.
  • Book, confirm, and recover consults so closer calendars stay full of qualified conversations.
  • Route every borrower to the right calendar.
  • Gather documents and complete the HubSpot record so closers never open a blank file.
  • Keep borrowers moving after the consult with clear, honest next steps.
  • Hand every objection, legal question, or SBA question to the closer. You do not answer them.

What You Will Never Do

  • Sell, close, or quote fees or terms.
  • Give legal advice or predict SBA forgiveness decisions.
  • Make promises on behalf of the SBA or an attorney partner.

How You Will Be Measured

Show rate, file completeness, speed to lead, closer capacity, and call quality. No dial-count quotas.

The Opportunity

Every lead is inbound. These are business owners actively searching for help with a serious financial problem — they raised their hand and asked us to call. Answer rates are high because they need us.

You are the first person a client speaks with. We train in tactical empathy, not scripts and pressure. Those skills transfer anywhere.

What You Need

Every item below is checked in your application:

  • Hands-on HubSpot CRM experience. You have logged calls and notes and kept contact and deal records current.
  • Experience working with AI. You have used an AI tool such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or Claude in your work.
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S. as a W-2 employee.
  • Availability Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:30 PM Central, and full-time through the three-week onboarding and training block.
  • A reliable computer with a webcam, stable high-speed internet, and a private, quiet place to take calls.

What We're Looking For

  • A warm, clear communicator who leads with empathy and listens before they talk.
  • A problem solver. When two numbers don't match, you check before you act.
  • Detail-oriented. You read every instruction and follow structured processes consistently.
  • You genuinely care about the person on the other end of the call, and you would rather tell someone the truth than close them. We hire people of every background who want to work this way.
  • Coachable and self-motivated in a remote environment.
  • Prior appointment-setting, lead-response, or customer-support experience is a plus but not required. No degree required.

This is not for you if you close by pressure or you're not comfortable with people in financial distress.

What We Offer

  • Four weeks of paid time off a year. One full week is yours the day you start — not prorated, no waiting period, no matter when in the year you join. The other three weeks accrue across the calendar year, prorated from your start date. PTO covers vacation and sick time.
  • All national holidays paid, plus Good Friday and Christmas Eve
  • Health insurance and retirement launching Q1 2027
  • KPIs you know in advance and see every month. Annual pay reviews run off those same measures, so nothing lands as a surprise
  • Ongoing paid communication, tactical empathy, and career training
  • The full commission structure in writing — every tier, every percentage — during the interview process and again before you accept an offer. You will know exactly how you get paid before you decide

Position Details

Full-time W-2, 100% remote, open to candidates across the United States. You must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. as a W-2 employee — we do not sponsor visas. A few states may be unavailable depending on where we are registered to employ; we will tell you early if yours is one of them.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM Central Time. That's 6:30 AM–3:30 PM Pacific and 9:30 AM–6:30 PM Eastern.

You'll be on video all day through Microsoft Teams. You need a reliable computer with a webcam, stable internet, and a quiet workspace.

How to Apply

The application comes first: a few short-written questions, about ten minutes. Then five stages, and we'll tell you where you stand at each one.

  1. A short video interview: scripted questions you record on your own time, about six minutes. Nothing to schedule.
  2. Skills assessments: about thirty-five minutes.
  3. A live interview with sales management.
  4. A set of workstyle and aptitude assessments: about two hours, and you can split it across sittings. We only send these to our finalists.
  5. A final conversation with leadership.

Job searching is stressful enough. We don't ghost candidates. You'll hear back either way.

EIDLexit is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

You'll turn our technical capabilities into clear propositions that help customers understand what to use, why it matters and how to get started.

This is a hands-on role. You'll interview customers, collaborate with engineers, create product marketing content and enable Sales, working closely with Product, Engineering, Growth and Ecosystem teams.

📍 Location: United States (Remote) — with some overlap with European working hours required.

What you’ll do

  • Own positioning and messaging across model APIs, serverless and dedicated compute, developing differentiated value propositions for priority segments and use cases.
  • Translate technical capabilities into customer value, highlighting cost, performance, reliability and time to deployment, backed by clear evidence.
  • Conduct customer and competitive research to understand workloads, buying criteria, objections, alternatives and market opportunities.
  • Lead go-to-market and product launches, coordinating messaging, demos, product pages and customer communications across teams.
  • Create compelling product marketing content, including product pages, use-case narratives, presentations, competitive comparisons and customer stories.
  • Enable Sales with pitch materials, discovery guidance and objection-handling resources.

  • Senior-level product marketing experience in technical B2B, such as APIs, developer platforms, cloud services or infrastructure products.
  • Proven ability to simplify and differentiate complex technical products through clear positioning and messaging.
  • Experience leading cross-functional product launches, coordinating efforts across multiple teams.
  • Excellent writing skills, with examples of product pages, presentations or launch materials you've created yourself.
  • Technical understanding of AI inference, GPU compute and deployment models, sufficient to communicate their value to customers.
  • Strong commercial mindset, with the ability to work with funnel metrics and product usage data.
  • Customer research skills, with the ability to turn interviews and market insights into actionable decisions.

Nice to Have

Senior Clinical Research Associate

At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise.


As the world’s largest FSP organisation, with over 90 sponsor partnerships, we offer stability, career development and a collaborative environment where your work contributes to the development of treatments that benefit patients worldwide.


At ICON, it’s our people that set us apart. Our diverse teams enable us to become a better partner to our customers and help us to fulfil our mission to advance and improve patients’ lives.

Our ‘Own It’ culture is driven by four key values that bring us together as individuals and set us apart as an organisation: Accountability & Delivery, Collaboration, Partnership and Integrity. We want to be the Clinical Research Organisation that delivers excellence to our clients and to patients at every touch-point. In short, to be the partner of choice in drug development.

That’s our vision. We’re driven by it. And we need talented people who share it.
If you’re as driven as we are, join us. You’ll be working in a dynamic and supportive environment, with some of the brightest and the friendliest people in the sector, and you’ll be helping shape an industry.

As a Clinical Research Associate at ICON, you’ll work within a large-scale, fast-paced environment alongside a close-knit team of highly qualified CRAs to identify, select, initiate and close-out investigational sites for clinical studies in phases II – IV, ensuring adherence to applicable regulations and principles of ICH-GCP. This position is sponsor dedicated supporting Dermatology & Rare Disease trials.

The role:

• Independent, proactive work to set up and monitor studies, complete reports and maintain documentation
• Submitting protocol, consent documents for ethics/IRB approval, as well as preparing regulatory submissions
• Balancing sponsor generated queries
• Taking responsibility for study cost efficiency
• Preparation and review of study documentation and feasibility studies for new proposals
• Potential to assist in training and mentoring fellow CRAs

You will need:
• 18 months+ of monitoring experience in phase I-III trials as a CRA
• College degree in medicine, science, or equivalent
• Previous monitoring experience in medium-sized studies, including study start-up and close-out
• Knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and ability to review and evaluate medical data
• Excellent written and verbal communication in German & English
• Ability to work to tight deadlines
• Availability to travel least 60% of the time (international and domestic -fly and drive) and should possess a valid driving license

Benefits of Working in ICON:
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

We offer very competitive salary packages. And to keep them competitive, we regularly benchmark them against our competitors. Our annual bonuses reflect delivery of performance goals – both ours and yours.
We also provide a range of health-related benefits to employees and their families and offer competitive retirement plans – and related benefits such as life assurance – so you can save and plan with confidence for the years ahead.

The Advocate Health National Center for Clinical Trials (NCCT) is setting a new benchmark for excellence and innovation in clinical trial solutions. Our goal is simple yet bold: We connect researchers to a broad population of patients and streamline the enrollment process, delivering more inclusive cohorts and more efficient clinical trials. And we make it easy for patients to engage in clinical trials in their own communities.


Grounded in experience and supported by the integrated research expertise of Wake Forest University School of Medicine, the Advocate Health National Center for Clinical Trials is a first-of-its-kind, fully integrated solution designed to make participation in clinical trials part of the standard of care for patients. Our technology ecosystem supports clinical trials across all stages of planning and execution, from recruitment and retention to management and virtual care, delivering efficient processes and high-quality results. Powered by the expertise of the school of medicine’s research team and Advocate Health clinicians and accelerated by cutting-edge technology, we are uniquely positioned to make an impact.


Job Description Summary:

The NCCT Product Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing the mission of the NCCT by leading the design and evolution of technology-enabled business capabilities that transform how our organization operates. This individual will report to the Vice President and Head of Technology & Transformation, working closely with cross functional leaders operate at the intersection of business strategy, process design and technology execution, helping ensure the organization focuses on the right work and achieves measurable outcomes.


The NCCT Product Manager is responsible for defining, executing, and delivering product strategy and roadmap initiatives that drive business growth and customer value. This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders, engineering, design, and operations teams to ensure products meet organizational objectives. The NCCT Product Manager leads product lifecycle activities from ideation through launch and ongoing optimization while mentoring junior team members and influencing cross-functional decision-making.


This role is not focused on external products or feature delivery. Instead, it:

  • Redesigns how work is performed across teams and how the organization operates, not just building features
  • Defines future-state processes enabled by technology, data and AI
  • Translates business needs into clear, high-value solutions
  • Partners with shared technology and informatics teams to bring solutions to life

Major Responsibilities:

Define Future-State Capabilities

  • Design how the business should operate when fully enabled by technology, data, and AI
  • Identify opportunities beyond requests or incremental improvements
  • Redesign workflows to align to future state, tech-enabled capabilities
  • Challenge legacy processes and assumptions

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and long-term roadmap.
  • Align product initiatives with organizational goals and business priorities.
  • Develop business cases and prioritize investments based on customer impact and return on investment.

Product Roadmap Management

  • Create, maintain, and communicate product roadmaps.
  • Prioritize features, enhancements, and technical investments based on data and stakeholder input.
  • Balance short-term business needs with long-term strategic objectives.
  • Manage product backlogs and ensure requirements are clearly documented.

Customer & Market Research

  • Engage with customers, users, and stakeholders to understand needs and pain points.
  • Analyze customer feedback, usage patterns, and market trends.
  • Translate customer insights into actionable product requirements.
  • Monitor competitive products and emerging technologies.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with engineering, UX/UI design, operations, and support teams.
  • Lead product planning, development, testing, launch, and post-launch activities.
  • Facilitate stakeholder alignment and drive decision-making across teams.
  • Manage risks, dependencies, and trade-offs throughout the product lifecycle.

Product Delivery & Performance

  • Define product requirements, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
  • Track product performance through KPIs and analytics.
  • Measure business outcomes and continuously optimize products based on data.
  • Ensure successful product launches and adoption strategies.

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Mentor Product Managers, Business Analysts and Project Managers, as necessary.
  • Foster a customer-centric and data-driven product culture.
  • Influence senior leadership through strategic recommendations and insights.
  • Champion agile product development methodologies and best practices.

Education Required:

  • ​​Bachelor’s degree in business, Technology, Engineering or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in product management with significant focus on transformation of business operations and workflows.

Work Experience Required:

  • Proven experience leading complex products, platforms or digital solutions
  • Track record of designing technology-enabled, data-driven efficient, scalable workflows
  • Track record of successful product adoption and customer satisfaction

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required:

  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Strong knowledge of agile, scrum or similar product management methodologies.
  • Excellent stakeholder influence skills to build trust and drive alignment
  • Proficiency in product and data platforms and analytics
  • Able to adapt in an evolving environment

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Office job

Preferred Experience

  • Experience within healthcare, clinical research, life sciences or regulated industries
  • Experience operating in a heavily matrixed organization
  • Experience managing SaaS, enterprise software or digital products
  • Experience helping to make build vs buy decisions from a product portfolio perspective

This job description indicates the general nature and level of work expected of the incumbent. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the incumbent. Incumbent may be required to perform other related duties.

Our Commitment to You:

Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including:

Compensation

  • Base compensation listed within the listed pay range based on factors such as qualifications, skills, relevant experience, and/or training

  • Premium pay such as shift, on call, and more based on a teammate's job

  • Incentive pay for select positions

  • Opportunity for annual increases based on performance

Benefits and more

  • Paid Time Off programs

  • Health and welfare benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life, and Short- and Long-Term Disability

  • Flexible Spending Accounts for eligible health care and dependent care expenses

  • Family benefits such as adoption assistance and paid parental leave

  • Defined contribution retirement plans with employer match and other financial wellness programs

  • Educational Assistance Program

Note: Eligibility for programs listed above may depend on your FTE or status (e.g., full-time, part-time, per diem, temporary, etc.); please ask a Recruiter for more information during an interview.

About Advocate Health

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

Cedars-Sinai was awarded the National Research Corporation’s Consumer Choice Award 19 times for providing the highest-quality medical care in Los Angeles. What You Will Do in This Role:

The Utilization Management Specialist provides advanced operational and workflow support to Utilization Review (UR) Nurses to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant execution of the utilization review process. This position performs complex, non-clinical functions that directly support payer communication, authorization coordination, documentation integrity, and regulatory compliance.

The Utilization Management Specialist maintains an assigned portfolio of cases in partnership with multiple UR Nurses and is accountable for oversight of authorization workflows from initial submission, follow-up through to final determination. The role applies independent judgment in prioritizing cases based on payer deadlines, regulatory requirements, and authorization expiration risk.

In collaboration with UR Nurses, Case Management, Revenue Cycle, and external payers, the Utilization Management Specialist ensures documentation and authorization activities are complete, accurate, and executed within established timeframes. This position plays a critical role in supporting revenue integrity, denial prevention, and compliance with CMS and payer specific requirements.

The role operates in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment using EPIC/CS-Link, AIDIN, payer portals, and related UM systems to proactively manage workflows and remove administrative barriers that could delay review completion or payer communication.

  • Maintain an assigned portfolio of cases in partnership with UR Nurses to support timely utilization review activities.
  • Prepare and assemble clinical review packets and supporting documentation for payer submission.
  • Review records to confirm required documentation elements are present prior to submission and escalate gaps to the assigned UR Nurse.
  • Track submission confirmations and ensure timely follow up on pending payer determinations.
  • Manage the authorization lifecycle for assigned cases, including entry, tracking, follow up, documentation of determinations, and monitoring of payer response timelines.
  • Monitor payer portals and contact payers directly, as needed, to obtain authorization updates and resolve status discrepancies.
  • Independently prioritize cases based on submission deadlines, authorization expiration risk, and regulatory timeframes.
  • Escalate urgent authorization issues, delays, or barriers that may result in avoidable denials or authorization lapses.
  • Coordinate peer to peer scheduling logistics and maintain related documentation.
  • Document and communicate payer determinations, including approvals, partial approvals, and denials, in EPIC/CS-Link in accordance with departmental and regulatory standards.
  • Identify patterns or systemic authorization workflow issues and communicate trends to UM leadership.
  • Document and communicate payer determinations, including approvals, partial approvals, and denials.
  • Ensure all required documentation is accurately entered into EPIC/CS-Link in accordance with departmental and regulatory standards.
  • Communicate effectively with internal and external partners to ensure patient and authorization information is current and complete.

*Approved Remote States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Minnesota, Nevada, Oregon, Texas*

What You Will Do:

The Managed Care Contracting and Performance Advisor is responsible for strategic management, evaluation, negotiation, implementation, and ongoing performance monitoring of managed care contracts. This role partners closely with Finance, Revenue Cycle, Operations, Physician Services, and payer organizations to optimize reimbursement, mitigate contractual risk, improve operational performance, and maximize revenue opportunities across hospital and physician service lines.


The position serves as a subject matter expert in managed care reimbursement methodologies, contract language interpretation, payer negotiations, and contract compliance, while driving initiatives that improve financial outcomes and payer relationships.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


Contract Evaluation and Analysis:


  • Conduct comprehensive reviews and audits of existing managed care contracts to identify opportunities for reimbursement improvement, contract optimization, and renegotiation.
  • Perform financial modeling and reimbursement analyses to assess the impact of proposed rate changes, contract amendments, and new payer arrangements.
  • Evaluate contract language to identify operational, financial, and compliance risks.
  • Assess reimbursement methodologies, payment policies, authorization requirements, carve-outs, and contractual obligations to ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
  • Develop business cases and executive-level recommendations to support contract strategy decisions.

Payer Negotiation and Relationship Management:


  • Develop and execute strategic negotiation plans for commercial, Medicare Advantage, Managed Medicaid, and other managed care payers.
  • Support payer negotiations involving reimbursement rates, contract language, payment methodologies, revenue protection provisions, and operational requirements.
  • Analyze payer proposals and prepare counterproposals supported by financial and operational data.
  • Maintain ongoing communication with payer representatives to resolve negotiation issues and facilitate contract execution.
  • Build and maintain productive payer relationships that support long-term organizational goals.

Contract Implementation and Operational Support:


  • Coordinate implementation activities related to new or amended managed care agreements.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Revenue Cycle, Patient Access, Case Management, and Physician Services teams to ensure operational readiness.
  • Develop and maintain contract summaries, reimbursement guides, and reference materials that translate contract terms into operational requirements.
  • Support payer configuration, billing implementation, reimbursement validation, and operational education following contract execution.
  • Serve as a liaison between internal stakeholders and payer organizations to resolve contract interpretation questions and post-implementation issues.

Performance Monitoring and Revenue Improvement:


  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators related to managed care contract performance, including reimbursement accuracy, denial trends, payment timeliness, underpayment activity, and revenue yield.
  • Partner with Revenue Cycle leadership to interpret contractual intent and support operational compliance with contract terms.
  • Investigate, escalate, and assist in resolving complex underpayment, denial, and reimbursement disputes.
  • Analyze payer performance trends and identify opportunities for revenue recovery and contract compliance improvements.
  • Prepare executive-level reports and presentations summarizing contract performance, negotiation progress, financial impact, and strategic recommendations.

Strategic Initiatives:


  • Identify and evaluate new payer, IPA, medical group, and physician contracting opportunities.
  • Support physician network and medical group contracting strategies designed to expand patient access and referral opportunities.
  • Assist with value-based care, risk-based contracting, and alternative payment model initiatives as appropriate.
  • Contribute to the development of managed care strategies that support organizational growth, financial sustainability, and market expansion.

Success in this role will be measured by:


  • Improved managed care reimbursement rates and contract terms.
  • Successful implementation of negotiated agreements.
  • Reduction in underpayments, denials, and payment variances.
  • Increased contract compliance and operational effectiveness.
  • Positive financial impact from payer negotiations and contract optimization efforts.
  • Timely resolution of payer disputes and reimbursement issues.
  • Strong collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and payer partners.

What You Will Need:

  • Requires a bachelor's degree and a minimum 6-8+ years or an AA degree and 8-10+ years of prior relevant experience. (Relevant experience may be substituted for formal education or advanced degree.)
  • Relevant experience coming from a healthcare provider, central business office environment, managed care, contracting, healthcare finance, payer relations, related healthcare administrative roles or revenue cycle outsourcing company.

What Would Be Nice To Have:


  • Demonstrated experience negotiating managed care agreements with commercial and government-sponsored health plans.
  • Experience performing reimbursement analyses, financial modeling, and contract reviews.
  • Knowledge of hospital and physician reimbursement methodologies, including Medicare, Medicaid/Medi-Cal, DRG, APC, fee schedules, capitation, and value-based payment models.
  • Strong understanding of managed care contract language and reimbursement structures.
  • Advanced analytical and financial modeling skills.
  • Ability to interpret complex contractual and reimbursement provisions.
  • Negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple departments and levels of the organization.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and healthcare financial analytics tools.

Collective Goods Holdings, Inc. (CGH) is a privately held holding company behind Books Are Fun, Inc. — a company with a simple but powerful mission: to inspire lifelong readers by getting kids excited about books. Books Are Fun energizes communities, schools, and families to ensure every child has books at home, because we believe reading can change the world.

To learn more about our companies and how we spark a lifelong love of reading, please visit our website at

Position Summary

The Childcare Sales Manager owns the Books Are Fun childcare division end to end. This is a builder role in a division that is growing fast, has a proven program, and has real runway ahead of it.

Book Blast is a literacy program that gets kids excited about books and reading. The childcare division brings that same program to childcare centers and early childhood settings. It operates differently than the schoolwide business. The buyer is different, the program cadence is different, and the sales motion requires dedicated ownership to reach its potential.

The Childcare Sales Manager leads a team of Childcare Specialists who own the full client lifecycle: from presentations through program fulfillment and into renewals.   • Partner with the CSM team to understand the Book Blast fulfillment process and adapt best practices for the childcare context.
  • Become the internal expert on the childcare program, including how it differs from the schoolwide model and how to evolve it based on field experience.
  • Partner with Marketing to develop childcare-specific awareness and demand generation.

Duties
