Become part of Humana’s caring community and help us put health first. The Manager, Care Management is responsible for leading a team of care managers who support members with transitional needs, chronic conditions, and barriers that may impact health, independence, and well-being. This role provides operational leadership for telephonic, member-centered care management activities, including coordinated follow-up, resource connection, and support aligned to member needs and business priorities.

This remote role offers the opportunity to lead within an organization focused on improving quality of care, access to resources, member experience, associate engagement, and operational performance. The manager is expected to develop talent, reinforce accountability, promote associate engagement, and support alignment to Humana’s broader care management objectives.

The Manager, Care Management is accountable for coaching, developing, and managing associates to achieve established performance, quality, productivity, compliance, documentation, and member-focused outcomes. This leader is expected to apply sound judgment, use data to identify trends and risks, and support continuous improvement in a dynamic care management environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide day-to-day leadership, direction, coaching, and development for assigned care management associates.
  • Establish clear expectations, monitor performance, deliver timely feedback, and document performance-related conversations in alignment with business and human resources processes.

  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, team meetings, call reviews, case reviews, and development discussions to support associate performance and growth.
  • Promote an engaged and inclusive team environment through clear communication, recognition, collaboration, and support for professional development.

  • Support associates through process changes, operational updates, system enhancements, structured schedules, and shifting business priorities.

Sales Development Representative

Argano | Remote

About Argano

Argano is the first and largest Global Specialist Consultancy exclusively focused on the design and delivery of High-Performance Business Operations with our AI-forward approach to transformation. We pioneer intelligent and connected solutions for our clients' operational environments across customer engagement and service, revenue management, finance and planning, supply chain, and workforce optimization, driving both efficiency and the agility to innovate product, service, and organizational design at the speed of today's market. Competitive advantage, cost optimization, customer satisfaction, and sustainable growth are our North Stars and our promise to our clients.

About the Role

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) is a critical, high-visibility role at the tip of the spear of Argano's revenue engine. This is not a passive lead-routing position - it demands a driven, intellectually curious professional who thrives on the hunt, builds genuine business relationships, and is energized by connecting complex enterprise challenges to transformative solutions that extend our clients' commercial agility, profitability, customer experience, and growth.

You will own the top of the sales funnel - identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective clients within an assigned Argano business unit (BU). You will partner with senior sales professionals, Practice Leaders, Presales, Alliances, and Marketing to build a consistent, high-quality pipeline. This role carries a quota with meaningful incentive compensation, and high performers have a clear path to senior sales roles within Argano.

What You'll Contribute

  • Bring positive energy, curiosity, a competitive spirit, and a relentless ambition for success to every prospect interaction and team engagement.
  • Drive brand awareness by educating the market and sharing thought leadership with executive-level prospects, while aligning Argano's solutions to meaningful business outcomes.
  • Identify and pursue high-value opportunities - net new and expansion - by targeting ideal customer profiles and connecting their business challenges to Argano's capabilities.
  • Execute high-volume, high-quality outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn to engage C-suite, VP, and Director-level decision-makers at enterprise companies.
  • Lead structured discovery conversations that go beyond surface-level qualification to uncover real business challenges, desired outcomes, and decision-making dynamics.
  • Align closely with your internal partners on target account priorities, messaging strategy, and lead pursuit to ensure a coordinated and effective approach to the market.
  • Utilize the full RevTech stack to increase connect rates, deliver timely and relevant messaging, and continuously improve outreach effectiveness.
  • Maintain accurate records of prospect data, activity, and market insights in Outreach and Salesforce to support campaign optimization and pipeline integrity.
  • Participate in ongoing training to deepen knowledge of buyer personas, Argano's service offerings, and the technology solutions we deliver.
  • Consistently meet and aim to exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline generation goals.

What We're Seeking

  • 3-5 years of experience in Sales Development, Business Development, or Inside Sales in a technology-driven environment - ideally selling enterprise software or technology consulting services to large, complex organizations.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Information Technology, or a related field - or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proficiency with tools including Outreach, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Microsoft Office, ZoomInfo, and a dialer such as Orum or Nooks.
  • Experience with territory prioritization, ICP definition, and targeted outreach strategy - not scripted calling.
  • The ability to tailor messaging to specific verticals, pain points, and buying triggers, with the judgment to know which accounts warrant pursuit and when to push versus pull back.
  • Professional maturity, business insight, and strong communication discipline in a high-expectation, self-managed environment.
  • A critical thinker and competitor who uses data to improve performance and wants to be great at this - not just good enough.

What Great Looks Like in This Role

The best SDRs at Argano are students of the craft. They invest in understanding their prospects' businesses before picking up the phone, write outreach that earns a reply, and run discovery conversations that uncover real pain and genuine urgency. They hand off opportunities that the sales team is excited to work - and they treat every rejection as information, not defeat. If you are hungry to learn and ready to compete at a high level, this role will reward you.

Why Argano

  • A market-leading consulting practice with deep client relationships and a strong reputation for delivery excellence - making your outreach credible from the first call.
  • Competitive base salary, uncapped incentive compensation, and a full benefits package.
  • A collaborative, high-performance culture where SDRs are respected contributors to revenue - not an afterthought.
  • A clear path to more senior sales roles for high performers who demonstrate results and ambition.

raw.description:
About Great Lakes Wellness

Great Lakes Wellness is a clean, fast-growing health and wellness brand specializing in high-quality collagen and nutritional products designed to support whole-body wellbeing. As part of the Wellmore Holdings portfolio backed by WM Partners, Great Lakes Wellness is committed to delivering clean, great-tasting products that help consumers feel their best—inside and out.

Great Lakes Wellness is committed to creating clean, great-tasting products that support the health and wellbeing of our consumers and the planet. We believe our people are the heartbeat of everything we do—a diverse community of ambitious humans driven to make a meaningful impact on the world, on each other, and on the communities we call home.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a highly organized, relationship-driven Social Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist to help grow and activate our creator, ambassador, and affiliate network.

This role will focus on the day-to-day execution required to turn creator partnerships into a scalable acquisition and revenue channel — identifying the right creators, managing outreach and onboarding, supporting product seeding and campaigns, driving consistent content creation, and optimizing affiliate performance.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building relationships with creators and working in the details: managing a pipeline, following up relentlessly, tracking links and codes, reviewing performance, and identifying which partners and content are driving results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Creator & affiliate recruitment: Identify, source, and recruit high-potential creators and affiliates across priority social platforms, with an emphasis on partners who demonstrate strong audience trust and conversion potential (DTC focus) — not simply reach.
  • Outreach & relationship management: Own creator outreach, follow-up, onboarding, gifting/seeding coordination, and ongoing communication to keep partners engaged and activated.
  • Affiliate activation: Support the growth of our social affiliate program, including affiliate setup, links/codes, incentives, campaign communication, and partner activation through platforms such as Superfiliate.
  • Creator pipeline management: Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects, active creators, ambassadors, and affiliates; track status, deliverables, performance, and next steps.
  • Content generation: Drive a consistent flow of creator-led video and UGC by communicating briefs, following up on deliverables, and helping creators develop strong, brand-aligned content.
  • Product launches: Support creator seeding for new product launches, helping generate early content, testimonials, social proof, and affiliate activity.
  • Performance optimization: Track creator- and affiliate-level performance, identify top-performing partners and content, and recommend opportunities to increase activation, revenue, and efficiency.
  • Partner development: Help identify high-potential creators who can progress from product seeding/community participation into ambassador and higher-performing affiliate relationships.
  • Content insights: Identify recurring high-performing hooks, formats, messaging, and creator profiles and share actionable learnings with the broader marketing team.
  • Compliance: Ensure creator content follows established brand, claims, sourcing, and disclosure guidelines.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role would be measured against a focused set of outcomes, including:

  • Growth in the number of active, revenue-generating social affiliates
  • Increased affiliate-attributed DTC revenue
  • Consistent recruitment and activation of high-quality creator partners
  • Growth in revenue per active affiliate
  • Increased volume of usable creator video/UGC
  • Strong creator participation in priority product launches
  • Improved speed from creator outreach/seeding to content and first conversion
  • Consistent creator pipeline management and follow-through
  • 100% adherence to brand and compliance guidelines

Requirements

Ideal Background

We’re looking for someone with:

  • 2–5+ years of experience in influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, creator partnerships, social commerce, or a related field
  • Hands-on experience recruiting and managing influencers, creators, ambassadors, and/or affiliates
  • Experience with affiliate or creator-management platforms; Superfiliate experience is a plus
  • Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram/Meta, and emerging creator platforms
  • A performance mindset and comfort working with metrics such as revenue, conversion, CAC, affiliate activation, and content performance
  • Excellent written communication and creator relationship-management skills
  • Strong project management skills and an ability to manage a high volume of outreach and follow-up without losing attention to detail
  • Experience with consumer brands; experience in wellness, beauty, food/beverage, or other regulated categories is a plus
  • An entrepreneurial, test-and-learn approach and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment

Benefits

PERKS & BENEFITS

Join us in helping people be well, more! You will have the opportunity to work with sharp, motivated humans working to make a positive impact on the planet, on people and on the communities we live in. Some of our benefits & perks for full-time employees include:

  • Comprehensive Health Benefits
  • 401K with a generous match 
  • Generous Paid Time Off and Holidays
  • Telemedicine & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) resources
  • Paid Parental Leave (primary & non-primary) 
  • Short-term and Long-term disability 
  • Education, Fitness & BeWell Flex Funds 
  • Rewards & Recognition
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Free Product across all brands! 

The annual base salary range for this position is $60,000 - $75,000 USD/year. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to: location, education, skills, training, and experience. This position may also be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

Senior Director, Performance Marketing Operations – O&O Lead Generation

Visiqua, a Local Hero Company, is scaling our Owned & Operated (O&O) call and lead generation business and is seeking an experienced Senior Director of Performance Marketing Operations, O&O Lead Generation to drive the operational execution of our pay-per-call, pay-per-lead, and CPA marketing programs.

Working closely with the President and COO, you will translate business strategy into scalable execution across our customer acquisition engine. You'll oversee the operational implementation and ongoing performance of multiple acquisition channels, ensuring programs are launched efficiently, measured accurately, continuously optimized, and positioned for profitable growth.

We're seeking a performance marketing professional with deep experience in pay-per-call and pay-per-lead marketing within an Owned & Operated (O&O) environment supporting pay-for-performance customer acquisition programs. The ideal candidate understands how direct-response businesses generate, monetize, optimize, and scale consumer demand while maintaining operational excellence, lead quality, conversion performance, and revenue growth.

As a senior member of the O&O team, you'll help scale the business by driving cross-functional initiatives, building operational processes, and turning strategic priorities into measurable results.

This position is remote (hybrid available if within commuting distance to Boulder, CO) and open to candidates living in the following locations: Colorado, California, Florida, Illinois, Arkansas, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Texas, Utah.

Relocation assistance is not provided. Do not apply if you do not reside in one of the above locations unless you are already planning to relocate at your own expense.

If you're excited by the opportunity to help build and scale a high-growth performance marketing business in an entrepreneurial environment, we'd love to meet you.

A Day in the Life

Operational Leadership

  • Lead and directly manage operational execution across all Owned & Operated pay-for-performance marketing programs.
  • Translate executive priorities into scalable operational plans and measurable business outcomes.
  • Establish operational processes and project manage initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, and execution consistency.
  • Drive cross-functional accountability to ensure initiatives are executed successfully.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement improvements that support continued business growth.

Performance Marketing Operations

  • Oversee execution across outbound dialing, direct mail, digital media, affiliate marketing, and other customer acquisition channels.
  • Ensure programs launch accurately, efficiently, and on schedule.
  • Drive operational excellence across all lead generation initiatives.
  • Partner with leadership to prioritize operational investments and growth opportunities.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Own the operational reporting framework supporting executive decision making.
  • Establish KPIs, dashboards, forecasting, and operational performance reporting.
  • Monitor lead quality, revenue performance, conversion rates, profitability, ROI, and operational efficiency.
  • Translate complex data into actionable recommendations for executive leadership.
  • Drive continuous optimization across acquisition channels through data-driven decision making.

Systems, Tracking & Infrastructure

  • Oversee tracking architecture, attribution, QA processes, and reporting infrastructure.
  • Ensure accurate measurement from traffic source through lead generation, conversion, and revenue.
  • Partner with development and technology teams to improve system capabilities and operational scalability.
  • Champion automation and process improvements that reduce manual work while improving accuracy.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the operational partner to executive leadership across Product, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Sales, and Operations.
  • Lead complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple internal teams and external partners.
  • Ensure organizational alignment around priorities, timelines, and business objectives.
  • Build strong operational discipline across the organization while fostering collaboration and accountability.

Here's What You Need to Get Our Attention

  • 7+ years of progressive performance marketing experience, including significant experience in an Owned & Operated (O&O) lead generation environment supporting pay-for-performance customer acquisition programs.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Finance, or a related field required.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Deep understanding of pay-per-call, pay-per-lead, CPA, affiliate marketing, and direct-response business models.
  • Strong understanding of operational metrics including CPL, RPC, conversion rates, ROI, profitability, customer acquisition costs, and lead quality.
  • Advanced analytical skills with exceptional proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets.

What Will Make Us Call You For Sure

  • Hands-on media experience in one or more digital media platforms (Google, Meta, Tik Tok, etc)
  • Knowledge of AI-powered call center or voice agent programs.

raw.description:
POSITION SUMMARY
The Commercial Property Examiner reviews, evaluates and processes complex commercial insurance claims and makes recommendations for resolution. Additionally, this role will examine and authorize commercial insurance claims investigated by independent adjusters. Lastly, the commercial property examiner will review claim forms and other records to determine insurance coverage, ensuring payment recommendations and settlements have been made correctly.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Manage a caseload of commercial property claims from assignment through resolution.
• Examine commercial claims investigated by independent adjusters to determine the extent of insurance coverage and validity of the claims.
• Review and adjust commercial loss reserves, correspondence, reports, verify coverage and authorize payments submitted by independent adjusters.
• Collaborate with internal personnel and/or legal counsel on claims involving litigation.
• Investigate, evaluate, and adjust claims, applying technical knowledge and human relations skills to promote fair and prompt settlement of claims.
• Oversee independent adjuster files to ensure they have followed CFP IA Guidelines.
• Verify and analyze data used in settling claims to ensure validity and that settlement is in accordance with company practices and procedures.
• Maintain compliance with the Department of Insurance and Company procedures.
• Identify fraud or illegal activity indicators and follow internal processes to refer the claims to the appropriate personnel for follow up.
• Promptly negotiates settlements ensuring the settlement reflects the insured losses while confirming the insurer is protected from invalid claims.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
The Commercial Claims Examiner III role will focus on Claims over $500,000 but may receive smaller claims as needed.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of property claims adjusting experience, including 2+ years commercial property claims preferred.
    • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
    • Working experience with MS-Office (especially Word and Excel).
    • Comprehensive understanding of policy contract/statutes and claims processes.
    • Certified in CEA and Fair Claims Settlement Practices.
    • 4 years Commercial Experience, 2 years claims over $500k
Salary: $46.15-$51.28

raw.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

[FR]

Environnement de travail

Dans le cadre d'un programme de transformation numérique, une administration fédérale modernise ses applications métier, renforce la collaboration entre les équipes et fait évoluer son environnement IT vers un modèle plus intégré et plus agile.

Pour ce rôle de Domain Delivery Lead, vous coordonnez plusieurs équipes agiles autour d'une vision commune, pilotez la livraison d'applications métier stratégiques et soutenez la montée en autonomie, en expertise et en capacité de delivery.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un contexte de changement important, avec des enjeux de structuration, de collaboration transversale et d'amélioration continue. Vous travaillez avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et des parties prenantes variées pour transformer une vision ambitieuse en résultats concrets.

Description des tâches

Au sein du programme, vous intervenez comme chef de projet et Domain Lead. Vous guidez les équipes par l'influence, la clarté de la vision et la confiance, afin de leur permettre de livrer de la valeur au métier.

  • Fédérer plusieurs équipes agiles autour d'objectifs communs et garantir l'alignement entre les priorités métier et celles des équipes.
  • Mettre en place un cadre clair qui favorise l'autonomie, tout en accompagnant la montée en maturité des squads selon les principes du servant leadership.
  • Construire la planification globale avec les équipes, coordonner les dépendances et arbitrer les priorités de manière transparente.
  • Animer les rituels inter-équipes, les revues et les rétrospectives, et encourager le partage des bonnes pratiques.
  • Identifier les obstacles à la delivery et faciliter la collaboration avec les autres équipes, les interlocuteurs métier et l'IT.
  • Accompagner les collaborateurs, encourager le feedback et entretenir une culture de confiance, de transparence et d'amélioration continue.
  • Gérer les demandes de changement en concertation avec les parties prenantes.
  • Assurer un reporting régulier sur l'avancement, avec une vision claire des risques, des difficultés et des arbitrages nécessaires.
  • Escalader à temps les changements ou incidents majeurs qui dépassent les seuils de tolérance définis.
  • Assurer le suivi des fournisseurs en les impliquant comme partenaires de delivery.
  • Prendre en charge le suivi budgétaire et la gestion de capacité.

📝 Votre profil

[FR]

Compétences clés

  • Capacité à traduire des concepts IT complexes en messages clairs et compréhensibles pour le métier.
  • Aptitude à transformer une vision stratégique et des besoins métier en roadmap opérationnelle et en priorités de delivery.
  • Leadership de type servant leadership, avec une forte capacité à guider les équipes sans recourir à l'autorité hiérarchique.
  • Excellente maîtrise du stakeholder management dans un environnement public complexe, avec des intérêts parfois divergents.
  • Bonne connaissance des pratiques de gouvernance IT et de leur application dans des environnements de delivery structurés.

Expérience requise

  • Expérience solide dans une fonction de liaison entre le business et l'IT, par exemple comme Product Owner senior, Business Relationship Manager ou responsable de programme.
  • Expérience confirmée dans la coordination de grandes équipes multidisciplinaires réparties en plusieurs squads ou équipes autonomes.
  • Pratique avérée de la gestion budgétaire, de la capacité et de l'allocation des ressources dans un cadre public.
  • Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire, avec pilotage de plusieurs équipes et gestion de parties prenantes complexes dans des projets de digitalisation.
  • Maîtrise des approches agiles et itératives appliquées aux projets IT, ainsi que du leadership d'équipes projet.
  • Bonne connaissance des méthodologies de gestion de projet, de la gouvernance et des pratiques de delivery.
  • Expérience significative dans des projets IT de grande envergure comportant des dépendances transversales.
  • Expérience en optimisation et réingénierie des processus métier.
  • Compréhension des enjeux de change management dans les transformations organisationnelles et digitales.
  • Connaissance de la gestion du cycle de vie applicatif, de la maintenance et de l'évolution des applications.

Compétences et aptitudes

  • Structurer, planifier et prioriser les activités selon les objectifs stratégiques, les besoins métier et la capacité de delivery.
  • Analyser les risques, les dépendances et les pistes d'amélioration avec rigueur et recul.
  • Coordonner efficacement plusieurs équipes et favoriser une collaboration fluide entre IT, métier et partenaires externes.

Qualités humaines et leadership

  • Influencer et mobiliser sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
  • Adapter sa communication à des interlocuteurs variés, y compris les équipes, la direction et les fournisseurs.
  • Créer un climat de confiance et de sécurité psychologique propice à l'expression et au progrès.
  • Gérer les tensions avec diplomatie et négocier des solutions équilibrées.
  • Adopter une posture de facilitateur et de coach auprès des équipes.
  • Rester résilient, orienté solution et ouvert à l'apprentissage continu.
  • Faire preuve d'intégrité et de transparence dans le pilotage du domaine.

Langues

  • Vous êtes néerlandophone ou francophone, avec une bonne connaissance de l'anglais.

[NL]

Werkomgeving

Binnen een programma voor digitale transformatie moderniseert een federale overheidsomgeving haar bedrijfstoepassingen, versterkt ze de samenwerking tussen teams en bouwt ze verder aan een meer geïntegreerde en agile IT-werking.

Als Domain Delivery Lead brengt u meerdere agile teams samen rond een gedeelde visie, stuurt u de oplevering van strategische bedrijfstoepassingen aan en ondersteunt u de verdere groei in autonomie, expertise en leveringscapaciteit.

De functie situeert zich in een context van ingrijpende verandering, met aandacht voor structuur, samenwerking over teams heen en continue verbetering. U werkt met multidisciplinaire teams en diverse stakeholders om ambities te vertalen naar tastbare resultaten.

Taakomschrijving

Binnen het programma neemt u de rol op van projectleider en Domain Lead. U stuurt via invloed, heldere richting en vertrouwen, zodat teams maximaal waarde kunnen leveren aan de business.

  • Meerdere agile teams verenigen rond gemeenschappelijke doelstellingen en de afstemming bewaken tussen businessprioriteiten en teamprioriteiten.
  • Een duidelijk kader creëren dat autonomie ondersteunt, en squads begeleiden in hun groei naar meer maturiteit volgens de principes van servant leadership.
  • Samen met de teams de globale planning uitwerken, afhankelijkheden coördineren en prioriteiten transparant afwegen.
  • Interteam-rituelen, reviews en retrospectieven faciliteren en kennisdeling tussen teams stimuleren.
  • Belemmeringen voor de delivery detecteren en samenwerking met andere teams, business en IT vlotter maken.
  • Mensen coachen, feedbackcultuur versterken en een omgeving van vertrouwen, transparantie en continue verbetering bevorderen.
  • Wijzigingsaanvragen beheren in overleg met stakeholders.
  • Regelmatig rapporteren over de voortgang, inclusief risico's, knelpunten en nodige beslissingen.
  • Belangrijke wijzigingen of problemen tijdig escaleren wanneer tolerantiedrempels worden overschreden.
  • Leveranciers opvolgen en hen betrekken als volwaardige deliverypartners.
  • Budgetopvolging en capaciteitsbeheer opnemen.

📝 Jouw profiel

[NL]

Kerncompetenties

  • Complexe IT-concepten helder kunnen vertalen naar begrijpelijke businesstaal.
  • Een strategische visie en businessbehoeften kunnen omzetten in een operationele roadmap en duidelijke deliveryprioriteiten.
  • Sterk servant leadership, met het vermogen om teams te begeleiden zonder formele hiërarchische sturing.
  • Uitstekende ervaring in stakeholdermanagement binnen een complexe publieke context, met uiteenlopende belangen.
  • Goede kennis van IT-governancekaders en hun toepassing binnen gestructureerde deliveryomgevingen.

Vereiste ervaring

  • Stevige ervaring in een brugfunctie tussen business en IT, zoals senior Product Owner, Business Relationship Manager of programmadirecteur.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het aansturen van grote multidisciplinaire teams, verdeeld over meerdere autonome teams of squads.
  • Ervaring met budgetbeheer, capaciteitsplanning en resourceallocatie binnen een publieke context.
  • Minstens 10 jaar ervaring in een gelijkaardige functie, met coördinatie van meerdere teams en complex stakeholdermanagement in digitaliseringsprojecten.
  • Grondige beheersing van agile en iteratieve werkmethoden binnen IT-projecten, evenals van projectteamleiderschap.
  • Degelijke kennis van projectmanagementmethodologieën, governance en deliverypraktijken.
  • Aanzienlijke ervaring met grootschalige IT-projecten met transversale afhankelijkheden.
  • Ervaring in procesoptimalisatie en business process reengineering.
  • Inzicht in change management binnen organisatorische en digitale transformaties.
  • Kennis van applicatiebeheer, inclusief lifecycle, onderhoud en evolutie van toepassingen.

Competenties en vaardigheden

  • Activiteiten kunnen structureren, plannen en prioriteren op basis van strategische doelstellingen, businessnoden en deliverycapaciteit.
  • Risico's, afhankelijkheden en verbeterkansen scherp kunnen analyseren.
  • Meerdere teams efficiënt coördineren en samenwerking tussen IT, business en externe partners versterken.

Menselijke kwaliteiten en leiderschap

  • Kunnen beïnvloeden en mobiliseren zonder directe hiërarchische macht.
  • Communicatie aanpassen aan verschillende gesprekspartners, waaronder teams, directie en leveranciers.
  • Een klimaat van vertrouwen en psychologische veiligheid creëren.
  • Spanningen diplomatisch aanpakken en werkbare oplossingen onderhandelen.
  • Een faciliterende en coachende rol opnemen naar teams toe.
  • Onder druk rustig en oplossingsgericht blijven, met openheid voor bijsturing en leren.
  • Handelen met integriteit en transparantie.

Talen

  • U bent Nederlandstalig of Franstalig, met een goede kennis van het Engels.

Technische beschrijving

  • Agile: 5 jaar
  • Projectervaring met complex stakeholdermanagement in een digitaliseringsproject: 10 jaar
  • Leiderschap van projectteams: 10 jaar

Start: zo snel mogelijk, na afloop van de selectieprocedure.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

raw.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Cyber Security Engineer to own and coordinate cybersecurity compliance for an AWS-hosted Army application. This role manages vulnerability findings, security scanning, eMASS records, and RMF/ATO activities while working closely with the ISSO and engineering team. The position requires technical security knowledge and the ability to drive remediation through closure.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Own the cyber compliance backlog, priorities, reporting, and coordination with the ISSO and government security stakeholders.
  • Coordinate security scans, including ACAS, application, dependency, and container scanning; review results and validate findings.
  • Triage CVEs and other vulnerabilities, assess applicability and risk, assign remediation owners, track due dates, and verify closure through rescanning or technical evidence.
  • Maintain eMASS records, RMF artifacts, control evidence, POA&Ms, and continuous monitoring documentation to support ATO attainment and sustainment.
  • Coordinate control evidence, inherited controls, assessment responses, and compliance milestones with the ISSO, engineering team, and platform or image owners.
  • Provide technical guidance on secure configurations, patching, access controls, and vulnerability remediation across Linux, container, and AWS environments.
  • Assess release security impacts, communicate residual risks and blockers, and integrate cyber requirements into agile planning and delivery.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret security clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of cybersecurity engineering or information assurance experience.
  • Hands-on experience with eMASS, RMF, NIST SP 800-53, POA&Ms, and ATO support. Understanding of the STIG assessment process and inherited security controls.
  • Experience coordinating vulnerability scanning, CVE remediation, and compliance activities with an ISSO and technical teams.
  • Technical understanding of Linux, AWS security, containers, and vulnerability assessment tools.
  • Active cybersecurity certification accepted for the assigned DoD 8140 work role and proficiency level.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Army cybersecurity compliance experience, including IL5/IL6 environments and authorization sustainment.
  • Experience with ACAS/Tenable, application or container scanners, and GitLab/Jira.
  • Experience supporting agile teams and communicating cyber risk to technical and government stakeholders.

Travel Requirements

Occasional travel for technical coordination, security assessments, and program milestones.

Through partnerships with frontier AI labs such as Anthropic and OpenAI, and the leading cloud providers, Accenture delivers end-to-end services that drive innovation and business agility.

The Digital Core Reinvention practice builds industry super-ontologies: industry- and ecosystem-specific agentic AI and data engines that encode how a vertical actually operates — its entities, its regulations, its rhythms — so AI systems can reason inside the industry rather than about it.


You Are:

A knowledge engineer with an industry lean — you want your ontologies to encode how a real vertical works, and you're happiest when the graph disagrees with the org chart and turns out to be right.

You belong here even if you haven't spent years in AI. Much of what makes a great practitioner in this work was learned somewhere adjacent — strong credentials in the neighboring discipline plus a year or two of serious hands-on work with LLM-based systems is exactly the profile we grow.


The Work:

At the Manager grade you lead industry digital-brain delivery on a client engagement: discovery and baseline of industry-specific patterns, ontology design and build (Knowledge Graph and Data Taxonomy, in skill terms), and the lifecycle management that keeps an industry engine current.

At the Senior Manager grade you hold authority across engagements in the vertical. We assess that fit at interview, not at requisition.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Company Overview
Our client is a fast-growing, venture-backed SaaS company helping frontline workers access life-changing benefits like childcare, elder care, and nutrition assistance. Their AI-powered platform connects employees to available government programs—cutting through complexity and delivering support where it matters most.

Used by major retailers, healthcare providers, and Fortune 500 companies, the product is trusted to handle sensitive workflows in regulated environments. The fully remote team is mission-driven, pragmatic, and growing quickly, with strong enterprise backing and a clear expansion path.

Your Role

As a Product Manager, you’ll help shape the future of their platform, guiding cross-functional teams across engineering, design, and operations. You’ll own the lifecycle of key features — from discovery to delivery — ensuring their solutions are not only innovative and scalable but also accessible, secure, and compliant with HIPAA and SOC 2 standards.

This is a highly collaborative role that blends product strategy, technical fluency, and user advocacy, supporting initiatives across B2B SaaS domains, white-label experiences, integrations with HRIS/payroll systems, and AI-driven automation features.

You’ll:

  • Product Strategy & Discovery

    - Collaborate with leadership, customers, and partners to refine product vision and strategy across our multi-tenant SaaS platform.
    - Conduct discovery sessions to validate customer needs, market opportunities, and program requirements.
    - Translate high-level business goals into actionable roadmaps that deliver measurable impact.

  • Execution & Delivery

    - Lead the end-to-end software development lifecycle, working closely with engineers, designers, and QA to deliver high-quality features.
    - Break down complex workflows (e.g., eligibility screening, income and employment verification, PDF pre-fill, automated workflows) into clear, prioritized backlogs.
    - Use agile best practices (scrum, kanban) to run sprints, stand-ups, retrospectives, and demos.

  • Stakeholder Communication

    - Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
    - Clearly communicate priorities, trade-offs, and timelines, balancing customer needs with technical feasibility and compliance requirements.
    - Prepare product briefs, release notes, and training materials for internal teams and clients.

  • Continuous Improvement

    - Monitor feature performance and user behavior to inform iteration and optimization.
    - Collaborate with data and engineering teams to integrate insights from analytics and monitoring platforms (e.g., Datadog, Segment, QuickSight).
    - Stay informed on industry trends in SaaS, benefits technology, and regulatory environments to guide innovation.

You Bring:

  • 4+ years of experience in product management for SaaS platforms or B2B/B2C applications, including experience building or managing AI-powered or AI-integrated products.

  • Proven track record of delivering complex products, ideally in multi-tenant, API-driven, or compliance-sensitive environments.

  • Experience delivering AI/GenAI features end-to-end, including products leveraging LLMs, document processing, intelligent automation, or conversational interfaces.

  • Working knowledge of LLM capabilities and tradeoffs (accuracy, latency, cost, reliability), and experience defining requirements, evaluation metrics, and iteration strategies for AI-driven features.

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineering and data teams to integrate model APIs and AI services into production systems.

  • Strong collaboration skills with engineering, design, and operations teams; ability to lead discussions across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience with agile/lean product development processes.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures (AWS), APIs, and data integrations (HRIS, payroll, third-party APIs), and automation workflows.

  • Excellent organizational, communication, and time management skills.

  • Experience in early-stage growth startup environments is preferred.

  • Background in engineering, computer science, data science, machine learning, or analytics is a strong bonus.

What’s Offered

  • Fully remote, async-friendly work with flexible hours

  • Competitive hourly USD rate, flexible based on experience and fit

  • A focused, collaborative team that values speed, clarity, and mission impact

  • Growth potential in a fast-scaling SaaS company with a strong emphasis on innovation, security, and customer success.

  • Opportunity to work at the intersection of technology and social impact, building tools that improve access to critical benefits.

Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
    • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
    • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Director of Business Development

The Director of Business Development is responsible for driving sales growth across an assigned geographic territory. This role blends strategic account farming with targeted hunting activities—balancing proactive expansion of existing accounts with the pursuit of new opportunities. By developing tailored engagement plans, building trusted relationships, and orchestrating multi-functional solution development, the Director of BD drives both immediate impact and develops long-term value. Leveraging data-driven insights, this leader prioritizes time and resources to maximize territory performance and elevate Syneos Health’s presence within the biopharmaceutical industry.

Responsibilities

·Develops and executes a comprehensive sales strategy for a defined book of business and geographic territory, balancing new client acquisition with growth of existing accounts.

·Manages an optimized territory through data-informed prioritization of time, client opportunity, and market potential.

·Identifies, engages, and nurtures key client relationships with decision-makers, influencers, and stakeholders at all levels.

·Leads the orchestration of tailored, multi-touchpoint sales strategies based on client needs, pipeline dynamics, and strategic goals.

·Drives expansion playbooks, including therapeutically aligned strategies, renewal opportunities and next-phase conversions, to deepen account value.

·Collaborates closely with cross-functional teams—including operations, therapeutic strategy, deal strategy, and delivery —to co-develop solutions that address client-specific challenges.

·Acts as a client champion internally by sharing insights on client culture, preferences, and strategic priorities to enable effective team alignment and proposal development.

·Educates clients on Syneos Health’s differentiated value proposition, clinical and commercial capabilities, and evolving service offerings.

·Conducts regular territory performance reviews, forecasts pipeline progression, and adjusts plans based on shifting client and market needs.

·Maintains up-to-date records of client activity, pipeline, and sales progress within CRM platforms such as Salesforce.

·Stays current on industry trends, competitor developments, and emerging client needs to continuously refine engagement strategies.

·Represents Syneos Health at client meetings, industry conferences, and other relevant events to build brand presence and uncover new opportunities.

Requirements

·Related experience including business development experience within the industry with preferrable experience in the Clinical Trials industry.

·Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or biopharma in a business development, commercial, or strategic sales role.

·Proven success managing complex B2B sales cycles and navigating mid- to executive-level client relationships.

·Strong consultative selling skills with a demonstrated ability to uncover client needs and co-create impactful solutions.

·Excellent interpersonal, influencing, and negotiation abilities with a collaborative leadership style.

·Highly organized with the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

·Data-driven decision maker with strong business acumen and strategic thinking capability.

·Proficient in Salesforce or similar CRM platforms; Microsoft Office Suite experience required.

·Ability to travel up to 40% for client meetings, conferences, and internal events.

At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING

Join the Kingdom of Saudia Arabia (KSA) Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Intelligence (C4I) Modernization Team and be a critical contributor on the first-phase design team helping to shape the project’s overarching modernization initiatives.

The team’s primary focus during the design stage is to shape the functional architecture and system capabilities that will rapidly modernize the customer’s product line. Day-to-day activities will include (but are not limited to) requirements governance, architecture definition, system documentation, CONOPs development, and integration guidance/planning. This is an opportunity to help design and develop the updated baseline while working directly with an international customer.

THE WORK

The KSA C4I Team is seeking a systems engineer to join our development team. In this role, you will:

  • Decompose customer requirements and use cases into system capabilities and functions
  • Perform requirements tracing to ensure that the necessary system and subsystems are developed in accordance with customer requirements/expectations
  • Create/refine MBSE models depicting system architecture and system activity/sequence diagrams
  • Help contribute to various SE CDRL documents, including (but not limited to): SEMP, ICD, SDD’s, TEMP
  • Help refine and develop overall system CONOPs to ensure planned modernization capabilities continue to meet the overall mission needs

PLEASE NOTE

  • This position may require travel to customer sites throughout the KSA.
  • This position may occasionally support off-hours test events, including overnight and weekend activities.

WHO WE ARE

The KSA C4I Modernization Team is a geographically dispersed project team that will operate in an Agile Scrum environment. Team members have the opportunity to work directly with an international customer and gain exposure to the technologies and processes supporting this upgrade.

Come be a part of a rapidly developing, fast-paced project team that is empowered to quickly develop and iterate potential design upgrades, with a condensed feedback loop that allows for quick iterations on proposed updates. This customer environment is a unique experience for an engineer to put their stamp on drafting new system functionality with a very engaged customer in an accelerated design cycle. If the thought rapidly performing various design activities and growing your knowledge on the numerous types of systems engineering artifacts that are developed and delivered as part of design stage of a modernization upgrade project is exciting, then the KSA C4I Team is the place to be!

This team/position is contingent upon contract award.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience in MBSE (Cameo, Rhapsody)
  • Experience with Requirements Decomposition and Traceability (DOORS, Jama)
  • Experience with Use Case and CONOPs Definition/Decomposition
  • Experience across the various activities in the Systems Engineering V-Diagram
  • Experience Developing CDRL Documentation
  • 4+ years of relevant work experience (Advanced Degree may be substituted for 2 years of experience)

Desired Skills

  • Experience tracing requirements down to subsystem design/implementation details
  • Experience participating in Early system design/maturation activities
  • Previous C2 Domain Experience
  • Experience in Agile Methodologies & Tools
  • Previous International Customer Experience
  • Active Secret Clearance

    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $76700.00 - $142500.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

raw.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks four Journeyman Network Engineers to support data-center networking, software-defined networking, enterprise connectivity, infrastructure modernization, and outage restoration for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks four Journeyman Network Engineers to support data-center networking, software-defined networking, enterprise connectivity, infrastructure modernization, and outage restoration for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Network Engineers will provide hands-on technical support for Cisco Nexus and Application Centric Infrastructure environments, software-defined networking, top-of-rack switching, and data-center connectivity. These positions will support network installations, technology refreshes, maintenance activities, service outages, and equipment-relocation cutovers.

The Network Engineers will work with senior network engineers, network leadership, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity personnel, Government stakeholders, vendors, and the Outage Response Team to maintain secure, reliable, and resilient network services.

These positions are remote. Travel or on-site support may be required for installations, site surveys, equipment refreshes, outages, or relocation cutovers. Work outside normal business hours may also be required during maintenance windows or mission-critical events.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Network Engineer will:

  • Configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot Cisco Nexus data-center switching environments.
  • Support Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure fabrics and approved policy-based network configurations.
  • Assist with configuration and maintenance of Application Policy Infrastructure Controllers, tenants, virtual routing and forwarding instances, bridge domains, endpoint groups, contracts, and external connectivity.
  • Support software-defined networking configurations across data-center network infrastructure.
  • Install, configure, maintain, refresh, and troubleshoot top-of-rack switches, data-center switches, network appliances, and related connectivity.
  • Support physical and logical connectivity among servers, storage platforms, virtualization environments, appliances, cloud services, and enterprise networks.
  • Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, trunks, port channels, virtual port channels, routing, access controls, and redundant network paths.
  • Support network architecture, integration, implementation, testing, troubleshooting, and performance-analysis activities.
  • Gather and document technical requirements for network installations, data-center connectivity, equipment refreshes, and relocation activities.
  • Assist with development of implementation procedures, migration plans, cutover plans, validation steps, rollback procedures, and outage contingencies.
  • Execute approved network installations, configuration changes, equipment refreshes, and hardware replacements.
  • Support relocation cutovers involving network equipment and associated infrastructure at USMEPCOM and MEPS locations.
  • Perform equipment staging, configuration validation, connectivity testing, implementation, and post-cutover verification.
  • Coordinate with cabling personnel on rack layouts, patching, fiber, copper cabling, network drops, and equipment interconnections.
  • Support site surveys and update physical and logical network diagrams, rack layouts, as-built documentation, and equipment inventories.
  • Test network devices and configurations before installation in production environments.
  • Apply approved firmware, operating-system, vendor, security, and configuration updates to network devices.
  • Configure network devices in accordance with applicable security requirements and DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides.
  • Monitor network availability, utilization, performance, capacity, faults, interfaces, and data-center connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot Layer 2, Layer 3, fabric, switching, routing, latency, packet-loss, and connectivity issues.
  • Support WAN, LAN, circuit, SD-WAN, firewall, VPN, wireless, and cloud-connectivity troubleshooting when issues affect data-center services.
  • Participate in Outage Response Team activities involving network degradation or service outages.
  • Support technical diagnosis, restoration, workarounds, corrective actions, and root-cause analysis.
  • Coordinate technical escalation with senior network engineers, Cisco, DISA, telecommunications providers, equipment vendors, and other external support organizations.
  • Support remote MEPS and other locations with router, circuit, firewall, VPN, ISP, cloud-service, and network-connectivity issues.
  • Follow approved incident, change, configuration, release, and service-transition processes.
  • Maintain network configurations, implementation records, change documentation, test results, troubleshooting procedures, and technical knowledge articles.
  • Identify recurring network issues, performance constraints, configuration problems, and potential points of failure.
  • Escalate complex technical issues, operational risks, and proposed network changes to senior engineering personnel.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Networking, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Between 3 and 7 years of relevant network engineering, network administration, data-center networking, or enterprise infrastructure experience.
  • Current Cisco Certified Network Professional certification.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience supporting Cisco Nexus switches and Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting ACI tenants, VRFs, bridge domains, endpoint groups, contracts, Application Policy Infrastructure Controllers, and external network connectivity.
  • Experience with software-defined networking and policy-based data-center network architectures.
  • Experience configuring top-of-rack switches, virtual port channels, port channels, VLANs, trunks, routing, and redundant network paths.
  • Experience supporting data-center connectivity among compute, storage, virtualization, cloud, security, and network platforms.
  • Experience supporting network installations, hardware refreshes, migrations, maintenance activities, and relocation cutovers.
  • Experience executing method-of-procedure documents, implementation plans, test plans, rollback procedures, and cutover checklists.
  • Experience supporting network-related outages, service restoration, vendor escalation, and root-cause analysis.
  • Knowledge of Cisco routing and switching technologies, including EIGRP, OSPF, BGP, VLAN routing, and Quality of Service.
  • Experience supporting WAN, LAN, SD-WAN, circuits, firewalls, VPNs, wireless infrastructure, load balancers, and cloud connectivity.
  • Experience with network-monitoring, configuration-management, performance-management, and observability platforms.
  • Experience applying DISA STIGs or supporting DoD RMF, ATO, IAVA, CND Directive, and POA&M requirements.
  • Experience maintaining network diagrams, rack layouts, as-built documentation, equipment inventories, and configuration records.
  • Familiarity with structured cabling, patch panels, fiber connectivity, inside-plant infrastructure, and network-drop planning.
  • Additional certifications such as CCNP Data Center, CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Security, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent credentials.
  • ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
  • Experience working in a federal or Department of Defense network environment.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, change-management, and team-collaboration skills.
  • Ability to support travel, after-hours outages, maintenance windows, installations, refreshes, and relocation cutovers when required.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

raw.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Social & Content Marketer to shape how GetResponse shows up on social media. Someone who knows how to build an audience, tell stories people care about and turn creative ideas into measurable results.

This isn’t a role where you simply follow a content calendar or hand everything over to an agency. You’ll own our social channels, drive their growth and use data to understand what resonates with our audience.

You’ll report to the Brand & Content Marketing Lead and help set our social strategy. You’ll have the autonomy to test new ideas and formats, collaborating with our Video & Campaigns Manager and the wider Brand team to bring creative concepts to life.

Social media will be your main focus, taking up around 70% of your time. The remaining 30% will be split between creating content beyond social (15%) and leading cross-functional marketing projects (15%).

About us: GetResponse is a Lifecycle Automation Platform built on 25+ years of email expertise. We help businesses drive revenue through reliable email delivery, behavior-based automation and AI-powered email, SMS and push notifications. Today, we support 350,000+ businesses worldwide, from solo founders to global brands.

Main tasks:

  • own and grow our social presence across global and Polish channels, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube, driving reach, engagement and follower growth
  • plan, create and publish social content day to day, experimenting with formats, storytelling and messaging to engage a professional B2B audience
  • build relationships with our audience through community management and customer advocacy initiatives
  • turn social into a pipeline driver, contributing to demo requests, trial sign-ups and referral traffic
  • run experiments and analyse performance, turning insights into measurable improvements in social media results and business impact
  • create content beyond social media, including blog articles, newsletters, landing pages and campaign assets, collaborating with our content team
  • lead cross-functional marketing projects from brief to execution and reporting

You may be a great fit if you have:

  • 5+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years managing social media for a SaaS, B2B tech or digital brand
  • a track record of growing social channels and delivering measurable results
  • experience connecting social media activity to business outcomes, for example through UTM tracking and HubSpot reporting
  • strong writing skills, backed by a portfolio of longer-form content such as blog articles, newsletters or campaign copy
  • experience leading cross-functional projects from brief to execution and reporting
  • practical experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or HeyGen
  • full professional proficiency in both Polish and English
  • confidence appearing on camera and creating content in both languages
  • the ability to balance creativity with a professional B2B brand tone of voice

Salary range:

  • 10,000 - 14,000 PLN gross/month on a contract of employment

What we offer*:

  • Private medical care for you and your family.
  • Employee referral programme, with rewards of up to 10,000 PLN.
  • Corporate life insurance.
  • Employee pension programme (PPE).
  • Free breakfasts and lunches whenever you work from the office.
  • Commuting support, including free employee parking and a subsidy for monthly public transport tickets.
  • Wellbeing and mental health support, including a mental health helpline and a sports card.
  • Modern equipment, with MacBooks used by most teams.
  • English language classes, webinars, knowledge-sharing sessions and other learning opportunities.

*Some benefits may be available only to employees hired under a contract of employment.

Apply and enjoy our fully remote online recruitment process!

  1. Review stage: We’ll check your resumé/CV to screen for various criteria and match your talents with opportunities.
  2. Teams screening: We’d like to get to know you, and vice versa. Let us know why you want to join our team and why you’d be a great fit with us.
  3. Hiring Manager Interview: Show off your skills! Meet your future manager and see what’s in store for you.
  4. Task challenge: Show off your skills! We'll ask you to complete a brief task. We'll suit it to fit your skills and your calendar.
  5. Team & Leadership Panel: Engage with your potential future teammates and leaders in a dynamic discussion, where you can demonstrate your skills and get a feel for our culture.
  6. Offer: If you have what it takes, accept our offer and - welcome aboard! Join our team and be in great company!

Michalina is the recruiter responsible for this process and will be your main point of contact throughout. Feel free to reach out to her directly :)

About Advocate Health

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

raw.description:
About the role

We are seeking a proactive, technically strong, and collaborative SDETto own and drive quality engineering activities within a dedicated product development track (pod) delivering complex software solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring the ability to independently define and execute a quality strategy, collaborate closely with developers and product stakeholders, and integrate quality practices throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

We are evolving beyond traditional, manual-heavy QA approaches toward AI-assisted, automation-first quality engineering. The ideal candidate is technically curious, adaptable, and excited about leveraging modern tools to improve software quality, accelerate delivery, and reduce repetitive work.

Key responsibilities

  • Own quality within the pod: Lead and coordinate all QA activities for a dedicated development track, ensuring quality is embedded throughout the SDLC rather than treated as a final testing phase.
  • Drive test strategy: Define risk-based testing approaches and appropriate coverage across API, integration, functional, end-to-end, and non-functional testing.
  • Champion test automation: Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using modern frameworks and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work closely with frontend and backend developers, product owners, and other stakeholders to identify risks, clarify requirements, and prevent defects early.
  • Integrate quality into delivery: Ensure automated quality checks are incorporated into CI/CD pipelines and evolve alongside application changes.
  • Provide quality visibility: Communicate risks, coverage gaps, testing outcomes, and release readiness using meaningful, actionable quality signals.
  • Continuously improve: Identify bottlenecks, challenge inefficient processes, and introduce practical improvements that increase delivery speed without compromising quality.
  • Lead by example: Promote shared ownership of quality, mentor team members when needed, and foster a collaborative, learning-oriented engineering culture.

Required qualifications

  • Proven ability to independently lead QA activities for a development team delivering complex software applications
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, integrations, and modern SDLC practices
  • Practical programming experience in at least one language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools or demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to adopt them
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and technical troubleshooting skills

raw.excerpt: Stay Organized.  Keep Compliance Moving. Compliance has a lot of moving pieces.
raw.description:
Stay Organized. Keep Compliance Moving.

Compliance has a lot of moving pieces.

Sometimes it's coordinating a vendor review.

Sometimes it's researching a regulatory question.

Sometimes another department needs help understanding what a requirement means for them.

As our Compliance Administrator, you'll help connect those pieces. You'll research compliance issues, coordinate vendor management and business continuity activities, maintain important systems and documentation, and help teams across the credit union navigate regulatory requirements.

Some people track the details. Others dig deeper to understand what those details mean.

What You'll Be Supporting

This role includes the coordination and administrative responsibilities you'd expect in compliance, but your impact goes beyond those responsibilities. You'll:

  • Coordinate vendor due diligence reviews and risk assessments, working directly with decision makers across the credit union.

  • Support business continuity through department reviews, annual testing, training, meetings, and documentation.

  • Review disclosures and agreements, research potential compliance issues, and help determine how regulations apply.

  • Turn regulatory information into clear, useful guidance for departments across the organization.

  • Maintain compliance, vendor management, and business continuity systems, records, policies, procedures, and user access.

  • Track audit and exam responses and supporting documentation to make sure information is accurate, current, and complete.

Why This Role Matters

This role gives you the opportunity to:

✅ Build deeper knowledge of credit union compliance
✅ Research and work through real regulatory questions
✅ Partner with leaders and teams across the credit union
✅ Support vendor management and business continuity
✅ Grow into managing key responsibilities independently

You won't be doing the same thing every day. You could be reviewing a disclosure, researching a compliance question, coordinating with a vendor decision maker, preparing for business continuity testing, or making sure documentation is ready when it's needed.

That variety is what makes this role matter.

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

You like to read, research, ask questions, and understand the why behind a requirement, not just check a box.

You bring 3-5 years of financial institution experience and a broad understanding of credit union compliance and regulatory requirements. You're organized, comfortable working independently, and able to communicate professionally with people at different levels of the organization.

Most importantly, you have the judgment to work through a problem, make decisions within your scope, and know when you need to bring someone else into the conversation.

Details Have an Impact

A vendor review completed thoroughly. A disclosure reviewed carefully. A regulatory question researched before it becomes a bigger issue.

Those things may happen behind the scenes, but they help the credit union stay prepared and make informed decisions.

The answers aren't always obvious. That's why curiosity, sound judgment, and follow-through matter.

Ready to dig into the details, solve problems, and help keep compliance moving? We'd love to talk.

Our client in the UK is an education provider delivering personalised tutoring and alternative provision to children and young people with special educational needs (SEN). They work with local authorities, schools and private families. The work combines responsive client service with careful coordination of tutors, learners and financial administration.

The opportunity

They are looking for a capable, friendly and highly organised professional to support day-to-day client operations during a colleague’s maternity leave. This is a varied, hands-on position combining accounts administration, client onboarding and first-line enquiries. It is not a conventional sales Account Manager position or a high-volume call- centre role.

Core responsibilities

Accounts, invoicing and administration

  • Oversee the shared accounts inbox; prepare credit requests and handle routine billing questions from families, schools and local authorities.
  • Maintain debtor reports, follow up unpaid balances courteously by email and telephone, and escalate sensitive or unresolved issues to management.
  • Record and check bank and Direct Debit payments, match remittance information and maintain accurate client balances in TutorCruncher and related systems.
  • Support monthly invoicing checks, rate and lesson corrections, purchase-order tracking and the submission of invoices through customer portals.
  • Run the existing daily automated quality assurance (QA) process, review the results and investigate or escalate any issues identified.

Client onboarding and tuition coordination

  • Prepare tutor-proposal communications, add agreed rates and deadlines, and follow up with prospective clients appropriately.
  • Issue registration invoices, track payments, send tutor introductions and coordinate next steps for trial lessons and continuing tuition.
  • Update jobs, client/tutor rates and tracking records; liaise with Client Managers and Education Consultants to ensure an efficient, accurate client journey.

First-line enquiries and wider team support

  • Answer and triage incoming telephone, website live-chat and email enquiries; capture key details, answer straightforward questions and route complex enquiries to the relevant colleague.
  • Provide occasional basic lead-handling or Client Manager cover when colleagues are unavailable, rather than holding a primary client-management portfolio.
  • Maintain accurate Excel-based operational reports and provide other practical administrative support as priorities evolve.

Requirements

Essential

  • Excellent spoken and written English, a warm and professional telephone manner, empathy, tact and confidence communicating with UK families and organisations. The ability to create positive rapport with sincerity.
  • Proven experience in a client-services, accounts administration, billing/receivables or operations-support role; comfortable balancing customer-facing work with detail-heavy administration.
  • Strong attention to detail, ownership of tasks, sound judgement and the ability to prioritise competing deadlines while working remotely.
  • Very good Excel and Microsoft 365 skills, including confidently using and checking structured spreadsheets, exports, filters, formulas and shared records.
  • Comfort handling confidential information and following access-control and safeguarding escalation procedures relevant to a children’s education provider.

Desirable

  • Hands-on experience with Xero, customer/tuition management systems, accounts receivable, Direct Debit administration or invoice portals.
  • Experience with CRM software, shared inboxes, live-chat platforms, Slack and cross-functional workflow coordination.
  • Previous experience serving UK-based customers, education organisations or service businesses.

Working arrangements and onboarding

  • Dedicated full-time resource based in Cape Town, working remotely and covering agreed UK working hours (including telephone and live-chat availability).
  • Target start: 23rd November 2026, ideally allowing a handover before the current employee begins maternity leave at the end of November.
  • The initial requirement is expected to be 9–12 months, with the possibility of an extension or a continuing role as the business grows; no ongoing position is guaranteed.
