About Allia Health Group

Allia Health Group is a fast-growing digital health system revolutionizing metabolic, hormonal, and longevity care. As the parent organization behind Brello Health (women's telehealth and longevity programs), HelloWellness (men's telehealth), Southend Pharmacy (a state-licensed 503A compounding pharmacy), and Zito Care (our healthcare provider network), we deliver seamless, end-to-end care powered by a shared technology and AI platform.

We remove barriers so clinicians can focus on patients and patients can access personalized, proactive care on their own terms — whether through telehealth visits, compounded medications, lab testing, wellness support, and more, all in one connected experience across 35+ states.

Allia is building the future of healthcare by being clinician-first and patient-centered. We are innovative, empathetic, and accessible to our patients, combining cutting-edge tools with human-centered care to make high-quality longevity and wellness solutions affordable and available to more people.

Position Overview

This role supports the day-to-day operation of the company's SOC 2 program, and over time will help build out our ISO 42001 AI Management System (AIMS) and AI governance program.

The immediate priority is keeping SOC 2 controls, evidence, and remediation on track throughout the year, not just ahead of audit season. The analyst will work with IT (including the CTO/CISO and their team), Security, HR, Legal, and other control owners to turn compliance requirements into concrete tasks, keep evidence current, flag gaps early, and keep the organization audit-ready on an ongoing basis.

The role reports to the Chief Compliance Officer, who retains ownership of the compliance program. The analyst operationalizes and maintains technology-related controls alongside IT while providing independent compliance oversight.

Key Responsibilities

SOC 2 & continuous compliance

  • Coordinate evidence collection, validation, and remediation across control owners; follow up on overdue or incomplete items.

  • Maintain audit readiness year-round rather than treating SOC 2 as an annual exercise.

  • Identify control gaps, exceptions, and deficiencies, and coordinate remediation with the responsible team.

  • Support SOC 2 Type 2 audit fieldwork and auditor requests.

  • Escalate overdue or material issues to the CCO and relevant IT/business leadership.

Drata administration

  • Operate and maintain Drata day to day, including API integrations and automated evidence sources.

  • Investigate and remediate failed automated tests and compliance exceptions.

  • Keep evidence complete, accurate, and correctly mapped to controls.

  • Look for ways to automate manual evidence collection and cut recurring effort.

ISO 42001 & AI governance

  • Support building the AIMS: policies, procedures, controls, risk assessments, and supporting documentation.

  • Help build and maintain an inventory of AI systems, applications, and use cases.

  • Coordinate AI risk and impact assessments, control activities, and evidence collection.

  • Work with IT and business stakeholders to put AI governance requirements into practice.

  • Support future ISO 42001 readiness assessments and certification work.

SaaS & vendor governance

  • Maintain the SaaS/technology inventory.

  • Support security and compliance reviews for new and existing vendors (SOC reports, questionnaires, certifications, contract requirements).

  • Track vendor compliance gaps and remediation, and keep related evidence current for SOC 2 and applicable ISO 42001 requirements.

Risk management

  • Maintain the risk register and coordinate periodic updates with risk owners.

  • Support information security, technology, third-party, and AI-related risk assessments.

  • Facilitate quarterly access reviews and track completion and remediation.

  • Escalate material or overdue risks to the CCO and appropriate leadership.

Audit readiness

  • Organize and maintain documentation for SOC 2 and ISO 42001 assessments.

  • Coordinate responses to auditor and assessor requests, and maintain audit trails.

  • Track findings and corrective actions through closure.

Reporting

  • Build monthly compliance and IT dashboards for leadership: MFA coverage, access review completion, onboarding/offboarding SLAs, evidence completion, remediation status, vendor reviews, and trends.

  • Surface upcoming deadlines, overdue items, and risks that need management attention.

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years in compliance, GRC, information security, IT audit, or risk management.

  • Working knowledge of SOC 2 and information security controls.

  • Experience with a GRC/continuous compliance platform (Drata, Vanta, Secureframe, or similar).

  • Experience coordinating evidence collection and remediation across technical and business teams.

  • Familiarity with NIST, ISO 27001, or CIS Controls.

  • Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple stakeholders and deadlines.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

  • Able to work independently, spot gaps, and drive issues to resolution.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting ISO 42001 or another AI management system.

  • Experience with AI governance, AI risk assessments, or emerging technology risk.

  • HIPAA or healthcare compliance experience, ideally in a technology or regulated environment.

  • ISO 27001 or other ISO management-system experience.

  • CISA, CISM, CRISC, Security+, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001 certification or training.

What success looks like

Continuous SOC 2 readiness, evidence and remediation completed on time, clear accountability among control owners, and fewer items requiring manual escalation. Over time, a working foundation for ISO 42001 and AI governance: a documented AI inventory, risks, controls, and ongoing monitoring.

What We Offer:

  • Full benefits package including medical, vision, dental, 401(k) with company match, PTO, Flex days, holidays, and more!

We are committed to cultivating a culture where all team members feel valued & respected. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.

Why This Role, Why Now

Enterprise security buyers and developers now find, evaluate, and choose software across paid, organic, and AI-powered channels, and the teams that win are the ones that can test, learn, and adapt fastest. ReversingLabs is scaling its digital marketing and demand generation programs, and we’re building a modern, AI-enabled growth marketing engine to do it. This role sits right at the center of that effort.

Is This You?

You’re a builder and problem-solver who enjoys turning marketing ideas into measurable results. You’re as comfortable launching a paid campaign, building a nurture sequence, or updating a landing page as you are digging into the data to see what’s working, and you see AI as a way to transform how marketing gets done, not just a shortcut for writing copy.

You’ll help attract, engage, and convert the enterprise cybersecurity buyers and developers who fuel ReversingLabs’ pipeline, while finding smarter, faster ways for the whole team to execute.

At a Glance

Role - Growth Marketing Specialist

Team - Marketing

Location - Remote, USA

Compensation - $108,000 – $118,000 base + commission + equity

Experience - 2 - 4 years

Travel - none

What You’ll Own

  • Paid media & digital campaigns: Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and other platforms in support of demand generation, product launches, content promotion, webinars, events, partner marketing, and account-based marketing (ABM). You’ll own audience research, keywords, targeting, ad copy, landing page alignment, budget pacing, and A/B testing across creative, messaging, audiences, bidding, and conversion paths.
  • Demand generation & email: Build, deploy, and optimize multichannel programs and email campaigns, including newsletters, content promotion, event invitations, lead nurture, lifecycle, and re-engagement workflows, for enterprise security buyers, technical practitioners, and developers. You’ll test subject lines, messaging, and CTAs, and support product-led growth (PLG) programs that drive community adoption, product registrations, and user engagement.
  • Landing pages & conversion optimization: Build and maintain campaign landing pages and lightweight website updates in our CMS, using basic HTML and CSS where needed. Run conversion rate optimization (CRO) experiments on headlines, messaging, forms, and layouts, document hypotheses and results, and make sure every page is mobile-responsive, properly tracked, and aligned with campaign goals.
  • SEO, GEO & discoverability: Apply SEO fundamentals to campaigns, landing pages, and web content, and contribute to generative engine optimization (GEO) so ReversingLabs shows up in both traditional search and AI-generated answers. Use Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and GA4 to spot search trends, content opportunities, and performance gaps.
  • Analytics, reporting & experimentation: Track and report performance across paid media, email, web, and demand generation programs, including CTR, CPC, CPL, conversion rates, qualified leads, and pipeline contribution. Maintain and automate dashboards, support UTM tracking, attribution, and conversion event setup, and turn data into prioritized recommendations judged on lead quality and pipeline, not just volume.
  • AI-enabled workflows & automation: Use generative AI, AI agents, and no-code automation to speed up research, copy and creative iteration, audience analysis, reporting, data preparation, and campaign QA. Build reusable prompts and workflows, validate AI output for accuracy, brand consistency, and compliance with our data security and privacy requirements, and measure the gains in speed, quality, and performance.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Content, Product Marketing, Design, Marketing Operations, web development, and SDR teams to deliver integrated campaigns, resolve tracking issues, and support effective lead routing, qualification, and follow-up.
  • Scaling what works: Document successful AI workflows and automations, share best practices with teammates, and help drive AI adoption across the marketing organization.
  • Other duties as assigned

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • Campaigns across paid media, email, and landing pages launch accurately, on schedule, and with proper tracking, and are executed consistently and efficiently.
  • Digital programs contribute to growth in qualified leads and pipeline, with ongoing optimization and experimentation improving conversion efficiency, lead quality, acquisition costs, and landing page and email performance.
  • Reporting is accurate, timely, and actionable, and your insights lead to meaningful tests and recommendations tied to business outcomes rather than vanity metrics.
  • AI-enabled workflows and automations deliver measurable productivity and quality gains, reduce repetitive work, and are documented so others can reuse them.
  • Demand Generation, Marketing Operations, Content, and Product Marketing count on you for reliable campaign support and efficient execution.

What We're Looking For

Here's what actually matters:

Must Haves

  • 2–4 years of experience in B2B digital marketing, growth marketing, demand generation, or marketing campaign execution.
  • Hands-on experience with paid search and paid social advertising, particularly Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager.
  • Experience executing email campaigns in a marketing automation platform, and creating or modifying landing pages in a website CMS.
  • Working knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, audience segmentation, lead generation, and marketing funnels.
  • Strong analytical skills, comfort with marketing data, spreadsheets, and campaign reporting, and familiarity with GA4, campaign tracking, and performance measurement.
  • Practical experience using AI tools professionally, including writing effective prompts and evaluating AI output for quality and accuracy, with specific examples of how AI improved a workflow, process, or outcome.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail, the ability to manage multiple campaigns at once, and excellent written communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • AI-Forward Mindset: You embrace AI and emerging technologies as part of how you work, using them to improve efficiency, solve problems, and deliver better results. You’re curious, open to new ways of working, and willing to experiment, learn, and help others adopt tools and approaches that make us more effective.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, developer tools, or enterprise technology marketing, especially engaging security professionals, technical enterprise buyers, or software developers.
  • Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, or Salesforce.
  • Experience with Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or similar analytics and SEO tools, plus an understanding of SEO, GEO, CRO, and landing page experimentation.
  • Basic HTML/CSS skills and experience working in a modern CMS.
  • Familiarity with account-based marketing and product-led growth strategies.
  • Experience with ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI platforms for research, content development, automation, and data analysis.
  • Experience building lightweight automations with Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar, and basic scripting or API experience connecting marketing tools.
  • Familiarity with Canva, Figma, or similar tools for lightweight creative development.

About ReversingLabs

ReversingLabs is the leader in software supply chain security, helping the world's most security-conscious organizations detect and respond to threats hidden inside software. Our platform is trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies, and security teams globally. We're a company that takes the work seriously and takes care of the people doing it.

raw.description:
We’re looking for a Junior Data Scientist to join our tech team and help build the future of neuro-contextual advertising at global scale.

Who We Are

At Seedtag, our mission is to transform advertising by proving that effectiveness and user privacy can truly coexist.

As the leading Neuro-Contextual Advertising Company, we combine Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and neuroscience to understand not only what content is about, but how it makes people feel and what they intend to do next.

Our proprietary AI, Liz, enables brands to connect with audiences across the open web and Connected TV without cookies or user tracking. Founded in 2014 by two ex-Googlers, Seedtag has grown to 500+ Seedtaggers in 17 countries, backed by €250M in funding, and operates today as a global ad-tech leader.

If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and building AI-driven systems at scale, you’ll feel right at home here.

Your Challenge

As our Junior Data Scientist, you will join our Insights team to transform contextual, audience, and campaign data into actionable insights for clients and commercial teams, leveraging Liz, Seedtag's AI.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Data Pipelines & Analytics: Build and maintain pipelines to analyse campaign performance, audience behaviour, and contextual data across the open web and CTV.

  • Analytical Models: Develop models for audience profiling, content analysis, campaign comparisons, and pre-campaign planning.

  • Data Products: Turn analyses into scalable data products using tools such as dbt, Trino, and Airflow, ensuring data quality and reliability.

  • AI Agents & Automation: Prototype LLM-based agents and workflows using techniques such as embeddings, classification, clustering, and summarisation.

  • Experimentation & Evaluation: Design and evaluate experiments to ensure automated insights are accurate, reliable, and actionable.

  • Data Quality & Troubleshooting: Investigate data anomalies, identify root causes, and improve pipeline reliability.

  • Data Storytelling: Communicate findings through clear visualisations and actionable recommendations for Product, Sales, and clients.

Our Core Values

Outcome over Output
We measure success by impact and value, not by volume of features or lines of code.

Failure Is Allowed, Learning Is a Must
Experimentation is key to innovation. We test early, iterate often, and learn fast.

We Are All Scouts
We take ownership and leave things better than we found them.

We Are Data-Driven
Data informs our decisions and helps us continuously improve our systems and results.

Tech Stack

You'll work with modern data and AI technologies to build scalable insights products.

Our stack includes:

  • Languages & Libraries: Python, SQL, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn.

  • Data Engineering: dbt, Trino, Airflow.

  • AI & Machine Learning: LLMs, AI agents, embeddings, classification, clustering, NLP.

  • Agent Frameworks: LangGraph, PydanticAI, MCP, OpenAI and Claude Agent SDKs.

  • Cloud & Data Platforms: GCP, BigQuery.

  • Development Tools: Git, unit testing, code review.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 0–2 years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, or Machine Learning, including internships, research, or personal projects.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with a solid understanding of statistics, machine learning, and model evaluation.

  • Hands-on experience building LLM-based agents or agentic workflows, including tool calling, structured outputs, or multi-step processes.

  • Good software engineering practices, including Git, testing, and clean, reproducible code.

  • Strong analytical thinking and data storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders.

About First Advantage

First Advantage (NASDAQ: FA) is a leading provider of global software and data in the HR technology industry. Enabled by proprietary technology and AI, First Advantage’s platforms, data, and APIs power comprehensive employment background screening, identity solutions, and verification services.
Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, we have an internationally distributed workforce of about 10,000 employees spanning 17 countries. First Advantage is seeking a Program Manager to lead and govern multiple, interrelated Salesforce initiatives across business units, clouds, and geographies. This role is responsible for translating enterprise priorities into executable roadmaps, managing dependencies across projects, and ensuring consistent delivery standards, financial discipline, and stakeholder alignment.

The Program Manager operates at both strategic and execution levels, overseeing Salesforce programs that span Sales, Service, Marketing, CPQ, integrations, data, and downstream systems within a highly integrated enterprise ecosystem.

What This Role Owns

  • Define and own the program roadmap, milestones, and success metrics aligned to enterprise business goals.
  • Provide delivery governance across multiple Salesforce projects, releases, and workstreams.
  • Coordinate dependencies across business teams, IT, vendors, and system integrators.
  • Ensure consistent program execution through standard planning, reporting, and risk management practices.
  • Serve as the primary escalation and decision‑making point for Salesforce program‑level issues.

Core Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated program plans covering scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, and resourcing across Salesforce initiatives.
  • Lead program‑level governance, including executive steering committees, status reviews, escalation paths, and decision frameworks.
  • Oversee multiple Salesforce delivery teams (internal and external), ensuring alignment to roadmap, priorities, and architectural guardrails.
  • Manage program financials, including budgeting, forecasting, vendor spend, and benefits tracking.
  • Identify, track, and mitigate program‑level risks, issues, and cross‑project dependencies.

Required Qualifications

raw.title: Global Benefits & Compensation Lead
raw.excerpt: Role OverviewThe Global Benefits & Compensation Lead owns the benefits GoGlobal provides to the people it employs on behalf of clients, worldwide — and the competitive compensation data behind our offers.
raw.description:
Role Overview

The Global Benefits & Compensation Lead owns the benefits GoGlobal provides to the people it employs on behalf of clients, worldwide — and the competitive compensation data behind our offers. Sitting within the HR Services (HRS) product line and reporting to the Global Product Owner, HRS, you make sure that in every country we operate, our employees receive benefits that are competitive, compliant and cost-effective, and that renew on time with no gaps in cover.

This is a hands-on, build-and-run role. You research and source benefits market by market, select and negotiate with brokers, insurers and providers, and run the renewal and renegotiation calendar so cover never lapses and pricing stays sharp. You set the global benefits standards and catalogue, keep every programme compliant with local statutory requirements, and give Revenue and our country teams the competitive compensation and benefits data they need to win and retain business.

You will be based in one of our Regional Delivery Centres — Malaysia, Romania or Colombia — operating as a global function for the HRS product.

Roles & Responsibilities

Benefits sourcing & market research

· Research and benchmark statutory and supplementary benefits — medical/health, life, disability, retirement/pension, leave, wellness and allowances — across the countries we operate in.

· Build and maintain a global benefits catalogue: what we offer, where, at what level and at what cost, aligned to local norms and GoGlobal standards.

· Source competitive, compliant benefit options for new and existing markets, balancing employee experience with cost-to-serve.

Vendor sourcing, negotiation & management

· Select, appoint and manage brokers, insurers and benefits providers in each market; run RFPs where scale or cost justify it.

· Negotiate pricing, terms and service levels, and consolidate vendors where it strengthens cover or reduces cost.

· Own the vendor relationship end to end — performance, escalations and coverage continuity.

Renewals, renegotiation & the benefits calendar

· Own the global renewal and renegotiation calendar; ensure every policy renews on time, compliantly, and with no gap in cover.

· Lead renewals and renegotiations ahead of expiry, challenging premium increases with data and market benchmarks.

· Track policy terms, anniversaries and claims experience to inform each renewal.

Compliance & governance

· Ensure every benefit programme meets local statutory and regulatory requirements in each jurisdiction it serves.

· Keep enrolments, documentation and provider contracts audit-ready; partner with Legal and Compliance on jurisdiction-specific obligations.

· Maintain data protection and confidentiality across all employee and vendor data.

Compensation benchmarking & total reward

· Maintain competitive compensation and total-reward benchmarks to support EoR offers, pricing and retention.

· Advise Revenue, Sales and country teams on market-competitive packages, and act as the benefits subject-matter expert in client and prospect conversations.

· Model the cost of benefit and reward options and their impact on cost-to-serve.

Cost, data & continuous improvement

· Own the benefits cost base; drive efficiency and value through sourcing, consolidation and renegotiation.

· Standardise and, where possible, automate benefits administration and renewals in partnership with Digital Operations.

· Report on coverage, cost, renewals and compliance, and improve the operating model over time.

Key Performance Indicators

· Renewals completed on time, with no lapse in cover.

· Benefits cost-to-serve, and savings achieved through sourcing and renegotiation.

· Coverage and compliance — zero material compliance breaches.

· Competitiveness of benefits and packages (benchmark position), and employee / client satisfaction.

· Vendor performance and coverage continuity.

· Speed and quality of benefits support to Revenue and country teams.

Requirements

Must have

· 6+ years in benefits and/or compensation, including global or multi-country benefits management.

· Hands-on experience sourcing benefits and negotiating with brokers, insurers and providers, and owning renewals and renegotiations.

· Strong working knowledge of statutory and supplementary benefits and local compliance requirements across multiple jurisdictions.

· Commercial and analytical: comfortable with benchmarking, cost modelling and vendor negotiation.

· Organised and deadline-driven, able to run a global renewal calendar without gaps.

· Fluent English, and able to work across time zones from a Regional Delivery Centre (Malaysia, Romania or Colombia).

Nice to have

· Experience in an EoR, PEO, global payroll or global business-services environment.

· A relevant certification — e.g. GRP or CCP (WorldatWork), CEBS or CBP (IFEBP), or GPHR / SHRM.

· Familiarity with global benefits brokers (Mercer, Aon, WTW, Lockton or regional equivalents) and benefits-administration / HRIS platforms.

· Comfort with AI-assisted tools and automation to scale benefits administration.

Benefits

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right.

We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success.

We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like:

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT

We Make Growing Your Career Possible

    • We prioritize organic and sustainable growth. Expanding operations quickly by way of mergers and acquisitions might seem appealing, but the reality is integrating diverse cultures can be challenging. We're proud of our own culture and prefer to grow it our way.
    • We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations
    • English is our official language, but for many, it's our second language. We embrace this and find it rewarding communicating with colleagues from all over the world.
    • We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success.
    • We keep things simple and collaborative. Our structure makes it easy for teams to work together across borders so we can serve our clients with global needs more effectively. Unlike big, siloed companies, we work seamlessly to handle international deals without the headaches of territorial ownership.
    • We believe in transparency and trust. Every month, we share our financials with the team so everyone knows where we stand and what's coming next. It's all about open communication, building trust and empowering every individual to be part of our journey. We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions.
    • We believe flexibility drives success. Our company is built on trust, and that's why we embrace fully remote work, and hybrid options in some countries. Forget rigid office routines - it's old school! This flexibility fuels productivity, strengthens our workforce, and ensures we remain agile in a fast-changing world.

Ready to take the next step in your career with us? Apply now!

**Kindly review the provided privacy notice (LINK) to gain a comprehensive understanding of our policies and practices governing the treatment of your Personal Data. By applying, you consent to background and reference checks, to the extent permissible by law.

CIEE is a nonprofit study abroad and intercultural exchange organization that transforms lives and builds bridges between individuals and nations through study abroad and international exchange experiences that help people develop skills for living in a globally interdependent andmulti-cultural world.

Why work with us:

  • You will change the world. CIEE builds bridges between people, countries, and cultures. We help young people participate in high-quality international exchange and study abroad programs that bring the world together. We change lives; our alumni change the world. Be part of the change!
  • You will receive a competitive total rewards package.CIEE provides all employees with exceptional benefits offerings that increase total compensation by up to 25%. Our top-tier benefits include:
    • Paid time off and Parental leave
    • Gym Reimbursement Program
    • Employee Assistance Program

    • Insurance Coverage (life, travel, medical, dental, and vision)

Additionally, we help international participants from over 140 countries come to the USA each year.  Committed to excellence and solving whatever problem the world throws at them, CIEE professionals work on international teams and are dedicated to advancing our almost 80-year-old mission to make the world a more peaceful place.

Who you are:

As a Summer Work and Travel Coordinator, you will be responsible for supporting the account management and sales activities for the team. The position focuses on providing exceptional customer service by addressing client inquiries, resolving issues related to systems, hiring events, and participant incidents, and delivering training on processes, program rules, and in-country activities. It supports sales activities by performing outreach to prospects to help increase job sales within a region. It provides ongoing support to host employers by helping navigate participant-related issues, mediating conflicts, and offering guidance on best practices. The role also involves recruiting and interviewing participants on behalf of employers, leading and contributing to assigned projects, and collaborating across teams to achieve shared objectives. The position may require both domestic and international travel depending on business needs.

  • Support account management and sales activities for the Summer Work and Travel program.
  • Provide exceptional customer service by responding to client inquiries and resolving issues related to systems, hiring events, and participant incidents.

  • Conduct outreach to prospective employers to support sales efforts and increase job placements within assigned regions.
  • Assist host employers in managing participant-related issues, including conflict mediation and guidance on best practices.
  • Recruit, interview, and place participants on behalf of employer partners.
  • Contribute to assigned projects, ensuring timely completion and alignment with team objectives.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to support program success and operational goals.
  • Travel domestically and internationally as required to support business needs and program activities, as needed.

What you’ll bring:

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • A minimum of 1-3 years of previous customer success or customer service experience required.
  • International study/work experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Computer skills including MS Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Excellent organizational skills with incredible attention to detail.
  • Excellent time management skills.
  • Strong ability to multitask while overseeing daily project management.
  • Energetic and team-oriented.

CIEE believes that professionals with varied backgrounds bring unique approaches and ideas to solving problems and advancing our mission to bring the world together. Qualified candidates from underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

Due to federal regulations and CIEE policies, a background check, reference check, and education and employment verification will be conducted as conditions of employment.

Sr. or Lead BI Developer Overview:

We are seeking an experienced BI Developer to design, develop, implement, and support data solutions that help the business make informed decisions. This position may be filled at the Senior or Lead level, depending on the selected candidate’s experience, technical expertise, and demonstrated leadership.

In this role, you will develop dashboards, reports, data extracts, governed datasets, ETL/ELT processes, data marts, and other BI solutions. You will work with business and technical partners to translate complex requirements into reliable, secure, supportable, and cost-effective data solutions. You will also help maintain development, testing, documentation, change management, data governance, security, and production support standards.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and support BI reports, dashboards, data extracts, governed datasets, and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Support data integration, data mart, reporting, and analytics solutions from source systems through downstream consumption.
  • Translate complex business requirements into technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, and solution designs.
  • Perform complex data analysis to support requirements gathering, metric definitions, source validation, and data-quality reviews.
  • Conduct unit testing and assist with output validation, reconciliation, and business acceptance criteria.
  • Troubleshoot reports, data extracts, ETL/ELT processes, scheduled jobs, and production data solutions.
  • Perform root-cause analysis for data, reporting, and pipeline issues and document resolution steps and preventive actions.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including business rules, data lineage, technical specifications, runbooks, and support procedures.
  • Support testing, user acceptance testing, change management, and release planning.
  • Support data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, access control, and reporting governance expectations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the performance, reliability, efficiency, automation, and supportability of existing solutions.
  • Serve as a senior technical contributor or technical lead for projects, enhancements, and corporate initiatives.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Advanced SQL skills using Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or another leading relational database management system.
  • Advanced experience developing reports and dashboards using tools such as Microsoft Reporting Services, Power BI, Business Objects, or Cognos.
  • Strong experience developing ETL/ELT processes using Microsoft Integration Services or other data integration tools.
  • Experience supporting data extracts, data integrations, data marts, governed datasets, and downstream reporting or analytics.
  • Experience with dimensional data modeling and data warehousing methodologies.
  • Experience designing or maintaining OLAP cubes, semantic layers, or data models.
  • Knowledge of data-quality processes, including validation, exception reporting, reconciliation, and data-quality metrics.
  • Working knowledge of production support practices, including scheduling, orchestration, monitoring, incident triage, root-cause analysis, and operational readiness.
  • Experience preparing technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, business rules, lineage documentation, runbooks, or support procedures.
  • Working knowledge of data governance, metadata, stewardship, reporting governance, access controls, and the secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with both technical and business partners.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Five or more years of related experience in IT, business intelligence, data engineering, data integration, reporting, or analytics delivery.
  • Experience developing and supporting enterprise data solutions in a production environment.
  • Equivalent military experience may also be considered.

raw.description:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

This role is the electrical authority across grid connection works, utility-scale solar PV, BESS and data centre power infrastructure in the US, from development through commissioning and handover. You'll own and deliver electrical design and ensure all systems (generation, storage, demand) are designed, installed, tested and energised safely, compliantly and to US requirements. Strong preference for candidates with substantial HV experience.

Responsibilities

  • Act as electrical SME across grid, solar, BESS and data centre projects; produce and own electrical designs across the portfolio
  • Deliver detailed design across substations, transformers, switchgear, protection and power distribution
  • Develop design packages from concept through detailed design: single-line diagrams, equipment specifications, protection schemes, cable sizing and earthing and bonding
  • Support grid interconnection works (export and demand), ensure compliance with utility interconnection requirements, ISO/RTO processes, NEC and IEEE standards, and validate or produce supporting studies (fault level, load flow, protection coordination, harmonics)
  • Provide electrical input from development through handover; align design intent with procurement and construction and resolve technical queries
  • Support and witness testing, energisation and commissioning; troubleshoot issues and ensure as-builts comply with approved designs
  • Support technical due diligence and lender advisory; act as escalation point for complex issues

Requirements

  • 5–10+ years of electrical engineering experience in power, utilities, renewables, or critical infrastructure; strong preference for substantial HV experience
  • Proven design background, able to produce and own electrical designs, not only review others' work
  • Strong infrastructure delivery experience across utility-scale solar, BESS, or grid-connected assets
  • Deep understanding of electrical systems, substations, protection, and power distribution design (generation and demand)
  • Working knowledge of U.S. grid interconnection standards, including utility interconnection requirements, ISO/RTO processes, the National Electrical Code (NEC), IEEE standards, and applicable state and local regulations, with the ability to interpret electrical studies.
  • Commissioning, testing, and energisation experience on HV infrastructure in the context
  • Critical eye for reviewing consultant and subcontractor designs; strong grasp of safety frameworks including the Electricity Safety Act, state-based electrical licensing requirements, and relevant codes of practice

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
  • Biannual bonus scheme
  • Fully expensed tech to match your needs
  • Private health insurance
  • Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

As we hire globally, benefits vary by location.

Who is RTS:

Recycle Track Systems (RTS) was developed with a desire to do better. We are committed to evolving and challenging the waste industry to be better stewards of the environment. We utilize technology, data analytics, sustainability expertise, and operational excellence to help people and businesses incorporate sustainability into their daily routines. Our passion for sustainability and innovation allows for us to guide businesses to a future of reaching a goal of zero waste.

Our technology platform utilizes sensors, GPS tracking, and highly engaged partner haulers to provide waste management and recycling services and track materials from their source to recycling and composting facilities. Our sustainability experts analyze the data generated by the platform to help our customers make tangible improvements to their waste management and recycling efforts. Ultimately, we are innovating to treat waste as a component material for other products in the circular economy so that as little as possible is deposited into landfills or incinerators.

What we need:

As an Accounts Receivable Specialist at RTS, you’ll be an essential part of our Finance team, with a primary focus on invoice creation, account reconciliations, and cash applications. You’ll work closely with internal teams and customers alike, to ensure timely and accurate billing as well as resolve past-due balances and ensure accurate and timely application of payments.

This is a remote position.

What People say about You:

You have a strong accounting or billing background with experience across multiple accounting functions. You're known for your attention to detail, clear communication, and a proactive, problem-solving mindset. You’re someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, manages multiple priorities with ease, and brings a collaborative spirit to every task.

What you will be doing:

  • Own client invoicing lifecycle from start to finish
  • Prepare and process customer invoices for contract and on-demand clients
  • Manage customer portal submissions and updates
  • Coordinate with internal teams to address invoicing and account concerns
  • Review customer contracts for billing accuracy and completeness
  • Track and report on AR metrics, including aging and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)
  • Contribute to ad-hoc accounting and finance projects
  • Support continuous improvement of AR policies and procedures
  • Post journal entries and ensure accurate recording of transactions
  • Apply customer payments accurately and in a timely manner
  • Reconcile daily payment activity, settlement batches, and bank deposits
  • Perform general ledger and customer account reconciliations
  • Maintain and update customer records and billing data
  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies and open items
  • Respond to customer inquiries and follow up on outstanding issues
  • Initiate collections on past-due accounts and negotiate payment solutions

 

Is this you?

“Must Have” Skills/Experience:

  • 2+ years of experience in Accounts Receivable or Accounting, with a focus on collections
  • Moderate to advanced level of experience with Microsoft Excel and Outlook
  • Data Analysis proficiency
  • Familiarity with ERP or Accounting Systems
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills
  • Detail-oriented and able to meet tight deadlines
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment
  • Capable of working independently with minimal supervision

“Nice to Have” Skills/Experience:

  • Post-secondary degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • Waste industry experience/knowledge
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365.

Why join RTS:

At RTS, each eligible employee receives a competitive total compensation package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, and Short-Term Disability. Our employees also receive Paid Vacation, Holidays, and Personal Days. Please note that benefits may vary by job and offer. Additional Educational opportunities and training may be available at the approval of management.

We believe the recruiting process is a two-way street, this isn’t just about us getting to know you. We encourage you to ask questions about the company, work culture and the role. As you interview with RTS, we hope the growth and challenge excites you.

  1. You will chat with our talent acquisition team.
  2. Meet with the hiring manager and potential team.
  3. Meet with one of our leaders and learn more about your career at RTS.

raw.description:
Career Category

Corporate Services

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Project Management, Senior Associate

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will coordinate scientific data and support key business functions. The successful candidate will organize and quality-check data for sharing, coordinate cross-functional work, and improve manual processes in partnership with scientists, data management resources, and business and functional teams. The role requires sound judgment, reliable follow-through, and the ability to identify when decisions or approvals need to be escalated.

This is a remote role, reporting directly to the Strategic Planning and Operations Sr. Manager, TSRS. Occasional travel (up to 20% of the time) could be required.

Responsibilities:

· Compile scientific data into approved tools, templates or formats for sharing; check records for completeness, consistency, and alignment with agreed requirements.

· Manage requests for scientific data by working with scientists and data owners to identify systems and tools to streamline data procurement from enterprise-wide source locations.

· Coordinate approved exchanges of data with internal and external partners, confirming that required content, approvals, and transfer steps are complete and escalating questions about data selection, permissions, or release decisions to the appropriate owners.

· Coordinate activities for internal initiatives and extramural memberships, including scheduling meetings, preparing agendas and follow-up notes, and tracking actions through completion.

· Build business information tools by gathering user needs, documenting process and system requirements, coordinating prioritization, participating in testing, and helping prepare instructions or training for new tools.

· Identify repetitive or manual workflows that may be improved through modernization or automation.

· Maintain visibility to financial trackers, monitor commitments and actual spending, and flag discrepancies or forecast variances for management review.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The organized professional we seek is a collaborative partner with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Master’s degree

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 2 years of project coordination, technical operations, or process administration experience, in Life Sciences

OR

Associate’s degree and 6 years of project coordination, technical operations, or process administration experience, in Life Sciences

OR

High school diploma / GED and 8 years of project coordination, technical operations, or process administration experience, in Life Sciences

Preferred Qualifications:

· Ability to build effective working relationships and collaborate across scientific, operational, and cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment.

· Experience managing scientific data in technical environments, preferably supporting nonclinical drug discovery or development, including data coordination, and understanding how scientific data is generated, stored, tracked, and used within pharmaceutical or life sciences organizations.

· Experience in process improvement, integrating workflow automation and AI-enabled agents.

· Sound judgment, problem-solving skills, and the ability to prioritize competing tasks, resolve straightforward issues, and recognize when to seek input or escalate.

· Continuous-improvement mindset and the ability to identify practical process improvements and support implementation.

· Experience with SharePoint, Microsoft Office and visualization/graphing tools.

Our Mission

We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Hear from our team about what it’s like working at Capital One UK.

About the Role

Velocity Black, the leading luxury concierge recently acquired by Capital One, harnesses the power of technology, the warmth of human experts, and the convenience of cutting edge apps to help high-performance people actualize the full potential of their lives. From access to the hottest restaurants to guaranteed upgrades at the world’s finest resorts, our concierge team is available 24/7/365 via our proprietary app to support our customers and fulfil their requests. It's concierge, reimagined for the digital age.

We are looking for someone passionate about the hospitality industry with strong existing knowledge of what it takes to be the most high-value-add concierge. The ideal candidate will be an energetic, ambitious and determined person who wants to take their career in the customer service and concierge space to the next level.

  • Communicating with clients, restaurants, vendors, and team members to deliver great service across dining, experiences and retail.

  • Liaising with every part of the business to ensure a swift and effective resolution process and effective handling of member issues

  • Communication with members, giving them a demonstration of the product interface and an overview of the membership

  • Completing end-to-end member requests

The skills and experience you need

  • Proven experience in luxury concierge or hospitality

  • Adaptability and multitasking

  • ‘Yes first’ mentality

  • General knowledge of high end experiences, luxury goods, and restaurants

  • Experience working with high net worth individuals and clients

  • Entrepreneurial, problem-solving attitude

  • Excellent, clear and effective verbal and written communication skills

  • Experience in a collaborative and transparent environment

  • Ability to work in high-pressure environment with tight deadlines

  • Flexible working hours - available to work on evenings and weekends

Where and how you'll work

This is a permanent, remote position. Please note, to be eligible to apply to this role, you must reside in the UK.

What’s in it for you

We invest in the growth of our people alongside our business. You will have extensive opportunities to learn and develop your career, including access to up to £5,000 in funding for external qualifications.

In addition to career development, our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:

  • Wealth & Future: Competitive pension and performance-based bonus schemes

  • Holidays: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with tenure. Need more? You have the option to buy 5 additional days.

  • Health: Access premium care through our private medical insurance.

  • Family Support: We champion your milestones with enhanced parental leave.

A full list of our benefits is availablehere.

We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. That’s why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible.

We value diversity, inclusion and belonging at our core. We empower our associates to do great work by creating an inclusive culture—one that values diverse perspectives, fosters collaboration and encourages innovative ideas—and a place where associates of all backgrounds can thrive by bringing their most authentic selves to work. We call this our Culture of Belonging, and it rests at the heart of our business.

Our associate-led Business Resource Groups were created to help support our diverse population and include over 10 groups across our offices. Because each Business Resource Group is as unique as the population it serves, they offer a range of activities, networking opportunities, special events and learning programmes to associates.

Capital One is committed to diversity in the workplace.

The Summer 2027 Applied Gen AI/Data Scientist Graduate Internship offers an exciting opportunity for graduate students to work at the forefront of Artificial Intelligence innovation within healthcare. This internship is designed for highly motivated individuals who are passionate about applying Generative AI (GenAI), Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and emerging AI technologies to solve real-world healthcare challenges and improve experiences for members, clinicians, and business stakeholders.


As a member of the AI Services and Platforms Research & Development Team, the intern will contribute to the design, development, and evaluation of innovative Generative AI solutions that support healthcare operations, member engagement, clinical workflows, and enterprise productivity. Working alongside experienced AI researchers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and software developers, the intern will gain hands-on experience developing and prototyping cutting-edge AI applications while exploring novel use cases that advance Highmark's digital transformation and innovation objectives.

The program provides practical exposure to the full lifecycle of applied AI development, including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, orchestration frameworks, experimentation, model evaluation, and solution delivery. Participants will have opportunities to research emerging technologies, collaborate across technical teams, and contribute to high-visibility initiatives that demonstrate the business value of Generative AI in healthcare.


Typical responsibilities include developing GenAI-powered applications and prototypes, evaluating and optimizing LLM outputs, researching advanced AI techniques, designing and validating healthcare-focused AI use cases, collaborating with engineering and analytics teams, conducting experiments, documenting findings, and presenting recommendations and demonstrations to technical and business audiences. Through mentorship, innovation-focused projects, and applied research, interns will strengthen their technical expertise while gaining exposure to enterprise AI strategy and healthcare innovation.

This job has the goal of providing the opportunity to acquire practical experience through direct exposure to the related business line(s) and to develop the next generation of diverse business professionals. To that end, the program will provide hands-on training and experience in the business line, expose the various career opportunities in the business line and related areas, and prepare participants for positions in the business.

3. Undertake and/or participate in projects and programs designed to develop professional skills and expertise appropriate to the needs of the organization.

6. Undertake related studies or enrichment programs as appropriate to the specific objectives of the operating unit.

raw.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Finalité du rôle

Le Senior Program Test Lead est responsable de l’orchestration opérationnelle de l’ensemble des tests du programme. Il traduit la stratégie qualité et le Quality Framework définis par le Quality Assurance Manager en un dispositif de test cohérent, intégré et piloté par les risques.

Il coordonne et consolide les activités de test menées par les différents workstreams, les équipes métier et IT, ainsi que les fournisseurs impliqués. Il apporte une vision End-to-End factuelle de la qualité, des défauts, des risques et de la release readiness, afin de soutenir les décisions de gouvernance et les Go/No-Go.

Positionnement et articulation avec le Quality Assurance Manager

  • Le Quality Assurance Manager définit la stratégie qualité, le Quality Framework, les quality gates, la gouvernance et l’évaluation indépendante de la qualité du programme.
  • Le Senior Program Test Lead met cette stratégie en œuvre au niveau opérationnel, pilote les campagnes de test et assure la coordination quotidienne et transverse de l’ensemble des activités de test.

Principales responsabilités

1. Orchestration et planification des tests du programme

  • Élaborer, avec le Quality Assurance Manager, le plan de test global du programme et le décliner en plans opérationnels intégrés.
  • Orchestrer les activités de test réalisées par les différents workstreams, les équipes internes et les fournisseurs.
  • Établir et maintenir un planning consolidé des campagnes de test, des dépendances, des environnements, des jeux de données et des ressources.
  • Coordonner les séquences de System Testing, SIT, End-to-End Testing, UAT, régression et tests non fonctionnels.
  • Anticiper les conflits de capacité, les dépendances critiques et les impacts inter-domaines, puis proposer les arbitrages nécessaires.

2. Pilotage par les risques et couverture End-to-End

  • Placer le Risk-Based Testing au centre de la planification, de la priorisation et de l’intensité des tests.
  • Évaluer les risques métiers, opérationnels, techniques et réglementaires afin de définir les priorités de test.
  • Garantir la traçabilité entre exigences, risques, scénarios, résultats, défauts et éléments de preuve.
  • Maintenir une vision End-to-End de la qualité sur l’ensemble des domaines du programme, y compris les interfaces et les parcours transversaux.
  • Identifier les zones insuffisamment couvertes et recommander des mesures compensatoires ou des tests complémentaires.

3. Coordination méthodologique et consolidation

  • Garantir une approche méthodologique cohérente, des critères communs et un reporting homogène à travers tous les workstreams.
  • Consolider les plans, l’avancement, les résultats, les anomalies, les risques et les preuves de test produits par les différents intervenants.
  • Définir et suivre les indicateurs opérationnels nécessaires à une lecture consolidée de la qualité.
  • S’assurer que les environnements, les données et les prérequis sont disponibles et adaptés aux objectifs de chaque campagne.

4. Coordination des fournisseurs et évaluation des résultats

  • Piloter la coordination des activités de test avec les partenaires externes.
  • Challenger les plans, les résultats, les défauts, les indicateurs et les conclusions présentés par les fournisseurs.
  • Analyser la qualité et la suffisance des éléments de preuve fournis.
  • Évaluer, sur la base des faits disponibles, le niveau de qualité démontré par les tests, documenter les écarts et les risques résiduels, puis en faire rapport au Quality Assurance Manager.

5. Gestion des anomalies, risques et arbitrages

  • Piloter le processus opérationnel de gestion des défauts et organiser les séances de triage multi-équipes.
  • Assurer une classification cohérente de la sévérité, de la priorité et de l’impact des anomalies.
  • Piloter l’arbitrage des priorités de correction et de retest, formuler des recommandations fondées sur les risques et escalader les décisions qui dépassent son mandat.
  • Escalader les risques critiques, les blocages et les écarts de qualité au Quality Assurance Manager et aux instances concernées.

6. Migrations, dry runs et cut-over

  • Planifier et coordonner la validation des migrations de données et de systèmes.
  • Définir et superviser les tests liés aux dry runs, aux répétitions opérationnelles et aux scénarios de cut-over.
  • Vérifier la couverture des critères d’entrée et de sortie, la réconciliation des données, les mécanismes de reprise et les preuves attendues.
  • Consolider les résultats des dry runs et évaluer les risques résiduels avant le cut-over.

7. Release readiness et soutien aux décisions Go/No-Go

  • Évaluer la release readiness sur la base d’indicateurs consolidés, de la couverture obtenue, des défauts ouverts, des risques résiduels et de la qualité des preuves.
  • Préparer une synthèse factuelle de la qualité End-to-End et des conditions nécessaires à la mise en production.
  • Formuler, avec le Quality Assurance Manager, les recommandations Go/No-Go à destination des instances de gouvernance.
  • Assurer le suivi des conditions, dérogations et actions décidées dans le cadre de la release.

8. Reporting et communication

  • Produire un reporting consolidé, régulier et orienté décision sur l’avancement, la couverture, les résultats, les défauts et les risques.
  • Présenter l’état de la qualité et de la release readiness au Program Board, en collaboration avec le Quality Assurance Manager.
  • Rendre visibles les écarts entre le niveau de qualité attendu et le niveau démontré par les tests.

📝 Votre profil

Expérience et expertise

  • Expérience confirmée dans un rôle de Program Test Lead, Senior Test Lead ou Expert Test Coordinator au sein de programmes de transformation complexes, multi-domaines et multi-fournisseurs.
  • Solide maîtrise des méthodologies de test, notamment ISTQB, le Risk-Based Testing ou un cadre équivalent.
  • Expérience approfondie des tests End-to-End, des environnements intégrés, des migrations, des dry runs et de la préparation au cut-over.
  • Excellente maîtrise du test management et des pratiques de pilotage opérationnel des campagnes de test.
  • Maîtrise des outils de gestion des tests et des défauts, en particulier Jira et Xray.
  • Bonne compréhension des processus liés à la distribution, au gaming, au digital, aux paiements et aux opérations.

Leadership et influence

  • Capacité à orchestrer plusieurs équipes et fournisseurs sans lien hiérarchique direct.
  • Aptitude à challenger de manière constructive les résultats et les preuves fournis par les parties prenantes.
  • Excellentes capacités de communication, de synthèse, de négociation et d’arbitrage.
  • Forte orientation vers les résultats, les risques et la prise de décision fondée sur des faits.
  • Capacité à conserver une vision globale tout en maîtrisant les enjeux opérationnels des campagnes de test.

Langues

  • Bonne maîtrise du néerlandais ou du français.
  • Bonne maîtrise de l’anglais.

Principaux livrables

  • Plan de test global du programme et plans opérationnels consolidés.
  • Planning intégré des campagnes, dépendances, environnements, données et ressources.
  • Modèle de priorisation et catalogue de scénarios End-to-End fondés sur le Risk-Based Testing.
  • Tableaux de bord consolidés de couverture, résultats, défauts, risques et qualité des preuves.
  • Référentiel de traçabilité entre exigences, risques, scénarios, résultats et anomalies.
  • Dossiers de preuve consolidés et revues des résultats fournisseurs.
  • Plans et rapports de validation des migrations, dry runs et critères de cut-over.
  • Évaluations de release readiness et recommandations Go/No-Go.
  • Registre consolidé des défauts, risques, décisions, dérogations et actions.

Rôle dans le programme

Le Senior Program Test Lead exerce une responsabilité transverse sur l’orchestration de l’ensemble des tests du programme. Il collabore étroitement avec le Program Manager, le Quality Assurance Manager, les responsables de workstreams, les Business Owners, les responsables UAT, les équipes Architecture, Intégration et Opérations, ainsi que les fournisseurs impliqués.

Sa responsabilité porte sur la cohérence et la consolidation du dispositif de test, indépendamment de l’endroit où les tests sont réalisés. Il fournit la visibilité End-to-End et le niveau de confiance factuel nécessaires aux décisions de gouvernance et à chaque mise en production.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

raw.description:
About the Role

A US-based social services organization is seeking a dedicated HR Generalist to keep its hiring and HR administration running efficiently on a day-to-day basis. This is a high-execution role that spans full-cycle recruitment, onboarding, training coordination, employee engagement, and payroll support. You will work closely with the People and Culture Director, who leads coaching, development, and retention, while you own the operational and administrative engine behind those functions.

The role is based in the Philippines and aligned to Arizona business hours (approximately 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM PHT, Monday through Friday). All communication and candidate-facing work is conducted in English.

Reports to: People and Culture Director

Location: Philippines, work from home

Schedule: Full-time, Monday through Friday, aligned to Arizona business hours (night shift)

Key Responsibilities

Recruitment (End-to-End)

  • Post and update job ads on US job boards; source candidates through job boards, referrals, and online searches
  • Screen applications and conduct initial phone or video screenings
  • Schedule interviews and conduct first-round interviews
  • Keep all candidates informed with follow-up within one business day at each stage of the process
  • Update the applicant tracking system daily and send a weekly hiring report to the People and Culture Director
  • Submit finalist interview notes and resumes for offer approval; prepare offer letters and coordinate background checks

Onboarding and HR Administration

  • Send offer letters and onboarding packets through Gusto (HR and payroll system); collect and track all pre-employment requirements
  • Track background checks, clearances, certifications, and required trainings; send reminders until complete
  • Maintain complete, audit-ready employee records (201 files)
  • Schedule 30/60/90-day check-in meetings for the People and Culture Director
  • Prepare welcome emails, system access requests, and first-week schedules for all new hires

Training Coordination

  • Build and publish the training calendar at least 30 days in advance
  • Schedule trainers, virtual meeting links, and sessions; manage registrations and attendance tracking
  • Track completion of required trainings and flag employees who are behind schedule
  • Route last-minute training requests to the People and Culture Director for approval before any changes are made to the calendar

Employee Engagement

  • Coordinate logistics for team events, recognition programs, and incentives, including invitations, online orders, vendors, and timelines
  • Manage the culture plan budget provided before each event; track spending and receipts
  • Send monthly employee engagement surveys and summarize results for leadership review
  • Schedule stay interviews and exit interviews
  • Maintain HR trackers for headcount, open positions, turnover, and training completion

Payroll and Benefits Support (Preparation Only)

This role supports payroll preparation but does not process or approve payroll.

  • Review timesheets in Gusto before each payroll cutoff; send an exceptions list covering missed punches, missing approvals, overtime spikes, and hours that do not match the schedule
  • Remind employees and supervisors to submit and approve timecards before the deadline
  • Check mileage reimbursement logs for completeness and accuracy before approval
  • Maintain a payroll change log each pay period (new hires, terminations, pay rate changes, bonuses) and submit it before each payroll run
  • Track PTO requests and balances; flag scheduling conflicts
  • Maintain the payroll calendar and send reminders; answer basic employee questions and route pay-amount questions to the appropriate contact
  • Collect I-9 documents and track completion deadlines (in-person document review is handled by a US-based representative)
  • Prepare responses to unemployment claim notices for approval before the deadline
  • Send benefits enrollment reminders for new hire and open enrollment periods; track completion
  • Track workers' compensation injury report paperwork and route to the insurance contact
  • Respond to employment verification requests using an approved template

Performance Expectations

  • Interviews scheduled within 2 business days of receiving a qualified application
  • Job offers extended within 21 days for direct-care roles
  • 100% of new hires complete all onboarding requirements before their first day of service
  • Training calendar published 30 days in advance with no unapproved last-minute changes
  • Engagement activities delivered on time and within the approved budget
  • Timecard exceptions list and payroll change log submitted before every payroll cutoff
  • Unemployment claim responses and I-9 tracking completed before their respective deadlines

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Human Resource Management, Business Administration, or a related field
  • At least 2 years of experience as an HR Generalist, Recruiter, or Talent Acquisition Specialist
  • Experience recruiting for US-based companies is required — you will be sourcing, screening, and communicating with US candidates on behalf of a US employer
  • Excellent written and spoken English — you will be the first point of contact for many US-based candidates and employees
  • Highly organized, with strong follow-through and consistent attention to detail
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection, backup power, and a quiet, professional home workspace
  • Willingness to work night shift aligned to Arizona business hours
  • Handles confidential information with full discretion; willing to sign a confidentiality agreement
    •

Preferred

  • Experience recruiting in healthcare, social services, or high-volume BPO environments
  • Familiarity with US timekeeping and payroll concepts, including overtime rules, PTO accrual, and pay periods
  • Experience with Gusto or similar HR and payroll platforms
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and applicant tracking tools

Requirements

This is a full time role

Rate is $6-$7/hr

100% Remote

Career Category
