Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Director Digital Manufacturing Innovation


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will help Amgen strengthen the digital, data, and AI capabilities that support safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing. We are seeking a leader who understands manufacturing, can turn operational needs into practical solutions, and can help sites adopt those solutions across our global network.


The Director, Digital Manufacturing Innovation (DMI), is the global business leader for digital innovation across Amgen Manufacturing. Based in Global Manufacturing Strategies and Technologies (GMST), you will identify the manufacturing opportunities where digital products, data, analytics, and AI can create the greatest value; set and manage the portfolio; and lead work from idea and pilot through supported deployment, adoption, and expansion across the network. You are accountable for ensuring that each priority has a clear product team, business owner, reliable data, an effective solution, and measurable results.

You will lead a global team and work with manufacturing sites, Digital Site Leaders, product owners, Engineering, Process Development, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, Technology, AI and Data, and Amgen India delivery teams. DMI sets portfolio direction, business requirements, readiness expectations, and scale decisions. Product and technology teams own technical design and delivery, while sites own local implementation, adoption, and sustained performance. You will bring these groups together, resolve trade-offs, and give leaders clear recommendations on where to invest, scale, improve, or stop.

Innovation strategy and portfolio leadership

  • Set and maintain the global DMI roadmap, translating Manufacturing priorities into a focused portfolio of digital, data, analytics, AI, and automation opportunities. Prioritize work based on patient and supply impact, safety, quality, business value, data and site readiness, risk, cost, and the potential for reuse across the network.
  • Lead a consistent process from idea intake and discovery through pilot, production, and network expansion. Ensure every initiative has a clear problem statement, business sponsor, accountable owner, resource plan, success measures, and decision points.
  • Provide clear recommendations and escalations to senior Manufacturing leaders. Align with Digital Site Leaders on site roadmaps, identify proven site innovations that can be reused, and evaluate emerging technologies through focused tests before broader investment.

Digital products and connected manufacturing

  • Partner with product owners to define manufacturing needs, expected outcomes, roadmaps, and delivery priorities across connected operations, digital performance management, electronic workflows, workforce tools, production scheduling, and capacity planning.
  • Set clear expectations for testing, release readiness, user experience, support, and lifecycle ownership. Ensure products are practical for operators, reliable, secure, integrated, and supported. Promote shared products and standards across the network while allowing local variation when a clear business need justifies it.


Manufacturing data ownership and readiness

  • Establish clear business ownership and stewardship for priority Manufacturing data. Work with enterprise data and system owners to define common terms, master and reference data needs, data sources, and measurable data quality standards.
  • Assess data readiness early and lead correction of critical gaps before digital or AI solutions advance. Make priority data easy to find, appropriately accessible, compatible across systems, and reusable.
  • Build a network of site data champions and connect source-system stewardship to reliable data products. Resolve gaps in ownership, key performance indicator definitions, data quality, and integration with named owners and clear due dates.


AI and analytics in manufacturing

  • Set priorities for AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, and generative AI in partnership with Manufacturing and the enterprise Technology and AI and Data team. Translate needs in capacity, productivity, readiness, reliability, and knowledge access into clear problem statements, requirements, baselines, and expected outcomes.
  • Focus on practical applications such as daily performance management, monitoring and troubleshooting, equipment health, capacity planning and debottlenecking, knowledge access, and computer vision. Move successful pilots into supported production only when representative testing, data quality, human oversight, monitoring, support, and lifecycle ownership are in place.
  • Work with Quality, Cybersecurity, and Technology teams to apply the right validation, data integrity, access, and change controls. Escalate unresolved risks before launch or expansion.


Deployment adoption and value realization

  • Plan deployment waves with sites and enterprise partners based on business priority, product maturity, and local readiness. Confirm the people, integration work, training, and support needed before committing to a launch date, and raise unresolved ownership or resource conflicts quickly.
  • Require a named site sponsor and business owner, engaged users, and a practical readiness and adoption plan before go-live. Partner with sites on workflow changes, training, launch support, and stabilization, with sites accountable for local implementation, adoption, and sustained results.
  • Measure adoption and business impact separately from the number of deployments or users. Establish baselines and work with sites and Finance to confirm benefits in error and defect prevention, workforce productivity, asset performance, throughput, and capacity. Use the evidence to decide whether to expand, improve, or retire a solution.

People leadership and enterprise partnership

  • Build, lead, and develop a global team of digital product, data, and innovation professionals. Set clear goals and accountability, strengthen product and data skills, and build a strong succession pipeline.
  • Create trusted partnerships across Manufacturing, Engineering, Process Development, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, Technology, AI and Data, and Amgen India. Resolve competing priorities, make trade-offs transparent, and communicate decisions, risks, and progress clearly to senior leaders.


How success will be measured

Success will be measured by whether the DMI portfolio is focused on the most important Manufacturing needs and whether priority capabilities move beyond pilots into reliable, supported use. Measures will include data quality and ownership, site readiness, adoption in daily work, timely portfolio decisions, reuse across the network, and sustained benefits in safety, quality, supply, productivity, asset performance, throughput, and capacity. Benefits and targets will be agreed with sites, Finance, and Manufacturing leadership.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The manufacturing professional we seek is a collaborative leader with these qualifications.

Basic qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of Engineering, Operations, or Digital Technology experience OR
  • Master’s degree and 7 years of Engineering, Operations, or Digital Technology experience OR
  • Doctorate degree and 4 years of Engineering, Operations, or Digital Technology experience

Preferred qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to apply analytical judgment, lead cross-functional teams, build strong working relationships, and translate complex manufacturing and technology issues into clear, executable plans.
  • Experience leading digital, data, or technology transformation across a global biopharmaceutical manufacturing network, with practical knowledge of GxP operations, validation, and data integrity.
  • A record of taking digital products or AI and analytics solutions from concept to supported production and multi-site use, with measurable manufacturing results.
  • Experience establishing business data ownership and stewardship, common definitions, data quality standards, and integration across manufacturing systems and enterprise platforms.
  • Practical experience applying AI, machine learning, generative AI, or predictive analytics to manufacturing, including readiness testing, human oversight, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Demonstrated people leadership, talent development, portfolio management, and coordination of work across global teams and delivery partners.
  • Strong business and financial judgment, change leadership, and continuous improvement skills, with the ability to prioritize limited resources and manage value across a product’s lifecycle.
  • Clear executive communication, negotiation, facilitation, and conflict resolution skills; flexibility to work across regions and time zones and travel as business needs require.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.


The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.


In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

Application deadline

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.

Sponsorship

Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

raw.title: Operations Associate (Hiring or Client Delivery)
raw.excerpt: Grow our AI image service. The roleWe are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency.
raw.description:
Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.
  2. A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.
  3. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed.   3. Strong written English.
  4. Based in Albania.
  5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1500 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

Are you an experienced AI /ML Solution Architect with experience in AWS? If so, here is your chance to utilize your skills on upcoming international projects with our highly qualified engineering team . You will see a lot of ideas move from POC to MVP to production, which means fast iteration and quick feedback on whether something actually works. What we build has to survive contact with real users, real data and real infrastructure.

Requirements

As an AI/ML Solutions Architect you will be part of unique AI/ML Service Line with a specific focus on delivering AI and data solutions across various projects. Furthermore, you will be responsible for technical coordinating a team of 2-3 engineers focused on designing and implementing AI solutions. Our current work centres on agentic automation, LLM-based RAG systems, Agentic systems, vector databases, and integrating AI into our clients' existing application landscapes. You will also work closely with colleagues from our application development and cloud migration service lines, on projects where AI, engineering and cloud come together.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Technically manage a team of 2-3 AI and cloud engineers focused on fast prototyping of AI/ML solutions in AWS cloud.

  • Provide mentoring and technical support to junior and medium teammates.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients.

  • Develop highly scalable services realizing AI/ML functionalities (e.g. LLM, ML and AI models).

  • Design and build agentic systems that plan, call tools and automate real business workflows (Amazon Bedrock AgentCore).

  • Develop LLM-powered applications, including RAG pipelines: chunking, embedding, retrieval strategies, evaluation and iteration.

  • Work with vector databases and search: indexing strategies, hybrid and semantic search, relevance tuning.

  • Integrate AI services with external systems through APIs: REST endpoints, authentication, webhooks, third-party and client-side SaaS platforms.

  • Perform prompt engineering, model selection and systematic evaluation of LLM outputs.

  • Build scalable Python services and the data flows behind them (ingestion, transformation, document preparation), including AI-driven data access such as Text2SQL.

  • Use AWS cloud to implement AI solutions (e.g. Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, Textract).

  • Understanding customers’ business problems and providing technology consulting to identify the best-fit solution

  • Owning the end-to-end solution as a key decision-maker and driving the delivery team

  • Describing infrastructures using Terraform (Terragrunt) or AWS CloudFormation

  • Designing, building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in multiple integration and test environments

  • Staying up-to-date with the AWS innovations and achieving Professional/Specialty level certifications based on personal interest

  • Contributing to AWS Competency and Service Delivery Program to support AWS Partner journey

You are looking for us, if you have:

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

  • Multiple years of experience, including recent hands-on work on AI projects. Software engineering, data engineering and data science backgrounds are all a strong starting point.

  • Experience with some of the following technologies: SageMaker, Bedrock, Glue, MWAA, EMR, RDS, Aurora, S3, OpenSearch, ElasticSearch.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with the GenAI ecosystem (e.g. Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LangChain, LlamaIndex, agent frameworks, LLM provider SDKs, Pydantic).

  • Good command of SQL and a working understanding of core data engineering concepts (ETL, pipelines, data modelling).

  • Proven experience designing, consuming and integrating APIs, and connecting AI services to existing systems.

  • Solid understanding of LLM application concepts: RAG, embeddings, vector databases, tool calling, agent patterns, prompt engineering and evaluation.

  • Working knowledge of AWS, including hands-on use of at least one of its AI/ML or serverless services. Strong cloud-agnostic experience across multiple providers is a plus, but some practical AWS exposure is expected.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

  • AWS Professional/Specialty Certification is a plus

Highlights

AI/ML , AWS , Python , Data , ETL Pipeline , Gen AI , LLM , NLP , Terraform

A market leader and pioneer, Advarra breaks the silos that impede clinical research, aligning patients, sites, sponsors, and CROs in a connected ecosystem to accelerate trials.

Company Culture

Our employees are the heart of Advarra. They are the key to our success and the driving force behind our mission and vision. Our values (Patient-Centric, Ethical, Quality Focused, Collaborative) guide our actions and decisions. Knowing the impact of our work on trial participants and patients, we act with urgency and purpose to advance clinical research so that people can live happier, healthier lives.

At Advarra, we seek to foster an inclusive and collaborative environment where everyone is treated with respect and diverse perspectives are embraced. Treating one another, our clients, and clinical trial participants with empathy and care are key tenets of our culture at Advarra; we are committed to creating a workplace where each employee is not only valued but empowered to thrive and make a meaningful impact.

The Client Executive will be responsible for managing and growing our client relationships, driving revenue growth, ensuring client satisfaction and business/strategic planning. raw.description:
Job Description:

Die Deutsche Oppenheim Family Office AG ist ein Multi Family Office und erbringt Dienstleistungen in der Beratung von Privatpersonen, Unternehmern, Kirchen, Stiftungen sowie institutioneller Investoren auf den verschiedenen Vermögensebenen wie der Gesamtvermögenssteuerung, der klassischen Vermögensverwaltung, der Immobilienberatung sowie des Reportings und Controllings.

Die Rolle des PMO Managers bündelt die Programmsteuerung (PMO) für mehrere parallel laufende strategische Transformationsvorhaben im Bereich Daten, Prozesse und Automatisierung. Ziel ist eine konsistente Steuerung, Berichterstattung sowie ein übergreifendes Meilenstein- und Risikomanagement über die verschiedenen, voneinander abhängigen Programme hinweg.

Tätigkeitsschwerpunkte

Steuerung strategischer Umsetzungsprogramme

  • Operative Programmleitung/PMO für mehrere parallel laufende strategische Programme, in enger Abstimmung mit den jeweiligen fachlichen Verantwortlichen.

  • Strukturierung und Steuerung mehrstufiger Umsetzungspläne, inklusive Priorisierung und Meilensteinlogik.

  • Nachverfolgung von Umsetzungsfristen und aktives Eskalationsmanagement bei Terminrisiken.

  • Abstimmung von Zuständigkeiten und Schnittstellen zwischen den beteiligten Fachbereichen.

  • Schnittstellenmanagement zu relevanten internen und externen Ansprechpartnern.

Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der zentralen Datenbasis

  • Koordination mehrerer Workstreams zur Vereinheitlichung von Mandanten-, Vertrags- und Abrechnungsdaten über CRM-, Reporting- und Abrechnungsprozesse hinweg.

  • Meilenstein- und Fortschrittstracking der Datenprogramme; Vorbereitung von Entscheidungsvorlagen für Vorstand/Aufsichtsrat.

  • Steuerung von Entscheidungen zu Scope-Erweiterungen (z. B. zusätzliche Stammdatendomänen, Governance- und Lebenszyklusfragen).

  • Sicherstellung der inhaltlichen Verzahnung zwischen den Programmen als gemeinsames Fundament der Transformation.

Automatisierung und KI-gestützte Prozessoptimierung

  • Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen der zentralen Datenbasis und Initiativen zur Prozessautomatisierung bzw. KI-gestützten Prozessoptimierung.

  • Nachverfolgung des Reifegradfortschritts von Automatisierungsinitiativen aus PMO-Perspektive; fachliche Leitung liegt bei den jeweiligen Stream-Verantwortlichen.

  • Unterstützung bei der Priorisierung von Anwendungsfällen, die eine belastbare Datengrundlage voraussetzen.

Übergreifende PMO-Aufgaben

  • Konsolidiertes Programm-Reporting für Vorstand und Aufsichtsrat (Statusübersichten, Meilensteine, Risiken, offene Punkte).

  • Abhängigkeits- und Risikomanagement zwischen mehreren parallel laufenden Vorhaben, inkl. Auflösung von Ressourcen- und Terminkonflikten.

  • Pflege einheitlicher Entscheidungsvorlagen und Statusformate im Corporate Design.

  • Unterstützung bei der übergreifenden Priorisierung zwischen verschiedenen Transformationsthemen.

  • Stakeholder-Koordination über Standorte und Fachbereiche hinweg.

Das sollten Sie mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Programm-/PMO-Management, idealerweise im regulierten Finanzdienstleistungs- oder Bankenumfeld.

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung komplexer, mehrstufiger Umsetzungsprogramme; Erfahrung in einem regulierten Konzernumfeld von Vorteil.

  • Grundverständnis von Datenarchitektur-Konzepten sowie von Automatisierungs-/KI-Anwendungen im Wealth-/Family-Office-Kontext.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Vorstands- und Aufsichtsratskommunikation, inkl. Erstellung entscheidungsreifer Unterlagen.

  • Erfahrung in der Begleitung strategischer Transformationsprogramme mit organisatorischen, prozessualen oder technologischen Veränderungen.

  • Hohe Datenaffinität sowie Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Management und Gremien zu entwickeln.

  • konzeptionelle und organisatorische Kompetenz zur Strukturierung komplexer Problemstellungen.

  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität sowie hohe Eigenverantwortung und Umsetzungsorientierung.

  • Sicheres Auftreten und kommunikatives Geschick im Umgang mit unterschiedlichsten Stakeholdern und Interessenlagen.

  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch gut in Wort und Schrift.

Was bieten wir Ihnen

  • Flache Hierarchien und eine enge Zusammenarbeit in kleinen Teams

  • Mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • 30 Urlaubstage, plus 2 freie Bankfeiertage (24.12. und 31.12.), Sonderurlaubstage

  • Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung inklusive Vermögenswirksamer Leistungen

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Benefits wie: Firmenfahrrad-Leasing, Deutschlandticket- Jobticket, Essensgutscheine

Beginn: nächstmöglicher Zeitpunkt

Lokalisation: München alternativ Köln

Vertrag: Vollzeit, unbefristet

Ihre Ansprechpartnerin:

Astrid Erdmenger (HR)

Telefon 089 45691610

Da wir Bewerbung nicht direkt über das Stellenportal der Deutsche Bank AG erhalten können, senden Sie Ihre Bewerbung bitte direkt per E-Mail an

Bei Fragen können Sie sich gerne telefonisch unter 089 45691610 an Frau Astrid Erdmenger wenden.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

raw.description:
TaxTalente ist eine junge Job-Matching Plattform für Jobsuchende und Unternehmen in der Steuerberatung. Unser Anspruch ist es, Bewerbern in der Steuerberatung das Leben zu vereinfachen und ihnen zu ihrem Traumjob zu verhelfen. Auf Basis deiner Wünsche können wir dir deinen passenden Job, aus der Vielzahl von Top-Kanzleien in unserem deutschlandweiten Netzwerk vorschlagen und dir vollumfänglich mit unserer Expertise beratend zur Seite stehen.

Derzeit suchen wir nach einer Steuerfachkraft (Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Bilanzbuchhalter) für eine unserer Partner-Kanzleien in Heiligenberg. Falls du woanders wohnst, ist dies kein Problem, da 100% Homeoffice ebenfalls möglich ist.

Bei Rückfragen kannst du dich gerne jederzeit (auch nach deinem Feierabend) direkt telefonisch an Herrn Becker-Koch über folgende Nummer wenden: 015901431130

Aufgaben

Dein Aufgabenbereich kannst du dir auf Basis deiner persönlichen Präferenzen selbst aussuchen.

  • Erstellung von Finanzbuchhaltungen für Unternehmen unterschiedlicher Größenklassen (optional Lohnbuchhaltung)
  • Vorbereitung und Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Erstellung von betrieblichen und privaten Steuererklärungen
  • Korrespondenz mit Mandanten, Behörden und Ämtern
  • Unterstützung bei Digitalisierungsmaßnahmen
  • Weitere individuell wählbare Tätigkeitsbereiche, die deinen Interessen entsprechen

Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn du dich in den nachfolgenden Punkten wiederfindest.

  • Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
  • Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Du hast genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen du nicht wirklich profitierst? Dann solltest du einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

  • Außerordentliche Vergütung zwischen 52.000€ und 85.000€ / Jahr
  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf 100% Homeoffice
  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
  • Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Fort- und Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen und ein persönlicher Mentor
  • Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient deinen Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an dich, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. Deine Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

  • Du führst keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche mehr, bei denen du während des Bewerbungsprozesses merkst, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor deinem Bewerbungsgespräch all deine mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab.
  • Wir führen deine Gehaltsverhandlungen und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens
  • 100% Anonymität – solange du uns nicht das „Go“ gibst und einem Kennenlernen mit deinem neuen potentiellen Arbeitgeber zustimmst, erfährt niemand von deinem Namen oder deinen bisherigen Arbeitgebern – deine dir wichtigen Kriterien können wir auch zunächst anonym mit unseren Partnerkanzleien klären
  • Attraktive Kanzleien – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.)
  • Und das Beste: Unser gesamter Service ist unverbindlich und völlig kostenfrei für dich

raw.description:
Position: Client Executive
Reports To: SVP Sales
Department: Sales
Location: Remote, Germany
Work Authorisation: Must live in Germany and have the right to work in the EU
Languages: Must Be Fluent In German

BlueVoyant is seeking a Client Executive to join our growing EMEA sales team, focused on driving new business through our co-sell relationships with Microsoft Account Executives and our strategic reseller partners. This fully remote role involves building strong relationships across Microsoft's field sales teams to generate joint pipeline, acquire new customers and grow revenue. You'll work closely with BlueVoyant's sales leadership, marketing and product teams to position our managed security solutions and deliver measurable partnership success.

What You'll Do:
  • Build relationships with Microsoft Account Executives and field sales teams to grow joint revenue and acquire new customers.
  • Amplify BlueVoyant's security co-sell messaging to Microsoft sales leadership and facilitate relationship building between field sales teams.
  • Work with Microsoft Account Executives to develop and close joint pipeline.
  • Leverage existing individual and BlueVoyant relationships to build and execute new go-to-market opportunities.
  • Build measurable business plans to define partnership goals and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with Microsoft stakeholders to drive pipeline and sales success.
  • Partner with BlueVoyant sales leadership and the field to develop joint selling and demand generation activities.
  • Collaborate with BlueVoyant marketing to leverage resources, including collateral, presentations, events, emails and webinars, to support joint initiatives with assigned partners.
  • Prepare and present regular partnership status updates and sales results to executive leaders and programme stakeholders.
  • Proactively generate your own leads with a hunter mentality to build new business opportunities.

What You'll Bring:
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft's business, field sales organisation structure and the Account Executive seller agenda.
  • Recent and relevant experience as a Microsoft seller, or in a partner role co-selling with Microsoft.
  • 4+ years of experience in business development, partnerships or cybersecurity sales, ideally including managed security services.
  • Experience supporting the enablement and growth of channel partner sales teams, helping them articulate and position solution value to increase pipeline and sales.
  • Deep background in security technologies and managed security solutions.
  • A proven track record in sales, partnership growth and relationship building.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present ideas in business-friendly and user-friendly language.
  • Strong presentation skills to support partnership and internal business needs.
  • Strong organisational and time management skills, with demonstrated ownership of tasks and escalation as needed.
  • Ability to collaborate closely with product, marketing and sales teams across the organisation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft tools and Salesforce.
  • Passion and drive for results, and the ability to thrive in a small, fast-paced, product-driven environment.

Nice to Have:
  • Experience with MDR platforms, SIEM, Third-Party Risk and Threat Intelligence solutions.
  • Experience working with Microsoft resellers.
  • Knowledge of Azure Security, particularly Microsoft Sentinel and the Microsoft 365 security suite.
  • A strong interest or background in cybersecurity.

Education:
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Why BlueVoyant?
  • Drive new business growth by building high-impact co-sell relationships with Microsoft Account Executives and strategic resellers across EMEA.
  • Represent industry-leading managed security solutions and award-winning Microsoft Security expertise to customers, with real ownership of your pipeline and results.
  • Join a global, mission-driven cybersecurity company defending organisations worldwide with cutting-edge data, technology, and expertise.
  • Competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, with support for wellbeing, development, and career growth.

About BlueVoyant
BlueVoyant is an AI-driven cybersecurity company dedicated to standing between our customers and cyber threats. By combining human, artificial, and proprietary intelligence, we deliver a unified solution that protects every organisation's network, identities, vendors, and digital footprints as a single attack surface. The company's award-winning Microsoft Security expertise helps organisations maximise their security investments while reducing risk and ensuring compliance.

Led by CEO, John Hernandez, BlueVoyant's highly skilled team includes former government cyber officials with extensive frontline experience in responding to advanced cyber threats on behalf of the National Security Agency, Federal Bureau of Investigation, Unit 8200, and GCHQ, together with private sector experts. BlueVoyant services utilise large real-time datasets with industry leading analytics and technologies.

Founded in 2017 by Fortune 500 executives, including Chairman of the Board, Jim Rosenthal, Vice Chairman, Tom Glocer, and former Government cyber officials, BlueVoyant is headquartered in New York City and has offices in Maryland, Tel Aviv, London, Budapest, and Latin America and is committed to building a workplace where talented people are empowered to do their best work in the fight against global cyber threats.

All applicants must have the right to work in the United Kingdom. BlueVoyant provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation. BlueVoyant complies with the Equality Act 2010 and all other applicable UK employment legislation in every location in which the company has facilities.

Disclaimer: Please note that candidates will be required to provide evidence of their right to work in the country of employment within the European Union prior to commencing employment, in line with applicable immigration and employment laws. Where a role requires government or client security clearance, continued employment on that contract is contingent upon obtaining and maintaining the relevant clearance.

Important Information for Applicants: BlueVoyant uses AI-assisted tools within our applicant tracking system to help identify candidates whose experience and skills best match the requirements of a role. This technology provides hiring teams with added insights to support fair and efficient hiring decisions. All applications are reviewed by a member of our hiring team, and final hiring decisions are made by humans, not AI. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that AI tools may assist in the evaluation of your resume as part of the recruitment process.

Interview Expectations: As part of our interview process, we assess your experience through real-time discussion, so we expect responses to be your own. While we embrace the use of AI within our business and recruitment process, we do not permit its use during interviews. Any suspected use of AI during an interview will be challenged, and this may include the use of detection tools.

BlueVoyant Candidate Privacy Notice: To understand how we secure and manage your personal data upon submitting a job application, please see our Candidate Privacy Notice, which can be found here - Candidate Privacy Notice

raw.description:
This position is responsible for selling CTI clinical trial and regulatory and scientific affairs consulting services, including Phase I-III clinical trials and regulatory consulting services spanning pre-IND to NDA support offerings. As part of this role you will be responsible for identifying, contacting and cultivating new clients and serving as client manager for existing clients. In addition to the duties and responsibilities outlined in the job posting, a successful candidate will be able to demonstrate a record of progressive achievement in current and previous roles within the company, be a strategic thinker, possess resourceful networking skills, and have an unrelenting desire to deliver solutions that meet our clients’ challenges.

What You'll Do

  • Secure and maintain relationships with qualified targets and decision makers within biotech and pharma, uncovering potential sales opportunities and developing effective sales strategies
  • Work with targeted business development accounts to secure future business - explain, offerings and align CTI offerings to meet customer’s needs
  • Work in collaboration with CTI’s proposal team to deliver budgets and proposals, including providing key direction on proposal text and budget scope.
  • Develop and maintain excellent working relationships with key members of CTI’s clinical operational management and proposal/contracting teams
  • Develop and implement specific disease strategies to drive awareness, lead generation and opportunity identification
  • Attend therapeutically focused conferences as a representative of CTI and meet with prospective clients also in attendance
  • Lead and participate in bid defense meetings, including leading the preparations, strategies, and follow-up efforts
  • Lead and participate in capabilities discussions, including leading the presentation, strategies, and follow-up efforts
  • Communicate with existing accounts and internal CTI representatives to ensure needs of accounts are being met
  • Present sales opportunities to management and work with internal departments/team members to close complex sales
  • Continuously monitor and update status of leads to ensure pipeline is maintained
  • Communicate all account activity to sales leaders/CTI executives and maintain updates in CTI’s CRM system
  • Manage sales departmental metrics

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, marketing or physical/life science
  • Sales experience (including account profiling, relationship development, needs assessment and account closing)
  • 5+ years in pharmaceutical, clinical or related experience

Why CTI?

  • Advance Your Career – We invest in your professional growth. Through a structured mentoring program, leadership development courses, and access to ongoing education and training opportunities, including tuition reimbursement, you’ll have the tools to achieve your goals. Our dedicated training department supports your successful career at CTI.
  • Be Part of an Award-Winning Team – Join a global team spanning 60 countries, recognized for its award-winning culture that prioritizes people. We support your work-life balance with generous health benefits, vacation packages, hybrid work opportunities, and paid parental leave. Through our CTI Cares program, you’ll have opportunities to give back to your community and the world.
  • Make a Lasting Impact – At CTI, your work directly contributes to advancing medicine. You’ll play a vital role in developing life-changing treatments for patients with chronic and critical illnesses. Together, we move medicine forward, making a difference for those who need it most

Important Note

In light of recent increase in hiring scams, if you're selected to move onto the next phase of our hiring process, a member of our team will reach out to you directly from an @ctifacts.com email address to guide you through our interview process. Please ensure you are applying for jobs directly on our website () or from our verified LinkedIn page.

Please Note

  • We will never communicate with you via Microsoft Teams or text message
  • We will never ask for your bank account information at any point during the recruitment process

Acting as the main link between business stakeholders and the delivery team, document as-is and to-do states, process diagramming, translate business needs into requirements, well defined stories and a backlog, ensuring solutions align with customer needs, business objectives, and quality standards within an Agile environment.

Requirements:

Experience & Knowledge

  • Minimum 4 years in BA/PrM role or similar position in Agile environment

  • Experience in production/manufacturing domain (preferably in Chemistry or Food Industry) - MUST HAVE

  • Proven experience delivering complex IT/software products and projects

  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and the full product development lifecycle

  • Experience working with cross-functional and distributed teams

  • Ability to balance business priorities, technical constraints, and user needs

  • Experience collaborating with many stakeholders

Skills

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities

  • Ability to clearly define and communicate product requirements and decisions

  • Strong prioritization, organizational, and self-management skills

  • Ability to create realistic estimates and balance sprint scope with team velocity

  • Ability to keep track of sprint progress

  • Focus on execution, delivery, and cross-functional coordination

OVERVIEW

We are recruiting on behalf of our client for an Air Freight Coordinator. Our client is a US-based freight forwarder seeking an experienced air freight professional to manage their import and export operations end-to-end. This is a fully remote position supporting US customers and logistics partners,
requiring alignment with US Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours.
The successful candidate will take ownership of air freight shipments from booking through final delivery, handling all documentation, filings, and operational coordination independently. This role suits a detail-oriented freight professional with solid hands-on experience in air freight operations
who is comfortable working directly with customers, airlines, and international agents.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage US air freight imports and exports across the full shipment lifecycle, from booking through final delivery
  • Obtain quotes and arrange bookings directly with airlines, and prepare and issue Master and House Air Waybills (MAWB/HAWB)
  • Handle US import, export, and TSA-related filings in accordance with applicable regulations
  • Coordinate customs clearance, cargo releases, collections, and deliveries with relevant parties
  • Manage dangerous goods and lithium battery shipments in compliance with IATA DGR regulations
  • Track active shipments, resolve delays, and manage operational exceptions in a timely manner
  • Communicate directly with US customers, airlines, overseas agents, and logistics partners, and process shipment invoicing through the company's TMS

REQUIREMENTS

  • Matric (Grade 12) as a minimum; a National Diploma or relevant NQF Level 6 qualification in Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field is advantageous
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on air freight operations experience at a freight forwarder or IATA-accredited agent
  • Solid working knowledge of air freight documentation, including AWBs, and familiarity with US air shipping processes and regulations
  • Demonstrated experience with chargeable weight calculations, ULD rules, airline rates, and standard carrier procedures
  • Experience working within a freight forwarding or Transportation Management System (TMS)
  • Comfortable communicating professionally and directly with international customers and logistics partners in a remote environment

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Prior experience handling US air freight imports and exports specifically
  • IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR) certification, with experience managing dangerous goods and lithium battery shipments
  • Experience quoting air freight shipments and negotiating rates with airlines
  • Familiarity with US customs and TSA filing requirements

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Strong communication skills
  • High attention to detail
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently
  • Professionalism and reliability

raw.description:
About the client: Specializes in products for retail stores, wholesale, and distribution partners.

Role Overview - Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Seeking an experienced, hands-on CFO to lead financial operations, strengthen financial controls, and oversee the transition from our existing in-house financial platform to QuickBooks Online (QBO).

We are looking for a finance leader who understands the complexities of wholesale distribution, particularly inventory accounting, cost of goods sold, purchasing, vendor payables, and gross margin management.

This individual will play a critical role in designing and implementing our future accounting processes, ensuring financial accuracy throughout the system migration, and building a scalable finance function to support continued business growth.

The ideal candidate combines CFO-level financial expertise with practical experience in inventory-intensive businesses and accounting systems implementation. This is not a traditional bookkeeping role. We need someone who can lead the finance function while personally driving critical aspects of the transformation project.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership and Reporting

  • Oversee financial operations, accounting processes, and internal controls.

  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting and close processes.

  • Prepare and analyze financial statements, management reports, budgets, and forecasts.

  • Develop cash flow forecasts and improve working capital management.

  • Monitor revenue, gross margins, operating expenses, and overall financial performance.

  • Provide actionable financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership.

  • Establish standardized accounting procedures and financial reporting practices.

    ﻿

    Inventory Accounting and Wholesale Distribution

  • Oversee inventory valuation, cost of goods sold (COGS), landed costs, purchase-price variances, inventory adjustments, and shrinkage.

  • Reconcile inventory subledgers and warehouse inventory reports with the general ledger.

  • Analyze gross margins, inventory turns, purchasing trends, and working capital.

  • Establish controls to ensure inventory movements are accurately reflected in financial records.

  • Work closely with purchasing, warehouse operations, and sales teams to investigate discrepancies.

  • Develop financial reporting that provides visibility into product profitability and inventory performance.

  • Ensure consistent application of accounting policies across inventory transactions and financial reporting.

    ﻿

    QuickBooks Online Migration and Implementation

  • Lead the transition from the existing in-house financial platform to QuickBooks Online.

  • Assess current accounting workflows, data quality, financial reporting, and system limitations.

  • Develop the migration roadmap, implementation timeline, and project milestones.

  • Design the chart of accounts and financial reporting structure.

  • Establish data-mapping procedures for the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, vendors, customers, and inventory-related transactions.

  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders, software vendors, and technical implementation partners.

  • Evaluate integration requirements between QBO and existing inventory, warehouse management, purchasing, and sales systems.

  • Develop and execute migration testing, reconciliation procedures, and financial validation controls.

  • Ensure opening balances and migrated financial data are accurate before go-live.

  • Establish post-implementation controls, reporting procedures, and ongoing reconciliation processes.

  • Identify opportunities to automate financial workflows and reduce manual data entry.

    ﻿

    Accounts Payable, Receivable, and Working Capital

  • Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, vendor reconciliations, and customer balances.

  • Improve visibility into payment obligations, collections, and cash requirements.

  • Evaluate vendor payment terms and opportunities to improve working capital.

  • Establish procedures for invoice matching, payment approvals, and account reconciliations.

  • Monitor aging reports and resolve discrepancies with vendors and customers.

    ﻿

    Process Improvement and Internal Controls

  • Document accounting workflows and develop standard operating procedures.

  • Strengthen financial controls and approval processes.

  • Identify inefficiencies and implement automation where appropriate.

  • Establish financial KPIs and management dashboards.

  • Improve coordination between finance and operational departments.

  • Build scalable financial processes that support business growth.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience.

  • Prior experience as a CFO, Finance Director, Financial Controller, or equivalent senior finance leader.

  • Demonstrated experience in wholesale distribution, FMCG, CPG, manufacturing, or another inventory-intensive business.

  • Strong understanding of inventory accounting, COGS, gross margin analysis, and working capital management.

  • Hands-on experience implementing or migrating to QuickBooks Online.

  • Experience integrating accounting platforms with inventory management, ERP, or warehouse management systems.

  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting requirements.

  • Experience leading accounting teams, financial transformation projects, or system implementations.

  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with financial analysis and reporting tools.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and communicate effectively with U.S.-based leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with wholesale distributors operating multiple warehouses or locations.

  • Experience with high-volume inventory transactions and complex purchasing operations.

  • CPA, CMA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification.

  • Experience with accounting automation and system integrations.

  • Experience working with U.S.-based businesses and U.S. financial reporting practices.

  • Experience establishing accounting departments, implementing internal controls, and scaling finance operations.

Data Scientist, Analytics

(Remote, Canada)

Events in recent years have made us all too familiar with the havoc that natural disasters can wreak, and the increasing frequency and intensity with which they are occurring. Despite record levels of losses, conventional methods of risk modeling continue to paint at best an incomplete picture of these threats.

ZestyAI uses novel data gathering and data science methods to produce higher quality information about the risks to property from catastrophes like storms and wildfires. While AI alone may not be able to thwart these disasters, it can help us become more prepared for them, and ultimately that will lead to better outcomes.

As a Data Scientist, Analytics, you will work closely with product, engineering, and machine learning teams to apply data science to complex product and business problems.You will use diverse data sources to evaluate product performance, generate actionable insights, and support evidence-based decision-making across ZestyAI’s products.You will also help establish the analytical processes, monitoring frameworks, and best practices needed to maintain product quality and scale the organization. You thrive in a collaborative, creative environment that moves fast and are comfortable implementing structures and processes to help the company scale.

The Opportunity:

  • Translate product management, engineering, and business questions into structured analytical approaches, applying appropriate statistical, experimental, and data science methods to measure product performance and guide decision-making
  • Champion data quality of ZestyAI data products
  • Lead product monitoring and quality assurance by designing and maintaining dashboards and KPIs
  • Develop automated ETL and data workflows
  • Iterate rapidly on everything; all of the above happens in a fast-paced business-driven environment that you must be comfortable with

What You Bring to theZestyAI Team:

  • BA / BS degree in Math, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or Economics
    • MS or Ph.D. is certainly a bonus
  • 2–3 years of experience in analytics, data science, or related roles, including experience building data workflows, defining metrics, and developing dashboards or monitoring tools
  • Strong organizational and management skills with past experiences implementing best practices and processes
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguous, cross-functional questions
  • Proficient in SQL
  • Proficient in programming language (Python or R)
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform, AWS, etc)
  • Must be legally eligible to work in Canada

Nice to Have:

  • 1 - 2 years of experience working with imagery and/or geospatial data
  • Working knowledge of modeling framework and performance metrics
  • Familiarity with, or an interest in, experimental design, causal inference, and applied statistical methods
  • DBT Experience

  • Market competitive comp and equity incentives to give you a stake in our future

Job Description:

This role requires hands-on technical experience with Azure cloud services, Microsoft Windows Server environments, identity and access management, and infrastructure deployment technologies. The engineer will contribute to maintaining secure, reliable, and efficient cloud infrastructure while supporting enterprise systems and operational requirements.

The successful candidate will possess strong scripting and troubleshooting capabilities, experience with cloud governance and compliance practices, and the ability to work effectively across infrastructure, networking, and cloud technology environments.

Responsibilities:

Azure Cloud Infrastructure & Administration

  • Administer, configure, and support Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure and services.

Server Infrastructure & Networking

Automation & Infrastructure as Code

  • 2+ years of experience supporting Microsoft Windows Server 2019 or later environments.
  • 2+ years of experience with server infrastructure, network protocols, firewalls, certificates, and load balancers.

About the job

Thriveworks is a mental health care company founded by clinicians in 2008 and still led by them today. With 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model, we serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and we're growing. In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. As a clinician-led organization, we're built to support the people who do this work with the tools, community, and stability you need to build a career that lasts.

About the Role

We’re hiring licensed clinicians to provide compassionate, evidence-based care to our more than 175,000 clients across the country. You may be a good fit for this role if you’re:

  • Independently licensed and living in California — LPCC, LMFT, LCSW, PhD (Licensed Psychologist)

  • Consistently available to clients for a minimum of 25 sessions with 30 hours of availability weekly

  • A behavioral health generalist who is open to treating a variety of clients, including couples and children

  • Invested in helping your clients achieve measurable progress

  • Confident working with modern clinical technology, including telehealth and EHR tools

  • A good teammate — we’re building a clinical community and value positive contributors

Compensation

Up to $115,400 based on licensure type, session volume, and bonus opportunities. Full-time clinicians are eligible for health insurance, student loan repayment assistance, paid time off, and other employer-sponsored benefits.

How We Support You

We handle the administrative work so you can focus on what you do best: providing exceptional care. That means credentialing, billing, scheduling, and marketing support taken care of for you, plus paid orientation and training to get you started. You'll build a full caseload within 90 days of credentialing, with flexible scheduling available seven days a week from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. ET.

Benefits

As a W2 employee, you'll be eligible to receive:

  • Guaranteed bi-weekly pay for completed sessions

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) with employer matching

  • Paid time off

  • Short- and long-term disability insurance

  • Company-paid life and AD&D insurance

  • CEU reimbursement and free in-house training

  • Student loan repayment assistance

  • Opportunities for paid clinical supervisor roles in select states

Our Community

Being a clinician can feel isolating, especially in a telehealth world. We're built to make sure it doesn't. You'll have access to live clinical support, monthly case consultations, and a vibrant online and in-person community of more than 2,700 licensed providers. All clinical leadership is promoted from within, so the people supporting you have been exactly where you are.

Ready to Join Us?
Apply today to become part of a team that’s changing mental health care for clients and clinicians alike.


Interested in joining Team Thriveworks? We're thrilled to meet you!


With Job scams becoming more and more frequent, here's how to know you're speaking with a real member of our team:

  • Our recruiters and other team members will only email you from or an @thriveworks.com email address.
  • Our recruiters and other team members may also contact you via text or phone to schedule an interview.
  • A google meets interview invitation will be sent via email and will only come from an @thriveworks.com email address.
  • Our interviews will take place over Google Meet (not Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or any other platform).
  • We will never ask you to purchase or send us equipment.

If you see a scam related to Thriveworks, please report it to . You can contact with any questions or concerns.


Thriveworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our people are our most valuable assets. We embrace and encourage differences in age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, national origin, physical and mental ability, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, and other characteristics that make our employees unique. We encourage and welcome diverse candidates to apply for any position you are qualified for to bring your unique perspective to our team.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship, either now or in the future.

By clicking Apply, you acknowledge that Thriveworks may contact you regarding your application.

raw.description:
Du lebst im Ausland, arbeitest remote und suchst eine sinnvolle, flexible Aufgabe mit echtem Startup-Einblick? Du bist stark in Wort und Schrift, greifst aber auch gerne zum Hörer, um Dinge voranzubringen?

Wir sind ZWW Deutschland – wir verbinden KMU, Agenturen und Berater mit staatlichen Förderprogrammen, von denen kaum jemand weiß. Unser Team wächst und wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Vertriebspipeline aktiv mitentwickelt: Anfragen bearbeiten, Kontakte qualifizieren, Termine vereinbaren. Auf Deutsch, auf Augenhöhe, mit Biss.

Aufgaben

  • Du bearbeitest eingehende Kundenanfragen per Mail – schnell, freundlich und professionell.
  • Du betreust unsere Mailkampagnen mit: Du beantwortest Rückläufer, schreibst mit Interessenten und entwickelst daraus konkrete Termine.
  • Du entwickelst unsere Pipeline aktiv weiter – du arbeitest Kontakte auf, hakst nach und bleibst dran.
  • Du greifst auch zum Telefon: Du telefonierst nach, qualifizierst Interessenten und vereinbarst Termine für unsere Vertriebsexperten – sauber, verbindlich, strukturiert.
  • Du qualifizierst potenzielle Kunden – passt das Angebot, macht ein Gespräch Sinn?
  • Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung, auch zu Kooperationen.
  • Du arbeitest dich tief ins Produkt ein und verstehst, welche Förderungen für welche Kunden passen.
  • Du dokumentierst Gespräche und pflegst die Infos im CRM.

Qualifikation

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau – du schreibst und sprichst fehlerfrei und professionell.
  • Du bist gewandt in Wort und Schrift – deine Mails sitzen, dein Ton am Telefon auch.
  • Du bist proaktiv: Du wartest nicht auf Anweisungen, sondern siehst selbst, wo was zu tun ist.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und erkennst schnell, ob jemand ernsthaftes Interesse hat.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und selbstständig – auch ohne dass jemand dir auf die Finger schaut.
  • Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt, Vertrieb, Setting oder als virtuelle Assistenz ist ein Plus.
  • KI-Tools nutzt du aktiv oder lernst sie blitzschnell.
  • Du bist kommunikativ, denkst mit und hast keine Scheu, Neues anzugehen.
  • Europäische Zeitzone bevorzugt – aber nicht zwingend.

Benefits

  • 100% remote – du arbeitest von wo du willst.
  • Aktuell 5–10 Stunden pro Woche – flexibel und planbar, ausbaubar auf mehr.
  • Du bekommst echte Einblicke in ein wachsendes Startup und lernst, wie moderner Vertrieb funktioniert.
  • Kein Konzern, keine Hierarchien – direkte Kommunikation mit dem Team und der Geschäftsführung.
  • Perspektive auf mehr Stunden und Verantwortung, wenn's passt.

Klingt nach dir? Dann melde dich einfach bei Felix auf JOIN – er ist dein erster Ansprechpartner und freut sich auf dich.

raw.title: Sr. Software Engineer
raw.excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLE: We’re hiring Senior Software Engineers to work on Rightway’s products across web, mobile, and backend systems.
raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re hiring Senior Software Engineers to work on Rightway’s products across web, mobile, and backend systems. Our backend platform spans multiple technologies, with newer services built using React, Node, NestJS, and TypeScript, alongside existing services implemented in Ruby on Rails.

Senior engineers at Rightway are expected to bring strong technical ownership, contribute to system design, and help teams deliver reliable, high quality software.

We're an AI-native engineering team that uses AI tooling daily in our development workflow and expects our senior engineers to lead adoption, establish best practices, and help the team get better at working with these tools.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Lead the architecture and delivery across the Rails backend and React frontend
  • Build the integrations that connect our service to our Node.js/NestJS PBM platform
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers through pairing and code review discussions
  • Set testing and code-quality standards for your area, and raise risks early
  • Collaborate closely with product and design partners to deliver thoughtful solutions
  • Participate in architectural discussions and help guide technical decisions
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well tested code
  • Review code and provide technical guidance to teammates
  • Help improve reliability, performance, and developer experience

WHO YOU ARE:

  • 5+ years of professional experience building production software
  • Strong experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and React
  • Solid backend experience with Ruby on Rails, Node, or similar frameworks
  • Experience working with APIs using GraphQL or REST
  • Interest in working across multiple backend technologies
  • Comfortable owning complex systems and improving them over time
  • Collaborative, pragmatic, and product minded

EXTRA CREDIT:

  • Experience with Ruby and Rails
  • Experience building backend services with Node, NestJS, and TypeScript
  • Experience with Protobuf and or gRPC
  • Familiarity with healthcare systems or regulated environments
  • Experience handling sensitive data and privacy considerations
  • Startup or fast paced product experience
  • Experience leading AI-assisted development workflows and establishing team standards around AI tooling

COMPENSATION: $160,000 - $195,000 annually, in addition to bonus and equity

Compensation offered will be determined by geographic location, experience, and qualifications.

CYBERSECURITY AWARENESS NOTICE

In response to ongoing and industry-wide fraudulent recruitment activities (i.e., job scams), Rightway wants to inform potential candidates that we will only contact them from the @ email domain. We will never ask for bank details or deposits of any kind as a condition of employment.

ABOUT RIGHTWAY:

Rightway is on a mission to harmonize healthcare for everyone, everywhere. Our products guide patients to the best care and medications by inserting clinicians and pharmacists into a patient’s care journey through a modern, mobile app. Rightway is a front door to healthcare, giving patients the tools they need along with on-demand access to Rightway health guides, human experts that answer their questions and manage the frustrating parts of healthcare for them.

Since its founding in 2017, Rightway has raised over $200mm from investors including Khosla Ventures, Thrive Capital, and Tiger Global. We’re headquartered in New York City, with satellite offices in Denver and Dallas. Our clients rely on us to transform the healthcare experience, improve outcomes for their teams, and decrease their healthcare costs.

HOW WE LIVE OUR VALUES TO OUR TEAMMATES:

We’re seeking those with passion for healthcare and relentless devotion to our goal. We need team members that embody our core values:

1) We are human, firstOur humanity binds us together. We bring the same empathetic approach to every individual we engage with, whether it be our members, our clients, or each other. We are all worthy of respect and understanding and we engage in our interactions with care and intention. We honor our stories. We listen to—and hear—each other, we celebrate our differences and similarities, we are present for each other, and we strive for mutual understanding.

2) We redefine what is possibleWe always look beyond the obstacles in front of us to imagine new solutions. We approach our work with inspiration from other industries, other leaders, and other challenges. We use ingenuity and resourcefulness when faced with tough problems.

3) We debate then commitWe believe that a spirit of open discourse is part of a healthy culture. We understand and appreciate different perspectives and we challenge our assumptions. When working toward a decision or a new solution, we actively listen to one another, approach it with a “yes, and” mentality, and assume positive intent. Once a decision is made, we align and champion it as one team.

4) We cultivate gritChanging healthcare doesn’t happen overnight. We reflect and learn from challenges and approach the future with a determination to strive for better. In the face of daunting situations, we value persistence. We embrace failure as a stepping stone to future success. On this journey, we seek to act with guts, resilience, initiative, and tenacity.

5) We seek to delightHealthcare is complicated and personal. We work tirelessly to meet the goals of our clients while also delivering the best experience to our members. We recognize that no matter the role or team, we each play a crucial part in our members’ care and take that responsibility seriously. When faced with an obstacle, we are kind, respectful, and solution-oriented in our approach. We hold ourselves accountable to our clients and our members’ success.

Rightway is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in the strength of diverse thought, beliefs, backgrounds, and education. We foster an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated to drive the best business decisions possible. We do not discriminate on any basis protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, need, and performance.

Sr Mgr, Customer Success Mgmt

About the Role

The Team Lead Customer Success Manager serves as the strategic bridge between account-level consultants and organizational leadership. This role aligns multiple customer programs or business units under a unified framework that translates corporate objectives into actionable account strategies. You’ll own overall portfolio performance, mentor Technical CSMs, and partnering & overseeing cross-functional optimization of the REs within your BoB. Ensuring consistent execution of customer strategies that drive adoption, retention, and expansion.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own regional ARR planning and attainment. Align capacity, resources, and account plans to targets; run cadence reviews and intervene early to protect growth and retention.

  • Standardize EBR narratives, proof-of-value metrics, and portfolio KSOs to demonstrate business impact.

  • Establish and enforce portfolio-level risk playbooks. Chair recurring risk reviews, surface systemic patterns, and coordinate cross-functional mitigations.

  • Run regional Voice of Customer cadences. Aggregate requests into prioritized product asks, coordinate betas or lighthouse initiatives, and close feedback loops with customers and Product teams.

  • Reviews standards across accounts. Ensure reusable, secure performance patterns that accelerate time-to-value.

  • Set the enablement agenda for the team. Establish proficiency baselines, curate deep-dives with Product, and guarantee expert coverage for strategic engagements.

  • Operationalize security best practices and standardize network design reviews across the portfolio, driving adoption of scalable, resilient architectures.

  • Scale vertical frameworks and tailor strategies to regulatory or industry needs (OT, Healthcare, Public Sector, etc.).

  • Own onboarding standards, playbooks, and operating rhythms. Measure adoption of best practices and continuously iterate for scale.

  • Model ethical decision-making and hold teams accountable to balanced customer and organizational outcomes.

  • Cultivate a learning culture. Run retros and experiments, build skills roadmaps, and institutionalize knowledge sharing to improve outcomes quarter over quarter.

  • 10+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Consulting within B2B SaaS, Consulting, Technical Pre- or Post-Sales Engineering, Development, Solution Development or Product Management.

  • Proven track record managing multi-account portfolios and leading CS teams in a technical or cybersecurity environment.

  • Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, risk mitigation, and value realization methodologies.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into operational plans and measurable outcomes.

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or related discipline (required); advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred.

  • Preferred Attributes

  • Strategic systems thinker who thrives on cross-functional alignment.

  • Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills.

  • Data-driven decision-maker with an eye for scalable process design.

  • Empathetic leader committed to developing people and uplifting team capability.

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.
