Material Bank is the world’s largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials.

About the role:

Material Bank is expanding its reach with the launch of our new MB3 platform – our modern B2B commerce platform built to replace our legacy system and serve the needs of architects, designers and brands at scale.

We're seeking a Lead Front End Engineer to design, build, and deliver technical and product roadmap features. You'll be part of a multidisciplinary team building innovative products with state-of-the-art technology, collaborating closely with designers and software engineers. You'll help shape key technology and tooling decisions, and work closely with the backend engineering team to define integration standards. You'll also own critical aspects of the site's engineering, including SEO tooling, site analytics, monitoring, performance optimization, and the selection of testing frameworks.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop and maintain the front-end architecture for a brand-new platform, ensuring it aligns with the overall technical vision and business goals.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design and QA teams to translate wireframes and design mockups into interactive and visually appealing user interfaces and build “the right things the right way”
  • Optimize UI components and application code for performance, scalability, and responsiveness, ensuring a smooth user experience even during high traffic periods. Be very aware of Accessibility, UX, and responsive design.
  • Create and maintain documentation for UI components, coding standards, and best practices to facilitate collaboration among team members.
  • Help the team to rewrite, refactor, and decouple frontend from a CommerceTools application to a NextJS app & build tests using playwright
  • Help build the strategy, select the right tools, and implement SEO, site analytics, A/B testing, monitoring, etc.

What you’ll bring:

  • Master’s degree in computer science
  • 5+ Strong expertise in React and related libraries, with the ability to design and develop complex user interfaces using React components.
  • Proficiency in HTML, REACT and CSS, including knowledge of CSS preprocessors like SASS or LESS.
  • Familiarity with UI/UX design principles and the ability to collaborate effectively with designers to create visually appealing and user-friendly interfaces.
  • Knowledge of cross-browser compatibility issues and solutions to ensure consistent performance across different web browsers.
  • Create intuitive and responsive User Interfaces (UI) that provide an exceptional user experience, leveraging your expertise in front-end technologies.
  • Able to maintain high-performance service requirement.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience building e-commerce customer portals
  • High proficiency at problem-solving with focus on speed of delivery, being a team player, and being into details
  • Knowledge of CommerceTools is a plus

What’s our tech stack?

  • React, Javascript
  • NextJS, Storybook, React Query
  • Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, Github Actions
  • NewRelic, Sentry, Slack, GitHub, Jira, Notion

What you’ll get from us:

  • Our people: We are a growth-driven team that values efficiency, builds smart automation, operates in small empowered teams, and moves quickly from idea to execution.
  • Relaxation and Celebrations: Flexible PTO, Sick Days, Paid National Holidays, and even more (ask us about this when we connect).
  • Health Benefits: We contribute to your medical, dental, vision and short-term/long-term disability plans and have a strong employee assistance program.
  • Plan for your Retirement: 401(k) eligible after your first 90 day's employed!
  • Giving Back: We sponsor multiple events throughout the year to help out our communities.
  • Growth: We’ll help you take your career to the next level. We want you to be creative and take initiative which will allow you to grow and create within the company. Most importantly, be the best at what matters!
  • Flexible Work Schedules: With business units and employees across the globe, Material Technologies has embraced a hybrid  working model allowing department leaders to decide on the best approach for their respective teams, whether that be remote, in person, or a little of both.

Material Bank is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran or disability status or other status protected under any applicable federal, state or local law.

raw.excerpt: Job DescriptionThe Richard W.  Riley College of Education and Human Sciences seek part-time faculty to serve as methodologists on dissertation committees for our Ed.
raw.description:
Job Description

The Richard W. Riley College of Education and Human Sciences seek part-time faculty to serve as methodologists on dissertation committees for our Ed.D. and Ph.D. programs. Contributing faculty are primarily responsible for student research mentoring within the school's doctoral degree programs. Specifically, they are required to serve on and/or chair dissertation committees These faculty members will report to the Associate Dean or designer.

Primary duties and responsibilities include:

  • Serve as methodologist on doctoral committees in either the position of chair or second member.
  • Complete required faculty trainings

Roles and Responsibilities for Methodologist and URR Committee Membership

The Role of Methodology Expert

  • Provides feedback to students on the following:
    • Proposed research design including appropriateness for addressing the problem statement and research questions or for testing stated hypotheses
    • Selection of specific methodology
    • Selection of a sample of appropriate characteristics and size
    • Oversee implementation of the selected methodology, assuring compliance with the following:
      • Program/professional norms
      • Generally accepted ethical and moral principles regarding human subjects
  • Provides constructive feedback about the following:
    • Data collection and analysis
    • Presentation of the data and the conclusions drawn from the analysis
  • Doctoral degree in the field of Education, or related field from an accredited university
  • Strong research methodology background in quantitative, qualitative (preferred) and/or mixed methods.
  • A significant record of intellectual and professional contributions to the field of Education, or related field, including peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations.
  • Experience serving on doctoral dissertation committees is required.
  • Three to five years of independent research project mentoring is preferred.
  • Commitment to advocating for the learning and development needs of students earning their degrees in a distance learning environment; supervising student research preferred at the graduate level; commitment to the promotion of research that contributes to Walden's mission of contributing to positive social change; commitment to advocating for the learning and development needs of students earning their degrees in a distance learning environment.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, team, and human relation skills.
  • Experience with distance learning is preferred.

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected compensation rate for this position is as follows:

  • Graduate Course Instruction: $1,560 - $4,080 per Quarter or Semester, depending on type of course taught and length of course
  • Undergraduate Course Instruction: $700 - $2,200 per quarter, depending on type of course taught and length of course

    Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Walden also offers other opportunities for its contributing faculty members, such as dissertation/doctoral study committee chair positions, research reviewing, and dissertation and doctoral study mentoring.

    For more information regarding these opportunities, including the Faculty Compensation Schedule, please Click Here.

Equal Opportunity – Minority / Female / Disability / V / Gender Identity / Sexual Orientation

About Walden University

Walden University, a Covista institution, supports a diverse community of adult learners from across the U.S. and other countries, who seek to achieve their academic goals and make positive, lasting social change in their professions and communities. Walden offers more than 100 online degree and certificate programs, for students pursuing a bachelor’s, master’s, doctoral or certificate. Walden University has graduated more than 174,000 students and is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission.

Visit WaldenU.edu for more information, and follow on Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn.

With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight Consulting. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market.   • Experience with Inertia.js and RESTful API in Laravel.

  • Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon, both regarding estimates and the general process.
  • Ability to identify with Bluelight's clients' goals and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.
  • A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
  • Forensic attention to detail.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications
Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

THE ROLE

We are seeking an exceptional CRM Systems Lead to join our Corporate Shared Services team, an Accredited Labs company. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a fast-growing, multi-location organization and have a direct impact on how more than 20 branches communicate with and serve customers — by building our HubSpot Service Hub environment from the ground up and then owning it.

The ideal candidate has 3+ years of hands-on HubSpot administration experience (not end-user experience), is comfortable writing and debugging code to extend HubSpot beyond its native functionality, and is senior enough to hold an outside agency partner accountable for scope, quality, and delivery.

This position is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the United States.

As our CRM Systems Lead, you will construct HubSpot Service Hub as the system of record for customer communication across our branch network, then own it end to end — administration, workflow automation, integrations, and customer data governance. This role is pivotal to giving branch staff one reliable system to serve customers, and giving the business a trustworthy, unified view of the customer relationship as we continue to grow.

DAY TO DAY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own day-to-day system administration — users, seats, permissions, properties, and pipelines — and serve as first-line support for branch staff.
  • Design and build workflows using native HubSpot automation, extending functionality with custom-coded actions and webhooks where native tools run out.
  • Lead rollout execution for branch launches rolling out in waves — configuration, hypercare support, and transition to steady state.
  • Manage our agency partner day-to-day: scoping work, reviewing deliverables, tracking hours, and holding the team accountable for quality.
  • Build and maintain integrations with Dialpad, NetSuite, and internal data pipelines — monitoring sync health, diagnosing failures, and designing new integrations as needs arise.
  • Own customer data quality within HubSpot — deduplication, record associations, and property governance — as the platform becomes our customer master.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years administering HubSpot with hands-on Service Hub or Sales Hub configuration experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to extend HubSpot beyond native functionality, including writing and debugging custom code and webhooks.
  • Strong technical fluency — able to reason about data structure, system architecture, and integration design.
  • Experience managing or overseeing an outside vendor or agency partner, including scoping and quality accountability.
  • Comfortable supporting non-technical, front-line staff across multiple locations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

NICE TO HAVE

Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with paid time off

All necessary tools and technology supplied to help you succeed

raw.description:
COMPANY PROFILE

CodeAI is an education innovation nonprofit dedicated to the vision that every student in every school has the opportunity to learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and computer science (CS) as part of their core K-12 education. We increase participation in AI+CS education by reaching students of all backgrounds where they are — at their skill level, in their schools, and in ways that inspire them to keep learning, with a focus on increasing participation by young women and students from other underrepresented groups. The leading provider of K-12 AI+CS education curriculum across the globe, CodeAI also organizes the annual Hour of AI campaign, building on the legacy of the Hour of Code, which has engaged more than 15% of all students in the world!

A unifying approach in a divided world

CodeAI's global role in the K-12 computer science movement is only possible because we use a unifying approach across diverse and often divided stakeholders. At a time of increasing polarization, the idea of increasing opportunity for students unites people from across the political spectrum. CodeAI's team members, students, teachers, and supporters have diverse and diverging view points, and they are all welcome in our mission. Read more.

JOB SUMMARY

As Director of Global Strategy & Programs, you'll set the strategic direction for CodeAI's work expanding access to CS + AI learning experiences outside the U.S. You'll decide where and how Global can have the greatest impact, then build the programs, partnerships, and systems needed to get there.

You'll balance depth-market investment with breadth-market scale, translating big-picture strategy into operating models that actually work in classrooms while representing CodeAI's global work to ministries of education, partners, and media.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, you will:

Global Strategy & Impact

  • Define CodeAI's global strategy, setting the goals, KPIs, and market approaches that expand access to and adoption of CS + AI learning.
  • Own global performance, using data, market insight, and partner feedback to spot opportunities and improve impact.
  • Decide where Global can have the greatest impact, balancing deep engagement in priority markets against scalable approaches everywhere else.
  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy as a strategic leader, aligning priorities across the organization.

Programs, Markets & Partnerships

  • Build and scale global programs that help partners and ecosystems deliver CodeAI's learning experiences sustainably.
  • Design distinct strategies for breadth markets (in-market partners) and depth markets (direct investment in infrastructure and partnerships).
  • Design frameworks and partner models that bring curriculum, product, marketing, operations, and partnerships together into one coherent program.
  • Win leadership and cross-functional buy-in for global strategies, securing the resources needed to execute.
  • Adapt programs and operating models to local context while holding the line on CodeAI's mission and standards.

Team & Operational Leadership

  • Lead and grow a small Global team — setting goals, coaching, and supporting career development.
  • Manage the Global team's budget and oversee vendors and contracted partners (teacher training, localization, market implementation).
  • Build systems for consistent execution, measurement, and reporting across the partner ecosystem.

Advocacy & Organizational Alignment

  • Represent CodeAI's global work and partner ecosystem to government and ministry leaders, nonprofit and education partners, and media.
  • Turn complex global strategy and market dynamics into narratives that drive decisions across the organization.
  • Build cross-team understanding of how global insights and partnerships should inform CodeAI's broader strategy.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

We seek candidates who have:

  • 7+ years of experience driving systemic change in K-12 education worldwide, particularly in AI and Computer Science education.
  • Deep experience in nonprofit settings, partnering with ministries of education, school systems, and teacher networks to expand equitable access to CS education.
  • An entrepreneurial, autonomous operating style — able to align programs and partnerships across complex education ecosystems to hit measurable outcomes.
  • The ability to design and scale programs spanning multiple workstreams: curriculum, teacher PD, government relations, and partner enablement.
  • Comfort operating at both ends of the spectrum — presenting strategic frameworks to boards and funders, and inspiring educators and partners directly.
  • A track record building data-driven systems that measure program effectiveness and student/teacher impact at scale.
  • A reputation as a trusted mentor and collaborator who builds alignment around shared goals across diverse teams and partners.

In addition, candidates must:

  • Be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
  • Work within the continental United States
  • Pass a pre-employment background check
  • Be willing to travel a minimum of two times per year for team events

OUR CULTURAL PRINCIPLES

The way we work matters as much as the work itself. Before you apply, we invite you to take a look at our cultural principles. They reflect who we are, how we show up for each other, and what we look for in the people who join us.

OUR APPROACH TO AI IN HIRING

At CodeAI, we use AI thoughtfully and responsibly to support human-centered hiring. AI may help with administrative tasks, but every hiring decision is made by real people on our team. We welcome candidates to use AI appropriately in their job search while upholding our values of honesty and integrity throughout the process.

Read our full AI Use Policy in Hiring here.

WHAT IS THE INTERVIEW PROCESS LIKE?

Step 1: Informational Interview - learn more about the role and share your experience (30 minutes)

Step 2: Take-Home Assignment (~3 hours)

Step 3: Interviews with several members of the CodeAI team (3 hours)
Step 4: Final Interviews (2 hours)
Step 5: Reference Checks

All interviews are currently being conducted virtually via Google Meet

TO APPLY

Our team will review all applications on an ongoing basis and if we believe your qualifications would make a great fit, we'll contact you to schedule an informational interview.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS PACKAGE

The expected salary range for this position is $117,000 - $130,000. Most offers are on the lower end of the salary range and are at the company’s sole discretion based on the final candidate’s experience. This allows us to provide a fair and equitable approach to compensation when setting pay and maintaining internal pay equity.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees that includes:

  • Technology subsidy consistent with our Bring Your Own Device environment
  • Flexible, engaging, and remote working environment
  • Paid time off: 5 weeks total, comprised of 3 weeks vacation annually, plus a 2-week winter break office closure (including Christmas and New Year's), and sick leave
  • Medical, dental and vision premiums paid at 100% for FT positions and their dependents
  • Option to participate in 403b retirement plan
  • Annual professional development stipend
  • The opportunity to help students learn better and change the face of computer science

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

raw.title: Associate Client Services Director
raw.excerpt: At BOLDSCIENCE, an Associate Client Service Director (ACSD) plays a pivotal role within the Client Services leadership team.
raw.description:
At BOLDSCIENCE, an Associate Client Service Director (ACSD) plays a pivotal role within the Client Services leadership team. They have a wealth of experience working within the medical communications industry and can execute a variety of deliverables and drive a diverse portfolio of accounts. As well as excellent project and client management skills, an aCSD has a high level of scientific and strategic knowledge, enabling them to quickly become a trusted partner to clients. They are forward-thinking and always looking for new ideas and fresh approaches to push BOLD’s offering to the next level. An aCSD is egoless and leads by example. They are never one to shy away from getting stuck in and pride themselves on the development of their line reports and team. They take the time to build relationships with the wider BOLDSCIENCE team (such as Scientific, Creative, Finance, and People Operations) and ensure that collaborations are successful. An ACSD is beginning to expand their role outside of day-to-day account management and will start to increase their visibility across the wider Client Services & BOLDSCIENCE team.

DAY TO DAY RESPONSIBILITIES:

At BOLDSCIENCE, an ACSD can apply high levels of scientific and/or industry expertise to function as a strategic partner to clients. They are responsible for tactical planning, financial management, resourcing, and driving organic and new business opportunities. Some typical activities will include:

Client Management:

  • Ability to build an open and honest partnership with clients and build the BOLD team around them. They have a sixth sense and can forward plan, knowing exactly when something needs to be changed/actioned
  • Extensive experience working across a range of therapeutic areas, clients, and medical education tactics
  • Provides onsite support where required
  • Ability to apply a high level of scientific and commercial expertise gained through extensive knowledge and experience in the industry to act as a true client partner
  • Provides strategic and operational direction to account teams
  • Acts as a strategic and trusted partner as well as pushing and challenging our clients’ thinking
  • Works in partnership with the Scientific Lead on accounts to develop and refine client strategy and tactics and ensure the BOLD plan for execution is feasible
  • Provides support to the account team on client discussions where appropriate and flags any potential conflicts across the business
  • Implements and maintains quality standards, cost efficiency, and best working practices alongside senior account team members

Project Management:

  • Overall responsibility for a large or a diverse portfolio of accounts
  • Effectively directs projects, overseeing and delegating tasks to the team as appropriate. Leads by example and is always happy to have a hands-on approach to support their team
  • Portfolio lead for strategic discussions and routine client/agency reviews, driving strategic and tactical organic growth
  • Drives alignment across client teams, ensuring the highest standards are met and providing internal leadership of accounts and teams
  • Holds regular team meetings to ensure that everyone is up to date, clear on actions, and can ask any questions
  • In collaboration with the scientific team leads, ensures the optimum level of resources to service account needs and pre-empt any resourcing challenges
  • Is accountable in driving actions forward and is solution focused to achieving company goals
  • Reviews content and provides sign-off on work, partnering with the scientific team leads

Financial Management:

  • Overall responsibility for account financials and business unit KPIs
  • Works closely with the VP, Client Services to set realistic revenue targets and ensure that BOLDs overall revenue target is achieved
  • Responsible for account and business unit forecasting, working closely with the Scientific Lead to ensure all financials are accurate
  • Consistently meets billability & recoverability targets and ensures the same from line reports and wider team members
  • Completes timesheets accurately on time and ensures the same from line reports and wider team members
  • Maintains strong relationships with senior clients and procurement teams and supports with MSA negotiations
  • Supports team in financial conversations with the client, including overall yearly budgeting, timely out-of-scope recovery, and billings

Business Development:

  • Identifies and drives new business opportunities across new and existing clients
  • Identifies opportunities for business growth, actively driving new business opportunities and leading in pitches
  • Responsible for keeping abreast with key events and innovations in the industry

People Management:

  • Manages and inputs into the career development of direct reports and their teams, closely reviewing goals and objectives
  • Line manages several team members of varying levels, providing constructive and actionable feedback to team members
  • Coaches and mentors others across the agency with the ability to adapt to get the best out of the BOLD team
  • Forms excellent senior-level relationships and is a trusted partner to the Business Unit founder

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Extensive experience working within the medical communications industry
  • Proven ability to work across different therapy areas and project deliverables in a client-facing role. Leading and actioning projects within a fast-paced agency environment
  • Excellent understanding of the pharma and competitor landscape
  • Extensive experience and knowledge within the medical communications industry
  • Experience collaborating with different departments such as Scientific Services, Creative, Digital, etc.
  • Able to lead a team effectively, including line management responsibilities and mentoring
  • Experienced financial management including budgets, forecasting, and recoverability
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in science, pharmacology, or medicine with the ability to apply high levels of scientific knowledge

title: Senior Team Lead, Paid Social
description: Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, and technology to make a mark on our communities - our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors.

raw.title: Senior Team Lead, Paid Social
raw.excerpt: Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, and technology to make a mark on our communities - our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors.
raw.description:
Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, and technology to make a mark on our communities - our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors. We believe in relentlessly pursuing (and sharing) the truth – bringing together millions of data points from quantitative and qualitative sources to base our decisions on. Our purpose is to unlock potential for our communities mentioned above. Our vision is a world where it’s easy to do the right thing throughout those communities. If you’re ready to uplift others, challenge your ego, commit to the truth, and be better than yesterday – keep reading.
Seer is a remote first agency and Certified B-Corp with team members working across the country. If an office environment is more your style, this position can also sit in our HQ office, Philadelphia. We can only consider candidates based in the US who are able to work continental US based hours.
The Role: As a Senior Paid Social Lead, you are naturally a consultant and leader. You test before you have an opinion. When a platform ships a new feature, an algorithm shifts, or someone on the team says "this doesn't work anymore," your instinct isn't to nod along, it's to run it on Seer first and see what actually happens. You back your point of view with receipts, not vibes: links, screenshots, and firsthand results over secondhand sentiment. You're not satisfied with Seer being seen as solid at Paid Social. You want us known, publicly, as one of the best, and you're ready to set the direction that gets us there, not just execute someone else's. You've built and grown a team before, and you know that scaling a group of Paid Social SMEs takes the same rigor you'd apply to a new ad format or bidding strategy.

Role Highlights

  • Evangelize Seer's vision within Paid Social, working closely with Seer's Paid Media Leadership Team to drive excitement, adoption, and integration as we run full-steam toward being an industry leader in AI, automation, machine learning, and holistic search strategies
  • Drive full-funnel Paid Social strategy through an integrated approach, leveraging deep expertise across a variety of paid social channels (Meta, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, Reddit, and more) while collaborating closely with divisions like Creative and SEO to grow your clients' bottom line
  • Own the test, learn, and iterate mindset across the client portfolio, running tests on Seer's own accounts first before rolling recommendations out to clients, treating our media budget as the proving ground for new platforms, formats, and AI-driven workflows
  • Leverage your Paid Media expertise across other paid channels (Paid Search, Display, Programmatic) to drive an integrated approach to Paid Social strategy
  • Lead a team of 4 to 6 direct reports, setting a bar for excellence and evidence-backed thinking that your team rises to meet, and take ownership of how that team grows and develops over time
  • Drive creative innovation and synergy between divisions within Seer to help provide direction for our growing Paid Social and Creative offering
  • Oversee day-to-day campaign strategy and management for 3 to 4 accounts, implementing industry best practices and making recommendations at scale, backed by what you've actually tested
  • Develop strong frameworks for building Seer's Paid Social Book of Business within the current client portfolio and within new and developing industries and channels
  • Build strong, lasting client relationships using Seer's values as your compass, positioning your team as an extension of theirs and taking their wins and losses as your own Play a key role in growing divisional revenue through cross-selling and up-selling, working closely with our business development team to identify, qualify, and close projects
  • Create and maintain scalable processes that support our AI transformation and holistic strategy in social, driving buy-in and excitement across our Paid Social division
  • Push Seer's public reputation in Paid Social from competent to category-leading, through original points of view, case studies, and thought leadership grounded in work you've actually done

Essential Skills

  • You have led and scaled a team of 2 or more direct reports, and you've shaped how that team grows, not just how it performs day to day
  • You treat Paid as a testing discipline end to end, which means you're already testing AI tools and workflows in your own work, not waiting for someone else to prove them out first. Before you form a point of view on a channel, feature, or platform change, you've already run it on either clients or Seer's own accounts
  • You are someone who challenges the status quo and brings the team along with you to think about new ways to evolve our Paid Social program and our UVP to clients
  • You want Seer to be known publicly as one of the best in the industry at Paid Social, not just a safe, competent choice
  • You have managed Paid Social campaigns across a wide range of industries, engines, and management platforms, and you know when and where automation and machine learning can get your team's time back
  • You have experience in emerging channels like TikTok and Reddit, and in pitching full-funnel strategies that incorporate creative design, supplemental marketing channels, and measurement plans
  • You have experience partnering with leadership on strategy or account decisions that extend beyond your own book of business
  • You take a data-driven, holistic approach to Paid Social, pulling in signal from Creative, SEO, and Analytics to build smarter strategies
  • You are skilled at developing and recognizing talent, whether that's coaching up a team member who's still finding their footing or making sure a strong quarter gets seen
  • You are quick to kick up a new opportunity and run with it, making data-driven, actionable recommendations that create value for your clients
  • You have a habit of sharing what you learn, through 1:1s, Lunch 'n Learns, webinars, blogs, case studies, or speaking engagements
  • You are savvy with Excel, Google Suite, and data viz tools, and you understand data sources, data constructs, and the basics of SQL
  • You have an eye for great talent, finding it, keeping it, and growing it

30/60/90

  • First 30 Days — Learn

  • Complete division training and begin supporting clients and your team of direct reports

  • Run your first test on a Seer account and share what you found with the team

  • 60 Days — Build

  • Be fully ramped on your 3 to 4 accounts and actively developing your 4 to 6 direct reports

  • Bring a documented point of view (with receipts) to the team on a platform, format, or AI workflow you've tested

  • 90 Days — Lead

  • Operate at full capacity, owning your book of business and your team's growth independently

  • Have a visible piece of thought leadership in motion, internal or external, that reflects your tested point of view

This might not be the right role for you if

  • Time management, context-switching, and juggling multiple projects and people is genuinely difficult for you
  • You're inclined to adopt other people's takes on a platform or tactic rather than testing it yourself
  • Continued learning and innovation, including with AI, isn't something you want as a baseline expectation
  • You'd rather execute a plan than help set one for your team or the division
  • Change management is hard for you and you struggle adapting to new tools and processes
Have questions about recruitment at Seer? Check out our Custom GPT: Guide to Talent Acquisition at Seerto drop in your questions! You can ask it anything about our hiring process, and how to best prepare for an interview with us.
As a B-Corp Certified organization, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
Not ready to apply but want to keep in touch? Stay connected via our monthly Career Update newsletter! We'll share curated content on Seer, open roles, industry insights, career advice, events you don't want to miss, and more (so you never miss a beat).

raw.description:
Category: IT Professional Services

Location:


This position sits within DX-ROI, Infoverity’s partner organization. DX-ROI is a digital consultancy aiming to redefine the landscape of digital transformations. We seek to provide clients with measurable outcomes and enduring value from the tools and processes surrounding their digital endeavors. DX-ROI commits to data-driven strategies and proven processes developed through decades of industry experience in its service offerings ranging from upfront Strategy, Architecture, and Experience Design through to Martech Delivery and Post-Launch Support. We are a team of curious and tenacious subject matter experts ready to roll up our sleeves and keep our clients' success at the center of everything we do.
We are looking for a full-time employee located and eligible for employment in the United States.

Workfront Solution Architect (Process Transformation, Workfront, Fusion, and Planning)

As a Workfront Solution Architect, you will lead client engagements that solve complex business process problems across marketing, creative, and content operations. You will combine deep expertise in Adobe Workfront, Workfront Fusion, and Workfront Planning with a strong foundation in process design and operational strategy. You will serve as a trusted advisor to client executives and stakeholders. You will uncover the root causes of process breakdowns and recommend practical changes to people, process, and technology. Your work will drive measurable improvements in throughput, visibility, governance, and user adoption.

Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, and working workshops to understand current-state processes, pain points, and business objectives.
  • Assess current-state workflows, organizational structures, and operating models to identify process gaps, bottlenecks, and inefficiencies.
  • Develop executive-level recommendations that clearly connect process gaps to business impact and proposed solutions.
  • Create current-state and future-state process maps that document handoffs, approvals, decision points, and system touchpoints.
  • Define role recommendations, including responsibilities, RACI models, and alignment of Workfront access levels to job functions.
  • Recommend organizational and operational model changes to support scalable work intake, prioritization, resource management, and delivery.
  • Design governance plans covering decision rights, intake standards, naming conventions, permission models, reporting standards, and platform change management.
  • Develop adoption plans that address stakeholder communication, training, change readiness, and success metrics.
  • Translate future-state processes into scalable Workfront architectures, including object hierarchy, request queues, templates, custom forms, calculated fields, approvals, dashboards, and reports.
  • Design Workfront Planning solutions, including workspaces, record types, fields, and views that connect strategic planning to execution in Workfront.
  • Architect Workfront Fusion integrations that connect Workfront with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Assets, other DAMs, marketing automation, CRM, ERP, and collaboration platforms.
  • Define content strategy and DAM strategy recommendations, including asset lifecycle, metadata, taxonomy, and handoffs between work management and asset management.
  • Guide delivery teams through build, testing, and deployment to ensure solutions reflect the approved design and process intent.
  • Partner with project managers and account leaders to scope engagements, estimate effort, and shape statements of work.
  • Produce clear, client-ready deliverables, including assessment findings, process maps, solution designs, governance documents, and executive presentations.
  • Mentor consultants and developers on process-first solution design and Workfront best practices.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience with Workfront, including solution design, configuration, governance, and enterprise implementations.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Workfront Fusion, including integration architecture and scenario design.
  • Hands-on experience with Workfront Planning, including designing workspaces and record types to support strategic and campaign planning.
  • Proven experience leading discovery workshops and facilitating sessions with executive, management, and practitioner audiences.
  • Demonstrated expertise in business process analysis, process mapping, and operational model design.
  • Experience developing role definitions, governance frameworks, adoption or change management plans.
  • Ability to translate business problems into clear recommendations that executives can act on.
  • Strong understanding of marketing, creative, and content operations workflows, including intake, review and approval, resource management, and campaign management.
  • Working knowledge of Workfront API, webhooks, and common integration patterns.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce polished client-facing deliverables.
  • Proven ability to lead client engagements and manage multiple stakeholders with competing priorities.

Preferred Experience

  • Content strategy experience, including content planning, content lifecycle, and content operations models.
  • DAM strategy experience, especially with AEM Assets is a plus.
    • Familiarity with other DAMs such as Bynder, Aprimo, or Frontify is also a plus
  • Experience with the Workfront for Experience Manager Enhanced Connector.
  • Consulting or agency experience delivering transformation engagements for enterprise clients.
  • Experience working in a blended onshore and offshore delivery model.

Preferred Certifications

  • Adobe Workfront Core Developer (Expert preferred)
  • Adobe Workfront Fusion Developer Professional or equivalent Fusion training
  • Adobe Workfront Project Manager Professional
  • Adobe Experience Manager Assets certifications (Business Practitioner or Developer)
  • Process or change management certifications such as Lean Six Sigma, Prosci, or PMP

raw.excerpt: Why RTI RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition.
raw.description:
Why RTI

RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems.

We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you.

About the Hiring Group

RTI International has an opening for a Commercial Sales & Business Development Specialistto join our Commercial Growth unit. The primary focus of this role is on expanding RTI’s business and impact with commercial clients, with a particular emphasis on identifying and developing business opportunities related to Water Solutions. The role will also support commercial growth across Energy, Environment, and Consumer Products sectors, including RTI’s offerings in Sustainability, Circular Economy, Lab Services, and other commercialized solutions.

As a Business Development Specialist, you will play an active role in identifying and pursuing new commercial business opportunities while supporting the processes, tools, and activities that drive an effective sales organization. You will research prospective clients, identify decision-makers, conduct outreach, generate leads, and help build a pipeline of opportunities with private-sector companies.

This role combines hands-on business development with sales operations and coordination. In addition to prospecting and supporting client engagement, you will help plan and execute targeted sales campaigns, maintain accurate CRM and pipeline information, track business development activities, and support improvements to sales processes and tools. You will collaborate with commercial business development leaders, Client Relationship Managers, marketing professionals, and technical staff to develop customer-focused messaging, sales materials, and go-to-market strategies that support growth with new and existing commercial clients.

This position is open to remote candidates within the United States, as well as those who would prefer to be hybrid or on-site at our Research Triangle Park, North Carolina campus. It is expected that this position will require frequent (25%+) travel and conference attendance. This role reports to the Head of Commercial BD Enablement.

What You'll Do

  • Research prospective commercial clients and target accounts, identify key decision-makers, and conduct proactive outreach to generate interest in RTI's services and solutions.
  • Identify and pursue commercial business development opportunities in Water Solutions, including researching prospective clients, understanding industry challenges and customer needs, and supporting targeted outreach to generate new business.
  • Support lead generation and prospecting activities through targeted outreach, follow-up communications, and relationship-building with potential commercial customers.
  • Research and analyze industry trends, client needs, and competitor activities to identify new business opportunities and inform commercial growth strategies.
  • For assigned commercial accounts, provide business development support to client management and delivery teams. Assist with the development of account plans and execute assigned tasks.
  • Conduct background research for pitch meetings, help with development of BD collateral (e.g., pitch decks), document activities.
  • Participate in and organize prospect and client calls, assist with preparation of sales presentations and client-facing materials, document discussions, and coordinate follow-up activities.
  • Use marketing and sales information services and platforms to complete actions required for all phases of the sales cycle – from lead generation through closing.
  • Proactively anticipate customer needs based on market activity to identify emerging projects and cross-selling opportunities with current clients.
  • Coordinate with Marketing and/or Client Delivery teams to help identify and execute business development opportunities, including conferences, events, and outreach campaigns.
  • Contribute to the application of business development best practices, continuous improvement methodologies, tools, and training to facilitate successful business development, forecasting, and planning activities.
  • Participate in intra-group collaboration and coordination efforts related to business development and strategic planning.
  • Continuously build the RTI brand by demonstrating how RTI adds value to clients.

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and at least 3 years of relevant professional experience, or a Master’s degree and at least 1 year of relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • At least 1 year of experience in B2B sales, business development, lead generation, or account development involving commercial/private-sector clients.
  • Demonstrated experience with prospect research, direct customer outreach, lead generation, or development of new commercial business opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to support multiple teams at the same time, and the ability to learn and communicate technical or complex service offerings to prospective customers.
  • Must have strong verbal and written communication skills, highly professional presence, ability to interact with senior clients and project delivery staff.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills such as PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.
  • Experience with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and Go-to-Market/Sales Intelligence software tools (e.g, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Navigator, etc.).
  • Ability to demonstrate RTI Values and Lead Forward behaviors. Behaviors associated with our Values and Lead Forward can been found on RTI Insider and Careers page.
  • To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B visa status, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in commercial sales, business development, lead generation, or account development within the water industry, including water treatment, water technologies, water resource management, or related environmental solutions.

  • Experience researching and selling technical services, consulting, or other commercial solutions related to Water Solutions, Sustainability, Circular Economy, or Lab Services.

  • Engineering or business degree in a field related to energy, environment, sustainability, water resources, or new technology development.

  • Proven track record of building a sales pipeline within an assigned business portfolio.
  • Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools to support business development activities, including prospect research, lead generation, sales outreach, campaign development, and process improvement.
  • Experience working with a diverse set of scientific and professional disciplines, including but not limited to laboratory and statistical sciences, product commercialization, research, or consulting/advisory services.

EEO & Pay Equity Statements

For San Francisco, CA USA Job Postings Only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Further information is available here.

RTI accepts applications to our job openings from candidates with criminal histories or conviction records in accordance with all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

For Applicants in Massachusetts Only: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

The anticipated pay range for this role is listed below. Our pay ranges represent national averages and may vary by location as a geographic differential may be applied to some locations within the United States. RTI considers multiple factors when making an offer including, for example: established salary range, internal budget, business needs, and education and years of work experience possessed by the applicant. Further, salary is merely one element to our offer.

At RTI, we demonstrate our commitment to rewarding individual and team achievement through a total rewards package. This package includes (among other things) a competitive base salary, a generous paid time off policy, merit based annual increases, bonus opportunities and a robust recognition program. Other benefits include a competitive range of insurance plans (including health, dental, life, and short-term and long-term disability), access to a retirement savings program such as a 401(k) plan, paid parental leave for all parents, financial assistance with adoption expenses or infertility treatments, financial reimbursement for education and developmental opportunities, an employee assistance program, and numerous other offerings to support a healthy work-life balance.

From scaling specialized tech infrastructure to delivering bilingual front-line customer service, Jobsity provides an all-in-one staffing solution including recruitment, onboarding, payroll, compliance, and more.

Why Work With Jobsity

We match standout professionals across Latin America with high-impact opportunities at leading U.S. companies. Joining Jobsity is about finding a rewarding remote role and working with innovative teams. It also means you get to become part of a community that values your experience, supports your ambition, and invests in your ongoing professional growth.

Whether you are looking for your next challenge, seeking greater flexibility, or ready to elevate your career, Jobsity gives you the platform and partnership to thrive on your terms.

Job Description

We are looking for an Ignition Engineer (Perspective) to build and maintain SCADA/HMI applications, connecting plant floor data from PLCs into production databases. You will create dashboards and tracking tools (OEE, downtime, traceability) using Python and SQL, working alongside PLC Engineers and technical leads on customer projects.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain SCADA and HMI applications in Ignition.

  • Connect data from PLCs and plant floor devices into Ignition and production databases.

  • Build dashboards, reports, and production tracking tools such as OEE, downtime, and traceability.

  • Write Python scripts and SQL queries to process and organize production data.

  • Collaborate with PLC Engineers and Dash technical leads to deliver customer projects.

Key Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience building SCADA / HMI applications in Ignition (Perspective).

  • 3+ years of Python scripting, ideally within Ignition.

  • 3+ years of SQL (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL), including data modeling for production data.

  • Experience connecting plant floor data to IT systems (OT and IT), using tools like Kepware, OPC UA, or MQTT.

  • Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for Ignition Perspective.

  • Based in Mexico.

What We Offer

At Jobsity, we know that a positive professional experience goes beyond the role itself.

Depending on the position, client, country, and type of contract, professionals may have access to different benefits, programs, and resources designed to support their well-being, development, and remote-work experience.

● Recognition initiatives and internal activities

● Remote-work flexibility

Passionate about leveraging cybersecurity innovation to drive strategic transformation across the Utilities industry, including electric, gas, and water utilities. You develop and deliver cybersecurity services that protect critical infrastructure, enable grid and operational modernization, manage enterprise and operational risk, and support compliance with utility-specific regulatory requirements. This role demands deep expertise across IT and OT environments and the ability to guide utility clients through complex business, technology, reliability, and resilience challenges. You assess current and future cybersecurity capabilities, advise on leading practices, and shape cybersecurity strategies aligned with each utility’s business priorities, regulatory obligations, and operational realities.

The Work:

As a Cybersecurity Manager, you will manage complex information security engagements and workstreams. You will provide cybersecurity subject matter expertise, coordinate project delivery, and serve as a key point of contact for client security, business, and IT stakeholders, Accenture domain experts, and third-party teams. You will lead; manage plans, risks, budgets, and deliverables; and help shape practical solutions that achieve committed client outcomes.

As a team member, you’ll be part of a Utilities industry team focused on applying cybersecurity expertise across the utility value chain—from generation, transmission, and distribution to field operations, customer services, gas delivery, and water operations. You’ll work closely with our Utilities industry leaders to innovate and shape secure, resilient solutions for grid modernization and energy transition.

  • Client Engagement: Build trusted working relationships with electric, gas, and water utility stakeholders, translating their cybersecurity, reliability, regulatory, and operational resilience priorities into actionable workplans and deliverables.

  • Initiative Delivery: Manage cybersecurity workstreams and project teams delivering solutions across cyber defense, AI-enabled security, risk management, and compliance, aligned with client objectives, scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations.

  • Utilities Insight & Strategy Development: Apply deep knowledge of utility operations, regulatory obligations, threat trends, and technology modernization to shape practical client strategies.

  • Innovative Strategy Formulation: Collaborate with utility clients to create and implement forward-looking strategies that secure grid modernization, advanced metering infrastructure, distributed energy resources, cloud adoption, field operations, and IT/OT convergence while protecting safety, reliability, and affordability.

  • Team Leadership & Development: Supervise and coach project team members, assign work, review deliverables, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing delivery environment.

  • Communication & Reporting: Develop clear recommendations, status reports, and executive-ready materials; present findings and delivery progress to client and Accenture stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with client stakeholders to align security initiatives with business objectives and regulatory requirements.

  • Manage cybersecurity assessments, strategy workstreams, and implementation activities across utility enterprise and operational environments, including IT, OT/ICS, cloud, substations, control centers, field systems, advanced metering infrastructure, and customer platforms, while supporting applicable requirements such as NERC CIP, TSA Security Directives, CIRCIA, NIST, and state utility regulations.

  • Support senior leaders in advising utility stakeholders on integrating cybersecurity risk management into operational resilience, capital programs, grid modernization, emergency preparedness, and energy transition initiatives.

  • Manage utility cybersecurity transformation workstreams focused on secure IT/OT convergence, network segmentation, internal network security monitoring, threat detection modernization, cyber resilience, and identity and access management for critical infrastructure.

  • Facilitate utility-specific threat modeling, incident response, and recovery-readiness activities for risks such as ransomware, nation-state activity, supply chain compromise, insecure remote access, and attacks affecting grid, pipeline, water, or customer operations.

  • Work with architects, ecosystem partners, and technology vendors to develop scalable cybersecurity solutions that enable secure grid modernization, automation, cloud adoption, distributed energy resources, and customer digital services without compromising utility reliability or safety.

  • Contribute Utilities cybersecurity expertise to client engagements, proposals, and internal forums.

  • Support Accenture Security and Utilities teams in developing differentiated offerings, reusable assets, and go-to-market materials for utility clients.

  • Establishing trusted relationships with our clients

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements

Here's what you need:

  • Minimum 6 years of work experience working on designing, developing, implementing, and managing solutions across various cybersecurity domains (e.g. industry strategy, security operations, risk management, digital identity, network security, vulnerability management, data protection, cloud security, OT security)
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience leading a team and performing leadership activities like planning, managing and delivery in a Security Account lead role (managing an account)
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience delivering cybersecurity solutions for electric, gas, or water utilities across enterprise IT and operational technology environments (Operational Grids, Substations, and/or Plants, etc.)
  • Experience with Utility Industry cybersecurity and regulatory frameworks, for example: NERC CIP, NRC Cybersecurity, TSA Security Directives, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-82, ISA/IEC 62443, and/or DOE C2M2
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent (12 years) work experience (If an, Associate’s Degree with 6 years of work experience)

Bonus Points If:

  • You have a certifications such as CISM, CISSP, CRISC, TOGAF, SABSA

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

As a Platform Engineer, you will serve as the technical execution and operational owner for a specific identity security product pillar's representation, enablement, and execution across our global technical sales motion.

This role sits within the Technical Solutions Center of Excellence and is responsible for defining key use cases and managing the technical readiness of our scaled demo and evaluation environments. You will partner closely with Product Management, Product Marketing, Technical Marketing, and GTM Strategy teams.

The Platform Engineer ensures that product strategy translates into high-quality, scalable, and repeatable technical execution across live demos, customer evaluations, and new product releases. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep product expertise, strong systems engineering thinking, and significant hands-on technical execution—specifically bridging the gap between DevOps practices, cloud infrastructure, and technical sales engineering.


Your Impact

  • Demo Engineering & Cloud Infrastructure: Architect, build, and maintain scalable, cloud-native demo environments, use-case flows, and value framing for the product pillar. Ensure seamless product representation within shared cloud lab environments via heavy hands-on contribution to infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and automated provisioning pipelines.
  • DevOps & Solution Building: Act as a core technical builder, applying DevOps methodologies to create robust, automated, and ephemeral evaluation environments that simulate complex, real-world customer architectures.
  • Technical Evaluation Architecture: Define technical evaluation use cases, success criteria, and best practices. Continuously update evaluation guidance and automation scripts as the product evolves, ensuring alignment with modern enterprise technology stacks.
  • Release Readiness & Field Enablement: Serve as the technical lead for new product releases within the assigned pillar. Partner with Product and Marketing teams to ensure the field has the technical tools, automation scripts, and stable cloud environments needed to demonstrate new capabilities effectively at scale.
  • Analytics, Insights & Continuous Improvement: Monitor the health and adoption of shared technical environments. Identify execution gaps, environment instability, or technical friction, and drive corrective action through code refactoring, pipeline improvements, or infrastructure optimization.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Engineering, or a related highly technical role.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in identity and access management (IAM), privileged access management (PAM), or adjacent enterprise security platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience deploying, managing, or integrating with CyberArk Secrets Manager (formerly Conjur) for secrets management and DevOps security workflows.
  • Advanced strength with Cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and scaling distributed enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience building, deploying, and managing infrastructure-as-code using tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Experience deploying, managing, or integrating AI tools and autonomous AI agents into cloud infrastructure or development workflows.
  • Advanced system administration skills across Windows and *nix environments, with strong CLI proficiency and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Fluent in scripting and programming languages needed for automation, API integration, and CI/CD workflows: Python, Bash, and PowerShell.
  • Experience architecting, supporting, or leading complex, automated lab/demo environments or sandbox platforms is highly preferred.
  • Strong systems thinking with the ability to translate business strategy into scalable, automated technical execution.
  • Possessing the ability to build credibility working with senior field architects, sales engineers, and cross-functional core engineering partners.
  • Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor in a fast-paced, highly technical matrixed environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of explaining complex architectural designs to both technical and business audiences.

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for US-based, actively practicing physicians (MD/DO) to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation program. General and internal medicine are our main focus. While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, join us!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-based physicians open to part-time, non-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified with the issuing medical board);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not fit to medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $35/hr. Because payment is per approved task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.
